title: Multi-Level Graph Attention Network Contrastive Learning for Knowledge-Aware Recommendation
summary: In recent years, the use of edge information provided by knowledge graphs together with the advantages of higher-order connectivity in graph neural networks for recommendation systems has become an important research direction. However, existing approaches are often limited by sparse labels, insufficient graph structure learning, and noisy entities in the knowledge graph, which reduce recommendation accuracy. To address these limitations, we propose a multi-view graph contrastive learning framework. The proposed method enhances user representations through multi-view knowledge graph distillation, enabling more accurate modeling of user preferences over entities and relations. The network aggregates neighborhood entity information to construct informative item representations. Furthermore, we design a multi-level self-supervised contrastive learning module that performs comparisons across three perspectives: Inter-Level, Intra-Level, and Interaction-Level. This design improves the model's ability to generalize across intra-class samples while increasing discrimination between inter-class samples, thereby enabling more effective multi-dimensional feature modeling. We conduct extensive experiments on three public datasets using both baseline and ablation settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of each module in the proposed model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多视图图对比学习推荐框架，通过多视图知识图谱蒸馏增强用户表示、聚合邻域实体构建物品表示，并设计包含 Inter-Level、Intra-Level、Interaction-Level 三个视角的多层次自监督对比学习模块，在三个公开数据集上以基线与消融实验证明其优于现有 SOTA 方法。
AI.motivation: 现有融合知识图谱边信息与图神经网络高阶连通性的推荐方法普遍受三方面限制：标签稀疏（监督信号不足）、图结构学习不充分（未充分挖掘用户-物品高阶协同结构）、知识图谱中噪声实体（引入错误语义边）。这些因素共同降低了推荐的准确性与泛化能力，亟需一种能同时缓解稀疏性、深化结构学习并抑制噪声的建模方法。
AI.method: 整体为多视图图对比学习框架：（1）多视图知识图谱蒸馏模块，从知识图谱的不同视图/语义层面蒸馏信息，聚合实体的邻域信息，构建信息更丰富的用户与物品表示，以更精确地刻画用户对实体与关系的偏好；（2）图结构学习部分利用 GNN 的高阶连通性聚合邻域实体信息，生成具有判别性的物品表示；（3）多层次自监督对比学习模块，在三个视角上构造对比目标——Inter-Level（类间视角，提升跨类样本判别性）、Intra-Level（类内视角，促进类内样本泛化与一致性）、Interaction-Level（交互视角，对齐用户与物品的交互语义），无需额外人工标签即可提供自监督信号，缓解标签稀疏问题，并实现多维特征建模。训练中通过对比损失联合优化各模块。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的大量实验显示，所提框架持续优于现有 SOTA 方法；消融实验进一步验证了多视图知识图谱蒸馏、邻域实体聚合以及多层次自监督对比学习各模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 融合知识图谱多视图蒸馏与多层次自监督对比学习可有效缓解推荐中的标签稀疏、结构学习不足与噪声实体问题，显著提升用户/物品表示质量与推荐精度；各模块的独立贡献得到消融实验证实。

title: Performance and Energy Trade-Off Analysis of Hierarchical Federated Learning for Plant Disease Classification
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 ERAS Conference
summary: Early detection of plant diseases is critical for improving crop productivity, while it also facilitates the foundations of precision agriculture. Recent advances in distributed deep learning have enabled plant disease classification models to be trained across geographically distributed agricultural sensing infrastructures. However, deploying such systems in large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) environments, introduces significant challenges related to computational cost, energy consumption, and system efficiency. In this paper, we present a design-space exploration of hierarchical federated learning architectures for plant disease classification, with a particular focus on the trade-offs between predictive performance and energy efficiency. We further introduce a power- and energy-aware optimization framework that enables the systematic evaluation and selection of model-aggregator configurations under varying deployment constraints. The hierarchical federated architecture organizes distributed clients through intermediate aggregation layers, reducing communication and computational overhead. We evaluate multiple convolutional neural network architectures, including EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, and MobileNetV3-Large, in combination with different federated aggregation strategies such as FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAvgM. Experimental results demonstrate that different model-aggregator combinations exhibit distinct performance-energy trade-offs. Consequently, we highlight configurations that achieve competitive diagnostic accuracy and significantly reduce system resource requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大规模IoT环境下植物病害分类的分布式深度学习部署难题，提出一种层级联邦学习架构的设计空间探索方案，通过结合多种CNN模型与聚合策略，并引入能耗感知优化框架，系统评估性能与能效之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: deploying distributed deep learning for plant disease detection in large-scale IoT environments faces significant challenges in computational cost, energy consumption, and system efficiency
AI.method: hierarchical federated learning with multiple CNN architectures (EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, MobileNetV3-Large) and aggregation strategies (FedAvg, FedProx, FedAvgM); power- and energy-aware optimization framework for design-space exploration
AI.result: different model-aggregator combinations exhibit distinct performance-energy trade-offs, and certain configurations can achieve competitive accuracy while significantly reducing resource requirements
AI.conclusion: hierarchical federated learning architecture can significantly reduce system resource requirements while maintaining competitive diagnostic accuracy for plant disease classification

title: Maintaining Queries under Updates Using Heavy-Light Partitioning of the Input Relations
summary:
We study the classical incremental view maintenance problem: Given a query and a database, maintain the query output under single-tuple updates (inserts or deletes) to the database such that the tuples in the query output can be enumerated with constant delay after any update.
  We introduce a maintenance approach whose update time matches or improves the best update time reported in prior work. Whereas prior approaches are manually tailored to each of a handful of queries, our approach generalizes to arbitrary join queries. It combines three techniques: delta queries, trees of materialized views, and heavy-light data partitioning. The overall update time incurred by our approach for a given join query is characterized by the maintenance width, a new measure that is parameterized by the heavy-light threshold for data partitioning. We show how to find the threshold that minimizes the maintenance width.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用的增量视图维护方法，通过结合delta查询、物化视图树和轻重数据分区技术，在任意连接查询上实现常数延迟枚举。该方法的关键贡献是定义了"维护宽度"这一新度量，并展示了如何找到最小化维护宽度的分区阈值。
AI.motivation: The classical incremental view maintenance problem requires maintaining query output under single-tuple updates (inserts/deletes) to the database, while ensuring constant delay enumeration after any update. Prior approaches were manually tailored to specific queries and lacked generality.
AI.method: The proposed approach combines three techniques: (1) delta queries, (2) trees of materialized views, and (3) heavy-light data partitioning. The maintenance performance is characterized by "maintenance width," a new parameterized measure based on the heavy-light threshold. The paper also presents a method to find the optimal threshold that minimizes maintenance width.
AI.result: The approach achieves competitive or better update time compared to the best prior work, while providing general applicability to arbitrary join queries.
AI.conclusion: The approach generalizes to arbitrary join queries (unlike prior manually tailored approaches), and can achieve update time matching or improving the best reported in prior work.

title: Designing Intelligent Enterprise Agents: A Capability-Aligned Multi-Agent Architecture
summary: Enterprise interest in multi-agent systems has shifted from generic software agents to large-language-model (LLM) based intelligent agents that plan, use tools, maintain contextual memory, inspect intermediate results, collaborate with other agents, and sometimes act in systems of record. This paper revises the enterprise architecture thesis around a design-first claim: governance is necessary, but it cannot be the primary organizing abstraction. The primary abstraction must be agent design - capability boundaries, autonomy allocation, interaction protocols, tool and data authority, state and memory design, verification design, and human interaction design. We propose CEAD (Capability-Aligned Enterprise Agent Design), a reference architecture for intelligent agents that uses service-oriented architecture (SOA) as an exemplar for contracts, registries, loose coupling, and policy-aware integration, while explicitly rejecting the idea that services are agents. It treats microservices as a cautionary precedent: decomposition without design discipline produces distributed complexity, cost, operational fragility, and agent proliferation. We evaluate CEAD over 10,000 enterprise tasks, comparing five architectures: a prompt-first mono-agent, a role-based micro-agent swarm, SOA-brokered agents, a governance-first but design-poor agent grid, and the proposed CEAD architecture. CEAD achieves 70.6% safe success, versus 45.2% for the mono-agent baseline, 23.1% for the ungoverned micro-agent swarm, 58.8% for SOA-brokered agents, and 50.8% for the control-heavy, design-poor grid. The results support the conclusion that design quality is the first-order enterprise concern; governance, security, policy, audit, and assurance should support and enforce good design rather than substitute for it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CEAD（Capability-Aligned Enterprise Agent Design）参考架构，主张企业级 LLM 智能体的首要组织抽象应是"智能体设计"（能力边界、自治分配、交互协议、工具与数据权限、状态与记忆、验证、人类交互），治理/安全/审计应作为支撑与保证平面而非主导分解逻辑。基于 10,000 个企业任务的架构对比实验，CEAD 的安全成功率为 70.6%，显著高于 prompt-first 单智能体（45.2%）、无治理微智能体群（23.1%）、SOA 代理架构（58.8%）和治理优先但设计拙劣的智能体网格（50.8%）。
AI.motivation: 企业界对多智能体系统的兴趣已从通用软件智能体转向基于大语言模型的智能体，但存在两个现实风险：其一，治理优先（governance-first）的架构思维把治理当作首要组织抽象，导致产生大量"合规外观"的智能体却能力重叠、权责不清、评估薄弱、记忆重复；其二，微服务的历史教训可能重演——出于技术时尚而非设计纪律的分解会引发分布式复杂度、成本、运维脆弱性与"微智能体泛滥"（prompt 包装的微型代理重叠权限、记忆不透明、涌现行为不可测、错误级联）。此外，SOA 作为设计范例提供了契约、注册表、松耦合、策略感知集成等有价值词汇，但服务是被动能力暴露，智能体是目标导向的自主行动者，必须额外评估计划质量、工具选择、抗幻觉、抗提示注入、记忆安全与委派安全。
AI.method: 1) 定义"企业智能体"七项条件（目标导向意图处理、LLM 介导认知、工具介导行动、有界自治、状态与记忆、可观测问责、不确定性处理），并给出 L0 观察 / L1 起草 / L2 准备 / L3 有界执行 / L4 高自治执行五级自治阶梯。2) 以 SOA 为范例（契约、注册表、策略、松耦合、可观测性、版本化）但明确"服务不是智能体"；以微服务为反例警示。3) 提出 CEAD 五层参考架构：意图与结果层、智能体设计平面（中心）、智能体运行时平面、企业能力平面、支撑控制与保证平面。4) 提出核心设计产物 Agent Capability Contract（ACC），含 16 个契约字段：业务能力与所有者、目的与非目的、自治等级、交互拓扑、输入输出模式、工具清单与作用域、数据分级、状态与记忆设计、模型行为策略、验证设计、人类交互、评估证据、可观测性与审计、版本与退役。5) 给出 12 条设计原则（能力先于智能体、边界先于拓扑、契约优先而非提示优先、少量持久智能体、自治是设计变量、最小权限跟随设计、记忆是被设计的状态、确定性检查先于概率式批判、系统级评估、协议是互操作通道而非信任边界、优雅降级、退役机制）与 5 种运行时模式（监督式工具使用智能体、代理式专家、验证/挑战者智能体、点对点协作、人在回路）。6) 实验：10,000 个跨 Finance/HR/采购/IT/法务/销售/客户运营的企业任务（复杂度 1–5、风险 1–5、歧义、敏感度、监管标记、对抗内容标记、工具数、依赖、是否写入），刻意超配跨职能与高风险任务；对比五种架构 A0 prompt-first 单智能体、A1 32 智能体角色群、A2 SOA 代理、A3 24 智能体治理优先网格、A4 CEAD。7) 建立简化成功模型（sigmoid 函数，纳入复杂度、风险、歧义、交接数、依赖与路由质量）与独立的策略违规模型（风险、敏感度、对抗性、交接、策略、最小权限、门控），定义"安全成功 = 功能成功 ∧ 无违规 ∧ 无记忆投毒"。8) 指标：功能成功、安全成功、自动化安全成功、每千任务违规、每千任务记忆投毒、升级率、审计覆盖率、平均交接数、成本、p95 延迟。另做 1–64 智能体数量的扩散扫描、消融实验（去除能力映射/ACC、运行时策略引擎、验证门、最小权限工具作用域、记忆治理、人工审批门）与高风险/监管/对抗子集压力测试。
AI.result: 主表：CEAD 功能成功 73.0%、安全成功 70.6%、自动化安全成功 43.8%、违规 22.4/千、记忆投毒 12.6/千、升级 38.9%、审计覆盖 89.0%、平均交接 2.01、p95 延迟 24.6。A0：52.4/45.2/40.4、违规 118.0、投毒 34.0、审计 32.5%。A1 微智能体群：30.8/23.1/21.8、违规 248.6、投毒 52.4、交接 6.25、审计仅 14.8%。A2 SOA 代理：63.1/58.8/44.2、违规 54.0、审计 68.1%。A3 治理优先设计拙劣网格：53.2/50.8/30.7、违规最低 30.0、审计最高 80.6%，但交接 4.51、p95 延迟 27.8、自动化安全成功仅 30.7%。关键发现：A3 表明治理能降低违规并提高审计覆盖率，却无法补偿弱分解，自动化率与安全成功均落后于 CEAD。扩散扫描：未治理系统在 16–32 个智能体后安全成功率急剧退化，CEAD 更稳定但 64 个时同样退化，印证"用能表达不同能力/风险/状态/评估/所有权边界的最少智能体数"。消融：去掉能力映射与 ACC 使功能成功降至 65.8%、审计覆盖降至 71.7%；去掉运行时策略引擎使违规翻倍至 44.9/千；去掉验证门使功能/安全成功降至 66.7/63.9%；去掉最小权限作用域违规升至 43.0/千；去掉记忆治理记忆投毒近乎翻倍至 28.5/千；去掉人工审批门虽成本与延迟下降（3.5、19.3），但审计覆盖降至 79.6% 且高风险升级路径被移除。压力子集：CEAD 安全成功 67.8%、违规 29.5/千，仍领先；A3 违规最低（38.2 vs A2 的 71.0）但安全成功仅 47.8%。
AI.conclusion: 设计质量是企业智能体的第一性问题：治理、安全、策略、审计与保证应支撑并强制良好设计，而不是取代设计。SOA 的契约、注册表、松耦合与策略感知集成值得借鉴，但必须扩展自治、记忆、验证、人机交互与对抗鲁棒性等智能体特有设计；微服务则提示无纪律分解会带来运维与组织债务。实践建议是围绕持久企业能力构建更少但设计良好的智能体，把每个智能体当作产品对待——具备能力契约、所有者、测试、策略、证据与退役路径：先画能力地图，每个生产智能体必须有 ACC，优先采用"监督者+专家"而非开放式智能体群，治理作为支撑而非主导，按任务/数据/动作/自治级别做最小权限，记忆按企业状态治理，区分互操作与信任，以安全成功（而非单纯完成率）作为发布门与度量标准，季度审查合并重复智能体，将人工审批显式嵌入系统，并准备 kill switch、回滚、记忆隔离、取证追踪与策略撤销等事件响应机制。

title: SalesSim: Benchmarking and Aligning Multimodal Language Models as Retail User Simulators
summary: We present SalesSim, a framework and testbed for evaluating the ability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to simulate realistic, persona-driven customer behavior in multi-turn, multi-modal, tool-augmented online retail conversations. Unlike prior work that treat user simulation as surface-level dialogue generation, SalesSim models retail interaction and decision-making as a grounded, agentic process, where shoppers with diverse backgrounds, preferences, and dealbreakers interact with a sales agent, seek clarifications, and make informed purchasing decisions. For evaluation, we design a suite of metrics centered on decision alignment, measuring the consistency between the simulator's actions and its persona specifications, as well as conversational quality. We find several behavioral gaps after benchmarking 6 open and closed-source state-of-the-art models. First, while models produce fluent conversations, they display significantly lower lexical diversity and overdisclosure of criteria across personas compared to human conversations. Second, models tend to be persuaded by sales agent suggestions and drift from persona specifications. Even the strongest model achieves less than 79% average alignment with its underlying persona specifications. To make progress on these limitations, we propose UserGRPO, a multi-turn, multi-objective reinforcement learning recipe to optimize both conversational fluency and decision alignment under persona specifications. Our experiments demonstrate that UserGRPO boosts decision alignment of the baseline model by 13.8% while improving conversational quality. By introducing SalesSim, we provide a new testbed for the community to investigate and improve the adherence of user simulators in goal-oriented settings.

AI.tldr: SalesSim是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在多轮多模态零售对话中模拟真实用户行为能力的框架和测试平台，通过角色驱动的设计使购物者能够做出知情购买决策。
AI.motivation: 现有用户模拟研究仅停留在表层对话生成，缺乏对零售交互决策过程的深度建模。需要一个能模拟具有不同背景、偏好和底线条件的购物者在工具增强环境中进行真实购买决策的测试框架。
AI.method: 提出SalesSim框架：(1) 构建多轮、多模态、工具增强的在线零售对话模拟环境；(2) 设计以决策对齐和对话质量为核心的评估指标体系；(3) 提出UserGRPO多目标强化学习方法，在保持对话流畅性的同时优化决策对齐。
AI.result: 基准测试6个模型后发现：(1) 生成的对话流畅但词汇多样性显著低于人类对话，且存在跨角色过度披露决策标准的现象；(2) 模型易被销售员建议说服而偏离角色设定；(3) 最强模型与角色规格的平均对齐度不足79%；(4) UserGRPO将基线模型决策对齐度提升13.8%。
AI.conclusion: SalesSim提供了一个可复现的测试平台，使社区能够系统研究多模态大语言模型在角色扮演用户模拟中的行为对齐问题，并证明通过UserGRPO强化学习可显著提升模拟器的决策一致性和对话质量。

title: UserGPT Technical Report
summary:
Personalized user understanding from large-scale digital traces remains a fundamental challenge. Traditional user profiling methods rely on discriminative models and manual feature engineering to predict discrete attributes, often producing fragmented and logically inconsistent profiles that generalize poorly to long-tail behaviors. In this work, we study a generative paradigm in which large language models (LLMs) summarize long and noisy behavioral histories into coherent narratives that capture nuanced user evolution. Our experiments show that even strong LLMs remain limited in complex and implicit personalization reasoning.
  We propose UserGPT, a framework for improving LLM-based persona understanding through both attribute generation and summary generation. To address the scarcity of real-world behavioral data, we develop a User Behavior Simulation Engine that produces realistic and complex user trajectories. We further introduce a Data-Centric Semantization module that transforms heterogeneous behavioral logs into structured and semantically coherent inputs, reducing noise and sparsity. On top of this pipeline, we design a curriculum-driven post-training strategy that combines multi-stage Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Dual-Filter Group Relative Policy Optimization (DF-GRPO) to strengthen reasoning over long behavioral histories.
  We also construct HPR-Bench, a benchmark for holistic persona reasoning derived from simulated data. On HPR-Bench, UserGPT achieves an Avg@10 score of 0.7325 on tag prediction and an $Acc_{Ex}$ score of 0.7528 on summary generation, while compressing behavioral records by up to 97.9% with critical information preserved. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UserGPT for holistic persona reasoning and personalized user-agent interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UserGPT框架，利用LLM通过生成式范式将用户行为历史汇总为连贯画像，并设计数据模拟引擎、结构化语义化模块及课程后训练策略提升模型在长行为历史上的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 传统用户画像方法依赖判别模型和手工特征工程，产生碎片化、不一致且泛化性差的画像；同时现有LLM在复杂隐式个性化推理任务中仍存在局限。
AI.method: 提出UserGPT框架，包含：1）User Behavior Simulation Engine模拟真实用户轨迹；2）Data-Centric Semantization模块将异构行为日志转换为结构化语义输入；3）课程驱动的后训练策略，结合多阶段SFT与DF-GRPO优化；4）构建HPR-Bench基准用于评估。
AI.result: UserGPT在HPR-Bench上：标签预测Avg@10达0.7325，摘要生成Acc_Ex达0.7528，行为记录压缩率达97.9%且保留关键信息。
AI.conclusion: UserGPT 通过生成式范式结合多阶段训练策略，有效提升了LLM在复杂用户行为理解上的表现，在HPR-Bench基准上取得了显著效果，为个性化用户-智能体交互提供了新思路。

title: Scaling Mobile Agent Systems: From Capability Density to Collective Intelligence
summary: Mobile agent systems are emerging as a key paradigm for enabling intelligent applications on edge devices and in AIoT ecosystems. However, their scalability is fundamentally constrained by limited on-device computation and fragmented intelligence across devices. In this work, we propose a unified research agenda for scaling mobile agent systems along two complementary dimensions: (1) improving capability density of individual agents through compact foundation model design and compression, and (2) enabling collective intelligence via communication-rich multi-agent collaboration. Building on recent model and infrastructure advances, this vision aims to transform isolated mobile agents into a distributed intelligent system that is efficient and scalable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的研究议程，用于扩展移动智能体系统（MobiSys'26 愿景论文）。核心思想是沿两个互补维度扩展移动智能体系统：（1）通过紧凑基础模型设计与模型压缩（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、模型合并）、数据策展与鲁棒性认证提升单个智能体的"能力密度"；（2）通过语义通信、结构化协调与高效路由实现多智能体协作的"集体智能"。目标是将孤立的移动智能体转变为一个高效、可扩展的分布式智能系统。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体系统是边缘设备与AIoT生态中实现智能应用的关键范式，但其可扩展性受三重瓶颈制约：(1) 移动设备算力、内存与能耗预算有限，难以部署通常超过1000亿参数的高容量模型；(2) 智能在各设备间呈碎片化分布，智能体通常孤立运行、无法有效协作解决复杂任务；(3) 尽管智能体基础模型与端侧LLM服务已证明个人设备部署智能体的可行性，但延迟、隐私与常在线可用性的需求要求把这些能力带到终端。此外，资源受限环境下的单智能体能力本身存在上限，必须借助多智能体协同才能突破。
AI.method: 论文为研究议程/愿景型工作，不提出单一新算法，而是整合作者既有研究形成二维框架。维度一（能力密度）：在受限资源下改造智能体基础模型，组合使用模型压缩技术（剪枝、量化、蒸馏、模型合并）以降低模型规模与推理成本并保持性能；强调数据侧作用——校准数据策展显著改进量化模型、教学法启发的数据合成增强知识蒸馏；并引入鲁棒性认证，为压缩模型提供抵抗后门与对抗扰动的保证。维度二（集体智能）：以通信为基础设施，语义通信协议使智能体交换意图、上下文与中间推理状态等高层信息，实现从底层数据交换到意义感知交互的转变；以结构化协调放大能力，包括推理的层次化 actor–refiner 框架与面向药物设计等功能导向的智能体流水线；以高效路由解决异构智能体网络中的查询分发，包含分析型路由模型、无需专用GPU的轻量高速路由系统、以及多模态智能体的自适应路由。
AI.result: 论文认为这两条技术路径互补且已获实证支持：精心的、原则化的压缩技术集成可在不牺牲能力的前提下显著提升系统效率；数据为中心的策展对压缩后模型性能保持至关重要；鲁棒性认证是真实部署的前置条件；语义通信、结构化协调与高效路由三者共同使智能体网络成为连贯的分布式系统，智能源于多智能体间的持续交互与协调而非单一模型。未来方向包括模型与基础设施的协同设计（co-design）、从任务级协作走向持续演化的移动智能体生态（长期记忆、从重复交互中学习技能、逐步专业化、自适应协作模式）。
AI.conclusion: 总结而言，移动智能体系统的可扩展性应通过在设备层面推进能力密度、在系统层面推进集体智能来联合实现；智能体的高效化是个体部署扩展的前提，而协作机制则解锁超越单个智能体的系统级智能。论文给出了从孤立移动智能体到高效可扩展分布式智能系统的原则性路径，并指出持续演化的移动智能体生态是后续重要研究方向。

title: Elastic Scheduling of Intermittent Query Processing in a Cluster Environment
summary: Many applications process a stream of tuples over a window duration, and require the results within a specified deadline after the end of the window. For such scenarios, processing tuples intermittently (in batches) instead of eagerly processing tuples as they arrive significantly reduces the overall cost. Earlier work on intermittent query processing has addressed only fixed environments. In this paper, we propose scheduling schemes for batched processing of tuples, in an elastic parallel environment, scaling nodes up or down. Our scheduling schemes ensure to meet the deadlines, while incurring minimum cost. Our schemes also handle multiple concurrent queries, the arrival of new queries, and input rate variations. We have implemented our schemes on top of Apache Spark, in the AWS EMR environment, and evaluated performance with both TPC-H and Yahoo Streaming datasets. Our experimental results show that our scheduling algorithms significantly outperform alternatives, such as using a fixed set of nodes without elasticity, or using Spark streaming.

AI.tldr: 本文研究弹性并行环境下窗口流处理的批量调度问题。针对需要在窗口结束后满足截止时间约束的流处理应用，提出可扩展节点的批量调度策略，在保证截止时间的同时最小化成本。方案支持多并发查询、新查询接入和输入速率变化。在AWS EMR上基于Apache Spark实现并使用TPC-H和Yahoo Streaming数据集验证了算法的优越性。
AI.motivation: Many applications process tuple streams over windows with deadline constraints, but eager processing (per-tuple) is costly. Batch/intermittent processing offers a cost-effective alternative but prior work only addressed fixed environments without elasticity.
AI.method: Implemented on Apache Spark with AWS EMR, evaluated using TPC-H and Yahoo Streaming benchmarks. Scheduling schemes designed to handle elasticity (scale up/down), concurrent queries, new query arrivals, and input rate variations.
AI.result: Experimental results demonstrate significant performance improvements over alternatives including fixed-node configurations and Spark Streaming.
AI.conclusion: The proposed scheduling schemes effectively balance cost minimization and deadline meetability in elastic environments, with significant performance improvements over fixed-resource approaches and Spark streaming.

title: Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Consensus Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems where agents communicate in natural language to solve tasks jointly. A key capability in such systems is consensus formation, where agents iteratively exchange messages and update decisions to reach a shared outcome. However, most existing multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that all participating agents are aligned with the system objective. In practice, a malicious insider may participate as a legitimate member of the group while pursuing a hidden adversarial goal. In this work, we study insider manipulation in multi-agent LLM consensus systems. We formalize the problem as a sequential decision-making task in which a malicious agent seeks to delay or prevent agreement among benign agents. To make attack optimization tractable, we propose a world-model-based framework that learns surrogate dynamics over the latent behavioral states of benign agents and then trains an attacker using reinforcement learning based on this learned model. Preliminary results show that the trained attacker reduces the benign consensus rate and prolongs disagreement more effectively than the direct malicious-prompt baseline. These results suggest that combining latent world models with reinforcement learning is a promising direction for adaptive insider attacks in language-based multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体LLM共识系统中的内部操纵问题，提出基于世界模型的攻击框架，利用强化学习训练恶意智能体延迟或阻止良性智能体达成共识。实验表明该方法比基线更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM框架假设所有参与者都与系统目标对齐，但实际中存在恶意内部人员伪装成合法成员追求隐藏的对抗目标，这方面的研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 提出基于世界模型的框架，学习良性智能体潜在行为状态的替代动态，并基于该习得模型使用强化学习训练攻击者。
AI.result: 训练后的攻击者在降低良性共识率和延长分歧方面优于直接恶意提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 结合潜在世界模型与强化学习是语言多智能体系统中适应性内部攻击的有前景方向。

title: Sanity Checks for Long-Form Hallucination Detection
summary: Hallucination detection methods for large language models increasingly operate on chain-of-thought reasoning traces, yet it remains unclear whether they evaluate the reasoning itself or merely exploit surface correlates of the final answer. We introduce a controlled-invariance methodology that exposes this distinction through two oracle tests: \textsc{Force}, which replaces each response's final answer with the ground truth while preserving the reasoning trace, and \textsc{Remove}, which strips answer-announcement steps while leaving the trajectory intact. This reveals if their predictive power derives from answer-level artifacts rather than from the structure or validity of intermediate reasoning. We further show that once these artifacts are controlled for, effective detection does not necessarily require complex learned representations: TRACT, a lightweight scorer built on lexical trajectory features (hedging trends, step-length dynamics, and cross-response vocabulary convergence), achieves strong robustness while remaining competitive with or outperforming existing baselines on unperturbed traces. These findings suggest that the current central challenge in reasoning-aware hallucination detection is not the absence of signal in the trace, but the failure to isolate it from endpoint cues.

AI.tldr: 长链式推理（CoT）上的幻觉检测器究竟在"评估推理过程"，还是仅在利用最终答案的表层线索？论文提出受控不变性（controlled-invariance）诊断框架，用两个 oracle 干预——Force（将最终答案替换为 ground truth 并规范化宣告格式）与 Remove（删除答案宣告步骤）——两者均保持推理主体不变，用以暴露检测器是否依赖端点伪相关。同时提出轻量级黑盒轨迹打分器 TRACT（Trace Rhetorical and Coherence Trajectory），仅用词汇/结构轨迹特征（对冲趋势、步长动态、跨样本词汇收敛），无需 NLI/嵌入模型或模型内部访问，在 4 个基准 × 5 个模型上对干预保持稳健，且与七个主流黑盒基线互补。
AI.motivation: 1) 长形式推理的幻觉/不确定性检测（语义熵、答案一致性、RACE 等推理感知方法）在未扰动轨迹上取得高 AUC，但这并不能证明其"推理忠实性"——检测器可能主要依赖终点答案的存在性、格式、响应长度或最终答案间的一致性等与推理质量正交的表层线索，使报告的提升高估了真正的推理评估进展。2) 因此需要一种模型无关、可复用的诊断手段，来区分"评估推理轨迹"与"读取答案端点"这两种信号来源。3) 进一步的问题：一旦控制住答案层伪相关，有效的轨迹级检测是否必须依赖复杂的神经表示与昂贵的外部模型（NLI、嵌入模型）？若不必须，则可大幅降低黑盒/闭源部署成本。
AI.method: 1) 受控不变性框架：若检测器声称评估推理轨迹，则保持推理主体的变换不应摧毁其判别能力。Force——把每条响应最终答案替换为 ground truth 并规范化其宣告格式，中间推理不变；Remove——删除显式答案宣告步骤，轨迹主体保留。两种干预都不修复错误推导、也不破坏正确推导，因此轨迹忠实型检测器应保持信息量，AUC 相对对角线大幅偏移即说明其依赖答案级伪相关；标签仍取原始响应的正确性。2) TRACT（Trace Rhetorical and Coherence Trajectory）：纯文本黑盒打分器，对每个 prompt 采样 K=10 条 trace，按空行切分为步骤（退化时按编号/项目符号/换行），剔除答案宣告步与过短/纯标点步；不需 logit、隐藏状态、答案标签、嵌入或蕴含模型。三组特征：Coherence（QuestionRate、WordsPerStep、PlateauFrac）；Structure（HedgeSlope、ColonFrac、MaxStepWc、ScMax、WcVarSlope）；Content（MidUnigramDiv、FinalUnigramDiv，基于 unigram Jaccard 距离；EntityRepeat）。特征经中位数中心化 + IQR 归一化并裁剪至 [-3,3]，块内等幅加权、符号按直觉给定；structure 块恒定参与，coherence/content 由 verbosity gate α(x)=exp(-(w̄-μ)²/2σ²) 调节（μ=28, σ²=50），以抑制散文式长文中表层线索的歧义。3) 实验：4 个基准（BBH-Tracking、GPQA Diamond、MATH-500、CausalT5K）× 5 模型（Nemotron-30B、GPT-OSS-120B、LLaMA-3-70B、Nova Pro、Gemma-3-27B），统一 zero-shot 分步提示，temperature 0.3/top-p 0.95/max 2048 tokens；对 7 个基线（EMR、NCP、BSC、NCS、NSN、RACE、SEU）比较，主指标 AUC；附加步骤级敏感性与特征块消融、TRACT+基线 4 折交叉验证逻辑回归融合的互补性分析。
AI.result: 1) 多数现有检测器在 sanity check 下大幅漂移：RACE 在 BBH-Tracking/Gemma-3-27B 从 Force 76.17 跌至 Remove 54.67，在 GPQA Diamond/Gemma 上几乎反转（Force 24.28 vs Remove 59.01）；NSN 在 MATH-500 上 Force 恒为 50.00（随机）而 Remove 升至 77.40（GPT-OSS-120B）、79.72（Nemotron-30B）；NCP/NCS/BSC/SEU 亦普遍偏移。表明其信号主要来自答案存在性、格式标准化与答案一致性，而非中间推理证据。2) TRACT 在两种干预下几乎不变（BBH-Tracking 与 CausalT5K 上 Force=Remove，如 Gemma 77.03/77.03、GPT-OSS 70.34/70.34、Nemotron 75.44/75.44），绝对 AUC 具竞争力：GPQA Diamond 56.75–74.26、MATH-500 约 67–80、CausalT5K 上 Nemotron 75.44 优于全部基线；且不需 NLI/嵌入模型。3) 步骤级敏感性：EMR/RACE 呈端点锚定（在答案揭示处尖峰），NCS/NCP/BSC/SEU/NSN 早期饱和，TRACT 的敏感度沿轨迹较均匀分布。4) 特征块互补：Content 单块在 MATH-500 达 80.3、GPQA 达 67.5；CausalT5K 上 Structure 单块最强（66.3）；完整组合在各基准最优或接近最优。5) 融合互补：所有 5 个模型上 TRACT+基线融合均优于单独 TRACT，平均增益 +5.42（Gemma）至 +20.00（Nova Pro），最稳定伙伴为 EMR 与 NSN。
AI.conclusion: 当前长形式幻觉检测的核心瓶颈并非轨迹中缺少可用信号，而是没有把轨迹信号与端点线索有效分离。Force/Remove 作为必要（非充分）的 oracle 稳健性检验应成为推理感知幻觉检测的标准评测实践：仅报告未扰动轨迹上的性能不足以说明问题，在受控扰动下性能崩塌或以错误理由保持，即暴露端点依赖。同时表明轻量、可解释的轨迹统计量（局部一致性、对冲/步长动态、跨样本词汇收敛）已足以获得稳健且有竞争力的检测性能，复杂学习表示并非必需；TRACT 可作为廉价、封闭模型可用的黑盒轨迹打分器，与答案重复、语义熵等信号互补融合。

title: Where Reliability Lives in Vision-Language Models: A Mechanistic Study of Attention, Hidden States, and Causal Circuits
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Reasoning. Code and probe-training pipelines: https://github.com/itsloganmann/VLM-Reliability-Probe
summary: A pervasive intuition holds that vision-language models (VLMs) are most trustworthy when their attention maps look sharp: concentrated attention on the queried region should imply a confident, calibrated answer. We test this Attention-Confidence Assumption directly. We instrument three open-weight VLM families (LLaVA-1.5, PaliGemma, Qwen2-VL; 3-7B parameters) with a unified mechanistic pipeline -- the VLM Reliability Probe (VRP) -- that compares attention structure, generation dynamics, and hidden-state geometry against a single correctness label. Three results emerge. (i) Attention structure is a near-zero predictor of correctness (R_pb(C_k,y)=0.001, 95% CI [-0.034,0.036]; R_pb(H_s,y)=-0.012, [-0.047,0.024] on a pooled n=3,090 split), even though attention remains causally necessary for feature extraction (top-30% patch masking drops accuracy by 8.2-11.3 pp, p<0.001). (ii) Reliability becomes legible later in the computation: a single hidden-state linear probe reaches AUROC>0.95 on POPE for two of three families, and self-consistency at K=10 is the strongest behavioral predictor we measure at 10x inference cost (R_pb=0.43). (iii) Causal neuron-level ablations expose a sharp architectural split with direct monitor-design implications: late-fusion LLaVA concentrates reliability in a fragile late bottleneck (-8.3 pp object-identification accuracy after top-5 probe-neuron ablation), whereas early-fusion PaliGemma and Qwen2-VL distribute it widely and absorb destruction of ~50% of their peak-layer hidden dimension with <=1 pp degradation. The takeaway is narrow but consequential: in 3-7B VLMs, reliability is read more reliably off hidden-state geometry, layer-wise margin formation, and sparse late-layer circuits than off attention-map sharpness.

AI.tldr: 研究表明视觉-语言模型的可信度无法从注意力图锐度判断，而应从隐藏态几何、层级边际形成和稀疏后层电路读取。早融合架构比晚融合架构对神经元级攻击更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 挑战"注意力-置信假设"：普遍直觉认为注意力图越锐利（聚焦于查询区域），模型越可信、置信度越校准。该研究直接检验这一假设的有效性。
AI.method: VLM可靠性探针(VRP)框架：统一机制分析流程，结合注意力结构解析、生成动力学追踪、隐藏态几何测量三类方法，在LLaVA-1.5、PaliGemma、Qwen2-VL三个模型族(3-7B参数)上进行因果性测试和相关性分析。
AI.result: (i)注意力结构对正确性预测接近零(R_pb=0.001)，但因果性仍必要（遮蔽top-30% patch准确率降8.2-11.3pp）；(ii)隐藏态探针在POPE上AUROC>0.95，K=10自一致性是最强行为预测因子(R_pb=0.43)；(iii)因果神经元消融揭示架构分裂：晚融合LLaVA集中于脆弱瓶颈(top-5神经元消融-8.3pp)，而早融合PaliGemma/Qwen2-VL分布广泛(消融50%隐藏维度仅-1pp)。
AI.conclusion: 在3-7B参数的视觉-语言模型中，可信度应从隐藏态几何而非注意力图锐度来读取；早融合架构对神经元消融更具鲁棒性。

title: Reddit2Deezer: A Scalable Dataset for Real-World Grounded Conversational Music Recommendation
summary: Conversational music recommendation (CMR) research currently faces a tradeoff between authentic dialogue corpora that are limited in scale and synthesized corpora that scale up but whose conversations are artificially constructed rather than naturally observed. In this paper, we introduce Reddit2Deezer, a reality-grounded CMR resource derived from 190k unique {thread, leaf-comment} pairs. We release the resource in two versions: a raw version that preserves authenticity, and a paraphrased version that maximizes long-term reproducibility. Each musical entity is linked to a Deezer identifier, which provides straightforward access to audio previews and rich metadata (e.g., genre tags, popularity, BPM), opening the door to future research on content-grounded conversational recommendation. A human validation confirms the quality of the dialogues, item grounding, and paraphrases. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/McAuley-Lab/Reddit2Deezer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reddit2Deezer数据集，通过从Reddit提取190k个{帖子,评论}对来解决对话音乐推荐研究中真实对话语料规模受限与合成语料缺乏真实性的矛盾，提供原始版本和 paraphrase 版本，并链接 Deezer 音乐元数据。
AI.motivation: 当前对话音乐推荐研究面临两难困境：真实对话语料规模有限，而可扩展的合成语料缺乏自然对话的真实感。
AI.method: 从 Reddit 收集190k个唯一的{帖子,叶子评论}对，发布原始版本和 paraphrase 版本，每个音乐实体链接 Deezer ID 以获取音频预览和丰富元数据（流派标签、流行度、BPM等），并通过人工验证确认对话质量、项目关联性和 paraphrase 质量。
AI.result: Reddit2Deezer 数据集兼具真实性和可扩展性，支持内容驱动的对话推荐研究，提供了高质量的音乐元数据和音频资源。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集已在 Hugging Face 发布，为对话音乐推荐研究提供了新的资源基础。

title: OrbitBFT: Enabling Scalable and Robust BFT Consensus in LEO Constellations
summary: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are evolving from communication relays into autonomous platforms operating in increasingly congested and contested environments. Since uplinks to ground stations can be severed or jammed, ensuring reliable coordination among satellites requires autonomous Byzantine Fault-Tolerant (BFT) consensus. However, applying conventional BFT protocols to LEO constellations is challenging due to their dynamic topology, sparse connectivity, and limited communication bandwidth. In this paper, we present OrbitBFT, a novel two-stage hierarchical BFT consensus protocol tailored to the unique characteristics of LEO constellations. First, OrbitBFT exploits the topological stability within orbital planes to partition the constellation and perform localized intra-plane consensus, which reduces communication overhead. Second, we design a Byzantine-resilient bypass mechanism and a hop-by-hop transmission protocol to ensure reliable message delivery and mitigate congestion, even in the presence of adversarial behavior. Third, we adapt and optimize PBFT and HotStuff to the LEO context, achieving linear message complexity while preserving safety and liveness. Extensive evaluations in a realistic Starlink-based simulation demonstrate that OrbitBFT significantly improves scalability, throughput, and latency compared to its original designs, making it a practical and efficient BFT solution for large-scale satellite networks.

AI.tldr: OrbitBFT 是面向低轨（LEO）卫星星座的两阶段分层拜占庭容错（BFT）共识协议：利用同一轨道面内星间链路的拓扑稳定性做面内局部共识，把跨面协调限制在一个常数规模委员会内，从而把消息复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O(N)、跨面链路开销降到 O(k)；同时设计了可容错的绕行（bypass）机制、逐跳传输与拥塞感知流控机制，并在 Starlink-I 参数的高保真仿真中验证了吞吐与时延的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 低轨星座正从通信中继演化为自主协同平台（自主避碰、星座重构、在轨数据处理等），但星地上行链路可能被中断或干扰，必须具备自主的 BFT 共识能力。将地面成熟协议（PBFT、HotStuff）直接搬到 LEO 存在三重根本性错配：(1) 拓扑动态且稀疏——同轨面内链路稳定成环，跨轨面链路随轨道运动不断建立/断开，单星最多维持 2 条面内 + 2 条跨面共 4 条 ISL，网络逼近有向图拜占庭共识的连通性必要条件极限，单个拜占庭节点靠选择性丢包即可阻断共识；(2) 规模巨大（Starlink 已超 9000 颗、申报规模近 20 万颗），O(N²) 消息复杂度与密集 P2P 假设不可行；(3) 现有卫星 BFT 工作（HPBFT、SatBFT）要么依赖不稳定的跨面链路做簇内共识，要么依赖 GEO 中继形成集中瓶颈，均不满足去中心化与可扩展要求。
AI.method: 1）两阶段层次化架构：星座按物理轨道面划分为 k 个并行共识组（每组 n 节点，n=3f_i+1），面内由确定性选举的平面领导者 PL 主持标准 BFT，产出带法定人数签名的部分证书；随后确定性选出全局领导者 GL，PL 并行异步地把提案汇聚给 GL，GL 用确定性函数排序聚合，在由伪随机函数按 ViewID 选取的常数规模委员会 N_c（N_c≪k，k≥3f_g+1）内发起 BFT 共识，成功后 PL 将最终序列下播给本面副本。2）拜占庭容错绕行机制（面内可靠投递）：ACK 确认 → 超时未收到 ACK 即怀疑路径被扰动并向相邻轨道面发起绕行，失败则递归请求前驱节点做更宽绕行，深度上限为 n（判定形成物理闭包并触发视图变更）；路径按段划分责任，只有收到目标端到端 ACK 才算完成，以抵御"正确转发但截获最终 ACK"的欺骗型拜占庭行为。3）逐跳传输与 relay race：PL 一次发起、消息沿环向两侧对向传播直至对称节点，每个节点须向其后 f_i+1 个后继转发并收 ACK，确保至少一个诚实节点继续传播，PBFT 的 PRE-PREPARE/PREPARE/COMMIT 与 HotStuff 的各阶段均改造为逐跳执行并收集 2f+1 签名。4）拥塞感知的滑动窗口流控（窗口 W 限制在途未提交实例数）。5）确定性领导者轮换与视图变更：面内 PL 为 p=v mod n、跨面 GL 为 g=v mod k，收集 2f+1 个 VIEW-CHANGE 即进入新视图，绕过递归深度超限或超时即触发视图变更。6）理论分析：证明绕行机制可靠性引理（引理1）并据此给出安全性/活性定理1，给出消息复杂度 O(N) 定理2、跨面链路利用率 O(k) 定理3，以及恢复时延 T_recovery=T_timeout+T_vc 的解析界。7）实验：基于 Hypatia/NS-3 高保真仿真平台，采用 Starlink Phase I（72 轨面×22 星=1584 星）、ISL 默认 1 Mbps，对比 PBFT/HotStuff 的 native 与 opt 版本，测试带宽风暴（热/冷 ISL 利用率）、1/10 Mbps 下时延-吞吐、窗口机制消融、平面规模 7→22 的扩展性、全星座规模下的时延与吞吐。
AI.result: 理论层面：绕行机制在 n=3f_i+1 且拜占庭节点不构成物理闭包的假设下保证任意两个诚实节点间可靠投递（覆盖"拒转发"与"欺骗转发+截获 ACK"两类攻击），从而继承底层 BFT 的安全性与活性；总消息复杂度为 k·C_BFT(n)+O(k)+O(1)，把面内规模 n 视为常数参数时对 N 呈线性（PBFT 因 PREPARE/COMMIT 为 n×O(n) 故平面内仍是 O(n²)，HotStuff 因领导者中心化为 O(n)）；跨面链路每轮仅 O(k) 次消息；每条物理链路单次广播仅承受 O(1) 负载，避免领导者邻近链路的 O(n) 瓶颈。实验层面：1 Mbps 下优化版峰值吞吐 87 TPS，约为原生版 8.2 TPS 的 10 倍，10 Mbps 下优化版峰值超过 870 TPS；相同吞吐下热链路带宽占用大幅下降且冷/热链路负载均衡（原生版热 ISL 打满、冷 ISL 利用率不足 10%）；平面规模从 4/7 增至 22 时，原生协议最大吞吐下降 84%，优化版仅下降 15%，且时延最多降低 27%（逐跳虽增加跳数但消除了拥塞）；关闭窗口机制后吞吐在峰值后崩塌（典型拥塞崩溃），开启后吞吐稳定在峰值；全 1584 星星座下 PBFT-native 在 200 秒时延上限内无法完成运行（推算需约 30 小时仿真），HotStuff-native 峰值吞吐不足 5 TPS，而 OrbitBFT 版本在吞吐上升时延增长缓慢。
AI.conclusion: OrbitBFT 证明了一条可行的路：不去对抗 LEO 的全局动力学，而是"全局动态、局部不变"这一特性本身就是最有效的优化杠杆——把共识切分到稳定的轨道面环上，跨面只保留与轨道面数 k 成正比的极小协调量，从而在保持安全/活性与 O(N) 线性消息复杂度的同时获得数量级吞吐提升与更低时延，且不依赖 GEO 等外部高轨基础设施。其核心取舍是以"平面领导者构成信任边界"换取线性可扩展性，拜占庭 PL 的影响被视图变更与轮换领导限制在单面内、且是暂时性的。局限与展望：面内 n 视为常数才使总体复杂度线性（PBFT 变体平面内仍为 O(n²)）；需要每个平面满足 n≥3f_i+1 的本地容错阈值，跨面用常数规模委员会 N_c 换取扩展性；递归绕行带来额外时延与实现复杂度，深度上限 n 是防止无界等待的折中；安全性证明依赖"拜占庭节点不形成物理闭包"这一概率性假设。后续工作聚焦于对抗局部拜占庭分区——即串谋对手形成连通子图、以破坏法定人数形成与路由自适应性的挑战。

title: PrepBench: How Far Are We from Natural-Language-Driven Data Preparation?
summary: Data preparation is a central and time-consuming stage in data analysis workflows. Traditionally, commercial tools have relied on graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to simplify data preparation, allowing users to define transformations through visual operators and workflows. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) raise the possibility of a paradigm shift toward natural language (NL)-driven data preparation, in which users can specify preparation intents in NL directly. However, it remains unclear how far current LLM-based agents are from this paradigm shift in practice. Existing code generation benchmarks do not capture key characteristics of data preparation, including ambiguous user intents, imperfect real-world data, and the need to translate code into interpretable workflows for validation. To bridge this gap, we present PrepBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate NL-driven data preparation along three core capabilities: interactive disambiguation, prep-code generation, and code-to-workflow translation. We crawl data from the Preppin' Data Challenges, and then extend it into a systematically designed benchmark. The benchmark covers diverse domains, and each task involves 3 to 18 data preparation steps. Nearly half of the tasks require over 100 lines of Python code, and the longest solutions approach 300 lines. Our evaluation shows that, despite recent progress, realizing this paradigm shift remains challenging for state-of-the-art LLMs. PrepBench provides a principled benchmark for measuring this gap and helps identify key challenges toward realizing NL-driven data preparation.

AI.tldr: PrepBench是一个用于评估自然语言驱动数据准备的基准测试，涵盖交互式消歧、代码生成和代码到工作流翻译三项核心能力。该基准基于真实数据准备挑战构建，包含复杂的多步骤任务。评估表明当前最先进的LLM在实现自然语言驱动的数据准备范式转变方面仍存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 传统商业工具依赖GUI进行数据准备，但LLM的最新进展可能推动向自然语言驱动范式的转变。然而，现有代码生成基准未能捕捉数据准备的关键特征，包括模糊的用户意图、不完美的真实世界数据和需要将代码翻译成可解释的工作流以供验证。
AI.method: 作者从Preppin' Data Challenges抓取数据，并将其扩展为包含三个核心能力维度的系统性基准：(1)交互式消歧，(2)预备代码生成，(3)代码到工作流的翻译。基准覆盖多个领域，每个任务包含3到18个数据准备步骤。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，尽管近期有所进展，但实现这一范式转变对最先进的LLM仍然具有挑战性。近一半任务需要超过100行Python代码，最长的解决方案接近300行。
AI.conclusion: PrepBench为衡量NL驱动数据准备的差距提供了原则性基准，有助于识别实现该范式转变的关键挑战。当前最先进的LLM在实现这一范式转变方面仍面临挑战。

title: SceneFactory: GPU-Accelerated Multi-Agent Driving Simulation with Physics-Based Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Autonomous-driving simulators typically trade physical fidelity for scalable parallelism. Physics-based platforms such as CARLA and MetaDrive provide articulated vehicle dynamics and contact, but their non-vectorized interfaces make batched training difficult. GPU-batched systems such as Waymax and GPUDrive scale to hundreds of scenarios by replacing rigid-body physics with simplified kinematic models, omitting tire--road interaction, suspension, contact dynamics, and road-condition-dependent friction. We introduce SceneFactory, a GPU-vectorized platform for procedural scene construction, physics-based multi-agent simulation, and RL in autonomous-driving environments. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim + Isaac Lab, SceneFactory represents worlds and agents as batched tensors: control, observations, rewards, resets, and policy inference run as GPU tensor operations over the Isaac Lab tensor API. SceneFactory converts Waymo Open Motion Dataset road topologies into simulation-ready USD worlds, runs many worlds concurrently on one GPU, populates each with multiple articulated PhysX vehicles, and maps precipitation and road-surface type to PhysX material friction coefficients. With GPU vectorization, SceneFactory achieves up to 127$\times$ higher throughput than a non-vectorized PhysX baseline on the same GPU and physics solver, reaching 19,250 controlled-agent simulation steps per second at 256 worlds $\times$ 16 agents. Cross-simulator transfer reveals an asymmetric dynamics gap: physics-grounded RL policies transfer to a simplified kinematic bicycle model with 99.5% success, whereas reverse transfer drops to 47.3%. Under wet-road friction, friction-aware policies reduce mean peak DRAC from 58.7 to 27.8,m/s$^2$ without sacrificing goal reach. SceneFactory shows that scalable autonomous-driving training need not discard articulated rigid-body dynamics or physically grounded road-condition variation.

AI.tldr: SceneFactory是一个基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim + Isaac Lab的GPU向量化平台，在自主驾驶环境中实现程序化场景构建、基于物理的多智能体仿真和强化学习训练。相比非向量化PhysX基线，吞吐量提升127倍；在256个世界×16个智能体配置下达19,250步/秒。跨仿真器迁移显示动力学保真度不对称性：物理策略可迁移至简化自行车模型（99.5%成功率），反之仅47.3%。湿滑路面摩擦感知策略将峰值DRAC从58.7降至27.8 m/s²。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶模拟器面临物理保真度与可扩展并行化之间的权衡：CARLA、MetaDrive等物理平台虽提供车辆动力学和接触建模，但接口无法向量化，难以进行批量训练；Waymax、GPUDrive等GPU批量化系统虽支持数百场景扩展，但用简化运动学模型替代刚体物理，忽略了轮胎-路面交互、悬架、接触动力学及路面摩擦特性。因此需要一种同时具备物理保真度和GPU可扩展性的平台。
AI.method: 基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim + Isaac Lab构建，将Waymo Open Motion Dataset道路拓扑转换为仿真就绪的USD世界，以批量化张量表示世界和智能体，控制、观测、奖励、重置和策略推理均作为GPU张量操作运行；将降水和路面类型映射为PhysX材料摩擦系数；支持多个Isaac PhysX关节车辆并发运行。
AI.result: GPU向量化使SceneFactory在同一GPU和物理求解器上相比非向量化PhysX基线实现最高127倍吞吐量提升，256世界×16智能体配置下达19,250步/秒；跨仿真器迁移揭示动力学差距的不对称性：物理强化学习策略迁移至简化自行车模型成功率达99.5%，反之仅47.3%；湿路面摩擦感知策略将平均峰值DRAC从58.7降至27.8 m/s²，且不牺牲目标达成。
AI.conclusion: SceneFactory证明可扩展的自动驾驶训练无需放弃关节式刚体动力学或物理真实的路面条件变化，为高保真物理仿真与大规模并行化训练的结合提供了可行方案。

title: How Much Do Circuits Tell Us? Measuring the Consistency and Specificity of Language Model Circuits
summary: The circuits framework in mechanistic interpretability aims to identify causally important sparse subgraphs of model components, typically evaluated by measuring necessity and sufficiency. We measure circuit reuse, the proportion of components shared across per-example circuits within a task, and investigate two less-studied properties of this: consistency, the recurrence of components within a task, and specificity, their uniqueness to a task. Using edge attribution patching across six tasks and seven models, we find that within-task reuse is high and that shared components are necessary for task performance, with ablations causing up to $\sim$100% relative accuracy drops. However, circuits turn out not to be task-specific: ablating one task's circuit damages another task's performance about as much as that task's own circuit does. We discover that this is due to substantial overlap between circuits across tasks, which are causally important for performance. Some circuits do contain a smaller set of task-specific components, but these account for only a modest portion of circuit performance. Overall, our findings suggest that while circuit discovery at the level of attention heads and MLP layers identifies important components, their lack of task-specificity raises questions about the degree to which circuits can support targeted understanding and intervention on model behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了电路框架中模型组件在任务间的共享程度，发现虽然电路复用率高且共享组件对性能至关重要，但电路并非任务特异性的——跨任务存在大量重叠。这表明基于电路的针对性干预可能面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在探索电路（模型中重要的稀疏子图）在任务间的共享程度，并考察两个较少被研究的属性：一致性（任务内组件的重复出现）和特异性（组件对特定任务的唯一性）。研究的根本动机是评估电路框架是否能够支持对模型行为的针对性理解和干预。
AI.method: 使用边缘归因修补（edge attribution patching）方法，在6个任务和7个模型上进行实验，测量任务内复用率、共享组件的必要性，以及跨任务的特异性。
AI.result: （1）任务内复用率很高；（2）共享组件对任务性能至关重要，消融可导致高达约100%的相对准确率下降；（3）电路并非任务特异性的——消融一个任务的电路对另一个任务的损害程度与消融该任务自身电路相当；（4）跨任务电路存在大量重叠，这些重叠部分对性能具有因果重要性；（5）虽然存在少量任务特异性组件，但其对电路整体性能的贡献有限。
AI.conclusion: 虽然电路发现能够识别重要组件，但电路缺乏任务特异性，这对其支持模型行为的针对性理解和干预的能力提出了质疑。该研究揭示了跨任务电路共享的程度远超预期，这既是一个重要发现，也对基于电路的干预策略提出了挑战。

title: Spatial Priming Outperforms Semantic Prompting: A Grid-Based Approach to Improving LLM Accuracy on Chart Data Extraction
comment: his is the version of the article accepted for publication in SUMMA 2025 after peer review. The final, published version is available at IEEE Xplore: https://doi.org/10.1109/SUMMA68668.2025.11302248
summary: The automated extraction of data from scientific charts is a critical task for large-scale literature analysis. While multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, their accuracy on non-standardized charts remains a challenge. This raises a key research question: what is the most effective strategy to improve model performance (high-level semantic priming) or low-level spatial priming? This paper presents a comparative investigation into these two distinct strategies. We describe our exploratory experiments with semantic methods, such as a two-stage metadata-first framework and Chain-of-Thought, which failed to produce a statistically significant improvement. In contrast, we present a simple but highly effective spatial priming method: overlaying a coordinate grid onto the chart image before analysis. Our quantitative experiment on a synthetic dataset demonstrates that this grid-based approach provides a statistically significant reduction in data extraction error (SMAPE reduced from 25.5% to 19.5%, p < 0.05) compared to a baseline. We conclude that for the current generation of multimodal models, providing explicit spatial context is a more effective and reliable strategy than high-level semantic guidance for this class of tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文对比两种提升多模态大模型图表数据抽取精度的策略：高层次语义引导（如"元数据优先"两阶段框架、思维链）与低层次空间引导（在图像上叠加坐标网格）。语义方法未带来统计显著改进，而简单的坐标网格叠加使 SMAPE 从 25.5% 降至 19.5%（p<0.05），得出"显式空间上下文比高层语义引导更有效可靠"的结论。
AI.motivation: 科学图表数据抽取是文献大规模自动化分析的关键环节。虽然多模态 LLM 展现出潜力，但在非标准化图表上的精度仍具挑战性。作者提出的核心研究问题是：提升模型性能应当采用高层次语义引导（high-level semantic priming）还是低层次空间引导（low-level spatial priming）？二者缺乏在同一受控实验下的直接对比。
AI.method: 在合成数据集上进行对照实验，比较两类策略：(1) 语义类方法——两阶段"元数据优先"框架（先抽取图表元数据/语义信息再抽取数值）与 Chain-of-Thought 提示；(2) 空间类方法——在送入模型前于图表图像上叠加坐标网格线，为模型提供显式的像素—坐标参照。以无网格为基线，用 SMAPE 衡量数据抽取误差，并做统计显著性检验（p<0.05）。
AI.result: 语义类方法（两阶段元数据框架与 CoT）未能产生统计显著的误差下降；网格叠加方案则使 SMAPE 从 25.5% 显著降低至 19.5%（p<0.05），即相对误差约降低 23.5%，为该策略中最有效者。作者指出这一结果基于合成数据集上的定量实验。
AI.conclusion: 对于当前一代多模态模型，在图表数据抽取任务中提供显式的空间上下文（坐标网格）比高层语义引导更有效、更可靠。实践启示：改进此类任务应优先考虑低层次空间线索的构造，而非仅靠提示工程式的语义推理流程；同时需注意结论的适用范围受合成数据集与当前模型能力的限制。

title: OpenIIR: An Open Simulation Platform for Information Retrieval Research
summary: OpenIIR runs hundreds of LLM-driven personas as parameterised, reproducible IR research experiments. Researchers configure agents across four kinds of multi-agent study (deliberative panels, social platforms, curated recommender feeds, and evolutionary co-evolution between content producers and credibility detectors) under many priors, rounds, and constraints. Persona budgets, retrieval policies, ranker choices, intervention timings, and mutation rates are declared up front, and the same study can be re-run under different settings to compare outcomes side by side. Every run produces structured outputs (argument graphs, exposure logs, fitness traces, transcripts) that a downstream evaluator can consume directly, and a new study is a 200--400 line plug-in over a shared core (agent runtime, world-model store, retrieval primitives, claim extractor, persona ontology). The contributions are: (i) the shared core; (ii) a type interface for pluggable scenarios; (iii) four released types with reference runs (Panel, Social-Media, Curated-Feed, Multi-Generational); and (iv) six modular extensions sketched against open IR research questions.

AI.tldr: OpenIIR是一个用于信息检索研究的可参数化、可复现的多智能体模拟平台，通过运行数百个LLM驱动的角色（personas）来开展各类实验研究。该平台支持四种多智能体研究范式，并提供结构化输出和模块化插件框架。
AI.motivation: 当前IR研究面临实验可复现性差、难以系统化比较不同设置下的结果、以及缺乏标准化实验框架的问题。研究者需要一种能够参数化配置、可重复运行、并产生结构化输出的大规模模拟平台来推动IR研究。
AI.method: OpenIIR采用多智能体模拟架构，配置项包括：角色预算、检索策略、排序器选择、干预时机、变异率等。平台核心功能包括：智能体运行时环境、世界模型存储、检索原语、声明提取器、角色本体论。研究通过200-400行插件扩展实现新场景定制。
AI.result: 平台产出结构化输出（论证图谱、曝光日志、适应度追踪、转录文本），支持同一研究的参数对比实验。已发布四种研究类型（Panel、Social-Media、Curated-Feed、Multi-Generational）及六个模块化扩展原型。
AI.conclusion: OpenIIR通过提供共享核心、类型化插件接口和标准化输出格式，为IR研究社区提供了一个可复现、可比较、可扩展的多智能体实验平台，降低了大规模模拟研究的门槛。

title: Intelligent Autonomous Orchestration for Distributed Cloud Resources using Complex-Stability Analysis
summary: In modern distributed cloud environments, efficient resource allocation is required as traditional scaling mechanisms are often subject to cloud thrashing due to network-induced latencies. In this paper, we propose C-SAS (Complex-Stability Aware Scaling), an intelligent autonomous orchestration framework that leverages complex analytic methods to achieve system-wide equilibrium. In contrast to heuristic-based models, C-SAS acts as a stability-aware agent, converting telemetry noise into a deterministic "Safety Envelope" on the $s$-plane using the Argument Principle and Rouché's Theorem. The algorithm smartly suppresses oscillatory scaling operations that would otherwise degrade performance, by computing a real-time Analytic Stability Index (ASI). The experimental results show that C-SAS reduces VM flapping by 94\%, and achieves 96\% resource efficiency, significantly outperforming standard PID and ML-based autonomous agents. Our results suggest that future resilient autonomous cloud infrastructures will require AI-driven orchestrators with built-in formal stability constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 C-SAS（Complex-Stability Aware Scaling）：把分布式云弹性伸缩建模为带纯时延τ的开环传递函数 L(s)=D(s)·K·e^{−τs}/(Ts+1)，用辐角原理与 Nyquist 判据给出 Z=0、N=0 的确定性稳定判据，用 Rouché 定理把遥测噪声扰动界 ‖Δ‖∞<min|1+L(iω)| 定义为“安全包络”，并据此实时计算相位裕度 φ_m 与解析稳定指数 ASI，在扩容动作前做前瞻性增益衰减（K_safe=K·φ_m/φ_target），从而抑制振荡式伸缩。仿真中 VM flapping 降低 94%、资源利用率 96%、抖动 8.4 ms、调节时间 12 s，相对启发式与 PID 控制器及 ML 黑箱方法优势明显，并节能 22%。
AI.motivation: 分布式云/HPC 环境中，控制信号与反馈信号之间存在网络传播时延 τ（往返时延），在反馈回路中形成死区时间，导致系统在过度供给与供给不足之间来回振荡，即“云抖动/云 thrashing”，浪费能耗并恶化 QoS。现有工业级自动伸缩多为启发式阈值（如 CPU>70% 扩容），缺乏在随机网络条件下的稳定性证明；PID 类方法未刻画时延在复平面的相位滞后；Lyapunov 类方法局限于时域、难以扩展到多区域大规模系统；ML 方法虽是黑箱但预测精度高，却无法给出“不会进入混沌振荡”的数学证明，也无法给出可容忍的最大时延上限。作者的核心问题是：能否用复分析（辐角原理、Nyquist 判据、Rouché 定理）刻画分布式反馈回路的频域稳定性，从而把“调参试错式”的伸缩策略变成可计算的确定性边界，并保证 RHP 内不稳定零点数为零。
AI.method: 1) 建模：云节点视为一阶系统 T·dy/dt + y = K·u(t)，得 G(s)=K/(Ts+1)；利用时移性质把网络时延表示为指数移位 e^{−τs}，得开环 L(s)=D(s)·K·e^{−τs}/(Ts+1)（引入无穷多极点，故需 Nyquist 而非 Routh-Hurwitz）。2) 稳定性判据：取包围 RHP 的 Nyquist D 轮廓 Γ，由辐角原理 N=Z−P，要求 Z=0、N=0；L(jω) 曲线顺时针环绕 (−1,j0) 即为不稳定临界。3) 相对稳定性：增益交越频率 ω_c=√(K²−1)/T，相位 φ_m=180°−arctan(Tω_c)−ω_c·τ（给出 τ、K 与相移裕度的确定性关系）。4) 鲁棒性：设实际系统 L′=L+Δ(s)，由 Rouché 定理得稳定半径 δ_max=min_ω|1+L(iω)| 与安全包络条件 ‖Δ(iω)‖∞<min|1+L(iω)|，超出则进入阻尼模式冻结伸缩。5) ASI：定义为复积分 ∮_Γ (d/ds)arg(1+L(s))ds，用 Cauchy 留数定理把资源 flapping 概率与绕数（缠绕数）绑定并约束为零。6) 算法 C-SAS（Algorithm 1）：每周期采样 τ 与到达率 λ → 计算 ω_c、φ_m → 若 φ_m<φ_target(=45°) 则按 β=φ_m/φ_target 衰减增益得 K_safe，否则取标称增益 → 再做 Rouché 噪声检查，噪声在稳定半径内则执行 u*(s)=K_safe·D(s)，否则维持现状抑制瞬时抖动；并给出 (K,τ) 空间中的“稳定前沿”。7) 敏感性分析：T 不可控时在频域自适应调整 K，权衡响应性与稳定性。8) 实验：基于 K8s HPA 逻辑改造的离散事件仿真器，50 个虚拟实例（T=200–800 ms）、Gamma 分布模拟多区域时延抖动、泊松突发负载、10000 次请求，与启发式阈值和 PID 基线对比。
AI.result: • 稳定边界量化：T=500 ms 时 τ>180 ms 相位裕度跌破 15°，进入“欠阻尼振荡供给”即云 thrashing 的数学成因；τ>150 ms 时标准 PID 出现不稳定环绕，而 C-SAS 通过动态调整 ω_c 始终维持 φ_m≥45°。• 对比基线（表 V）：平均抖动 8.4 ms（启发式 45.2 / PID 22.1）；VM flapping 率 1.1%（18.5 / 9.2，即相对 PID 降低约 94%）；调节时间 12 s（120 / 45，约 10 倍改进）；资源效率 96%（72 / 84）。• 噪声鲁棒性：δ_max 与噪声方差对比曲线呈“安全包络”，绕数在包络内保持为零，接近边界时自动提升阻尼比并冻结伸缩，抑制 noisy-neighbor 引起的 VM 迁移。• 能耗：总功耗与稳定指数呈非线性关系（VM 启停开销），稳定裕度下降时功耗上升；C-SAS 维持“高稳定-低能耗”绿区，24 小时周期相对 PID 节能 22%。• 图形验证覆盖频率响应（Nyquist 轨迹随时延 50→250 ms 顺时针旋转逼近 (−1,j0)）、时域收敛（稳定时间 vs 抖动）、Rouché 稳定包络。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张云 thrashing 并非随机异常，而是网络诱导相位滞后的可预测后果；把弹性伸缩从启发式阈值升级为带形式化稳定性约束的形式控制模型，可对单层分布式资源分配给出确定性稳定保证与可计算的时延容忍上限（相位裕度不低于 45°），实现更少的伸缩抖动、更快的平衡收敛与更低的能耗。局限与后续方向：现有模型为线性、常时延、单层且一阶近似（未考虑多节点耦合、队列饱和、迟滞死区）；未来工作包括非线性与时变时延 τ(t)（面向 6G/卫星边缘）、多层微服务耦合稳定性（数据库与 API 网关伸缩逻辑互耦）、RL 与 C-SAS 的混合智能体（用 ML 预测负载但保留 Rouché 确定性安全包络）、以及无服务器冷启动动态（FaaS 极端冷启动下的伸缩稳定性）。

title: Personalized w-Event Privacy for Infinite Stream Estimation
summary: In applications such as event monitoring, log analysis, and video querying, $w$-event privacy protects individual data within a sliding time window while supporting accurate stream statistics. Existing studies on infinite data streams mainly assume homogeneous privacy requirements for all users, which cannot capture user-specific privacy preferences. This paper studies personalized $w$-event privacy for private data stream estimation. We first design the Personalized Window Size Mechanism (PWSM), which supports personalized privacy requirements at each time slot. Based on PWSM, we propose Personalized Budget Distribution (PBD) and Personalized Budget Absorption (PBA) to estimate streaming statistics under $\boldsymbol{w}$-Event $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{E}}$ Personalized Differential Privacy (($\boldsymbol{w}$, $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{E}}$)-EPDP). PBD guarantees that the budget reserved for the next time step is no smaller than the budget consumed in the previous release, while PBA improves the current budget by absorbing unused budgets from the previous $k$ time slots and borrowing from the next $k$ time slots. We further develop Dynamic Personalized Budget Distribution (DPBD) and Dynamic Personalized Budget Absorption (DPBA), which allow users to dynamically adjust privacy requirements while satisfying $(τ, \boldsymbol{w}_B, \boldsymbol{w}_F)$-Event $(\boldsymbol{\mathcal{E}}_B, \boldsymbol{\mathcal{E}}_F)$-Personalized Differential Privacy. We prove that all proposed methods achieve the corresponding personalized differential privacy guarantees and derive their error upper bounds. Experiments show that our methods reduce estimation error by at least $53.6\%$ compared with state-of-the-art algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无限数据流统计估计中的"个性化 w-事件隐私"：允许每个用户拥有各自的隐私预算 ℰ_i 与事件窗口 w_i（并可随时间变化），同时仅发布每时隙一个共享聚合直方图。作者提出 PWSM 框架（含 OBS 最优预算选择 + 采样机制 SM + 相似度判定的自适应发布），以及固定设定下的 PBD/PBA 和动态设定下的 DPBD/DPBA 四个机制，证明其分别满足 (w,𝓔)-EPDP 与 (τ,w_B,w_F,𝓔_B,𝓔_F)-EPDP，并给出误差上界；实验表明 AMRE 相对 BD/BA 至少下降 53.6%。
AI.motivation: 经典 w-事件隐私（Kellaris et al. 的 BD/BA、RescueDP、SPAS 等）假设所有用户共享同一隐私预算 ℰ 与窗口 w，属于"一刀切"策略，难以反映现实中的异质隐私偏好：例如名人需要强位置保护、街头艺人希望分享位置；统一取最大窗口 w=8 会对多数用户过度保护并抬高误差，统一取最小预算 ℰ 又使全部用户保护不足（论文中给出网约车 100 司机示例：8-事件下 Uniform 法误差 128，降至 4-事件则降至 32 但违反两名司机需求）。核心挑战有三：①异质隐私预算需统一为系统级发布决策（每时隙只有一个共享聚合输出）；②个性化预算在窗口内的时间分配问题；③动态（时变）隐私需求带来的历史预算兼容与未来可行性维持问题，即在线可行性问题。已有 PDP/HDP/Geo-I 等个性化隐私工作均不涉及无限流的持续发布与 w-事件语义。
AI.method: 1) 定义基础概念：w-邻接流前缀、(τ,w)-后向/前向邻接关系、(w,𝓔)-EPDP 与 (τ,w_B,w_F,𝓔_B,𝓔_F)-EPDP（后者等价于前向邻接 = (τ+w-1,w) 后向邻接）；威胁模型为可信策展者（CDP）持续发布被扰动直方图。2) 固定个性化设定 PWEPP-IDS：提出 Optimal Budget Selection (OBS)，在离散预算上枚举阈值 ε_θ，平衡采样误差 err_s（方差+平方偏差）与噪声误差 2/ε_θ²，取全局最优 ε_opt；据此构建 Personalized Window Size Mechanism (PWSM)：将用户预算拆为 Part_DC（计算与上次发布的私有相似度 dis）与 Part_NOP（发布新统计量），比较 dis 与 √err 决定是否发布新结果，否则复用上次发布值。3) PBD：发布预算按"为下一时隙预留不少于本次消耗"的分配策略（每时隙消耗为剩余预算的一半），适合变化剧烈的流；PBA：以预算份额 ℰ_i/(2w_i) 为单位，从前 k 个时隙吸收未用预算并向后 k 个时隙预借，支持跳过（skipped）与作废（nullified）发布，适合平滑流。4) 动态设定 DPWEPP-IDS / DPWSM：提出后向可行性条件（ε_{i,t} ≤ ℰ_B − 窗口内历史消耗）与前向可行性条件（ε_{i,t} ≤ min_{τ∈T_B} (𝓔_F − 前向窗口已消耗)），并据此在每时隙计算可行上界，取后向与前向上界的最小值作为该用户预算；DPBD 沿用分布式调度，DPBA 额外计算前向"作废时隙右边界" R_FN 以支持前向吸收。5) 理论分析：给出 PBD/PBA/DPBD/DPBA 的隐私证明（滑窗组合定理）、误差上界（含 Lemma 1 的 OBS 误差上界 min{2I²/min ε², (n−n_A)(n−n_A+1/4)+2I²/max ε²}）、时间复杂度 O(n)（固定）/O((w_max^F+w_max^B)n)（动态）与空间复杂度，以及误差分解分析。
AI.result: 隐私：PBD/PBA 满足 (w,𝓔)-EPDP（定理4.3），DPBD/DPBA 在每个时隙满足 (τ,w_B,w_F,𝓔_B,𝓔_F)-EPDP（定理5.3）。工具性：固定设定下 PBD 平均 AMRE 比 BD 低约 72.6%（Taxi）、72.0%（Foursquare）；动态设定下 DPBD 比 BD 低 73.5%/93.3%；合成数据上 PBA 比 BA 低 30.2%(TLNS)/24.6%(Sin)/21.1%(Log)，DPBA 低 70.6%/61.0%/63.6%（变窗口 w 时 DPBA 至少低 53.6%）。总体结论：相对 SOTA 至少降低 53.6% 的估计误差。机制选择规律：真实数据（变化剧烈）上分布型 PBD/DPBD 更优，合成平滑数据上吸收型 PBA/DPBA 更优；DPBD/DPBA 普遍优于 PBD/PBA；SPAS 在 w=40 时误差很小但随 w 增大急剧恶化，个性化方法更稳定；PLBU（LDP）在多数数据集最差。误差分解显示 OBS 引入的额外误差主要来自采样偏差（平方项）而非采样方差，且该偏差同时影响相似度估计与自适应发布决策——这是 PBA 在 Foursquare 上反而不如同质 BA 的原因之一。
AI.conclusion: 本文将 w-事件隐私从同质扩展到异质、时变的个性化需求，核心贡献是提出"异质→系统级发布"的统一框架：不是简单替换全局窗口/预算，而是在重叠、异质、时变的个性化约束下构造并维持有效的共享发布预算。方法上以 OBS 在采样机制中求最优预算阈值，再以私有相似度驱动自适应发布（跳过/作废/分配/吸收四类调度），并给出完整隐私保证与误差上界，验证了动态设定下的误差界可退化为固定设定的界。局限与展望：继承了经典 w-事件隐私的"有界窗口、非轨迹级"语义；仅覆盖可信策展者（CDP）场景；效用上界随非空发布数呈指数增长，频繁更新下吸收型机制精度下降；未来工作包括本地/洗牌模型下适配时变偏好的机制、高速流优化，以及在移动众包、社交媒体分析等场景的应用，并考虑分布型与吸收型机制之间的自适应切换策略。

title: NeurIPS Should Require Reproducibility Standards for Frontier AI Safety Claims
summary: Frontier AI safety claims - published assertions that a highly capable general-purpose model is below a threshold of concern, adequately mitigated, or suitable for release - increasingly shape model deployment, governance, and public trust. Yet the artefacts needed to evaluate them are routinely withheld, producing an evidential inversion: the most consequential claims in AI safety are often the least reproducible. This position paper argues that NeurIPS should require reproducibility standards for papers making such claims, treating non-reproducibility not as a transparency preference but as an evaluation-methodology failure. The 2026 International AI Safety Report [Bengio et al., 2026] concludes that reliable pre-deployment safety testing has become harder to conduct and that models now distinguish test from deployment contexts; the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index [Wan et al., 2025] reports a sector-average transparency score of 40/100 with no major developer adequately disclosing train-test overlap; contemporaneous measurement-theory work shows that attack-success-rate comparisons across systems are often founded on low-validity measurements [Chouldechova et al., 2025]. We propose a three-tier disclosure framework, distinguishing public, controlled, and claim-restricted disclosure, paired with a mandatory claim inventory, scope statements, and a phased implementation path with graduated sanctions. The framework treats secrecy and openness as endpoints of a spectrum, with controlled review (via a federated colloquium of qualified secure-review hosts) covering claims whose artefacts cannot be released publicly, and right-scaling claims whose artefacts cannot be reviewed even confidentially. The standard the community applies to its most consequential claims should be at least as high as the standard it applies to its least.

AI.tldr: 一篇立场论文，论证 NeurIPS 应要求涉及高能力通用模型安全阈值的论文满足可重现性标准，将不可重现性视为评估方法论缺陷而非透明度偏好，并提出包含公开/受控/声称受限三级披露的框架及渐进式制裁机制。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI安全声称日益影响模型部署、治理和公众信任，但评估所需的 artifacts 被常规性保留，导致"证据反转"：最具影响力的AI安全声称反而最难以重现。
AI.method: 提出三级披露框架：公开披露、受控披露和声称受限披露；配套强制性声称清单、范围声明、分阶段实施路径和渐进式制裁措施；通过合格安全审查主持人联盟的联邦研讨会实现受控审查。
AI.result: 建立了三级披露框架，区分公开披露、受控披露和声称受限披露三种情形；提出强制性声称清单和范围声明要求；设计了分阶段实施路径和渐进式制裁机制。
AI.conclusion: NeurIPS应将论文的可重现性标准作为强制要求而非透明度偏好；对于无法公开审查的声称采用受控审查机制，对于连机密审查都无法进行的声称进行正确评估；社区对其最具影响力的声称所采用的标准应至少不低于对最不具影响力声称的标准。

title: Do not copy and paste! Rewriting strategies for code retrieval
summary: Embedding-based code retrieval often suffers when encoders overfit to surface syntax. Prior work mitigates this by using LLMs to rephrase queries and corpora into a normalized style, but leaves two questions open: how much representational shift helps, and when is the per-query LLM call justified? We study a hierarchy of three rewriting strategies: stylistic rephrasing, NL-enriched PseudoCode, and full Natural-Language transcription, under joint query-corpus (QC, online) and corpus-only (C, offline) augmentation, across six CoIR benchmarks, five encoders, and three rewriters spanning independent model families (Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral). We are the first to evaluate NL-enriched PseudoCode and snippet-level Natural Language as direct retrieval representations, rather than as transient intermediates. Full NL rewriting with QC yields the largest gains (+0.51 absolute NDCG@10 on CT-Contest for MoSE-18), while corpus-only rewriting degrades retrieval in 56 of 90 configurations, about 62%. We introduce two diagnostics, Delta H, token entropy, and Delta s, embedding cosine, and show that Delta H predicts retrieval gain under QC across all three rewriter families: pooled Spearman rho = +0.436, p < 0.001 on DeepSeek+Codestral; rho = +0.593 on Codestral alone; rho = +0.356 on Qwen. This establishes Delta H as a cheap, rewriter-agnostic proxy for deciding when rewriting pays off before running retrieval. Our analysis reframes LLM rewriting as a cost-benefit decision: it is most effective as a remediation layer for lightweight encoders on code-dominant queries, with diminishing returns for strong encoders or NL-heavy queries.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了「LLM 重写」用于代码检索的效果边界：提出将 NL 富化伪代码与片段级自然语言直接作为检索表示，在 6 个 CoIR 基准 × 5 个编码器 × 3 个重写器家族（Qwen/DeepSeek/Mistral）上对比三种抽象层级（风格改写 / PseudoCode / 完整 NL）与两种增强模式（查询+语料 QC 在线、仅语料 C 离线），并提出两个表示层诊断量 ΔH（输入 token 熵）与 Δs̄（嵌入余弦），其中 ΔH 是与检索增益显著正相关且与重写器无关的廉价代理指标。结论是：QC-NL 在代码密集查询上增益最大（MoSE-18 在 CT-Contest 上 +0.51 NDCG@10），仅语料重写在 90 组配置中 56 组（约 62%）反而退化，ΔH 可在检索前预判重写是否值得。
AI.motivation: 现有基于嵌入的代码检索存在「表层语法过拟合」问题：编码器过度依赖词法/句法线索，把语义不同的片段映射到相近向量。已有工作（Li et al. 2024 的风格改写、Li et al. 2025b 的 code→PseudoCode→code 往返）尝试用 LLM 归一化风格，但存在四点未解：(i) 抽象层级被预先固定为「代码」单一层级，从未把伪代码或片段级 NL 当作直接检索目标评测；(ii) 都要求逐查询的在线 LLM 调用，成本高；(iii) 只用单一重写器，跨模型家族泛化性未知；(iv) 缺少「何时值得重写」的判据。因此需要回答：多大的表示迁移才有帮助？在线 LLM 调用何时划算？
AI.method: 提出受控的「抽象层级 × 在线成本」二维实验框架。三个重写层级：(1) 风格改写 Rephrase（Li et al. 2024 作为单轴基线）、(2) NL 富化 PseudoCode、(3) 片段级完整自然语言转写；层级 (2)(3) 首次直接作为检索表示而非中间桥梁。两种增强模式：QC（查询+语料同时重写，在线）与 C（仅语料重写，离线一次）。基准：CoIR 中 6 个测试集（CT-Contest、CT-DL 代码到代码；Apps、CosQA 文本到代码；StackOverflow-QA、CodeFeedback-MT 混合），指标 NDCG@10。编码器 5 个：Qwen3-Emb-0.6B、E5-Base-V2（通用）与 MoSE-18、CodeXEmbed、UniXcoder（代码专用），共 90 组配置。重写器 3 个独立家族：Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct、DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct、Codestral-22B，另用 Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B–14B 做过重写器规模的体外实验。诊断量：在相同批处理下计算输入 token 一元熵 H 与其差值 ΔH（编码器「看到」什么），以及 L2 归一化嵌入的均值成对余弦 s̄ 与其差值 Δs̄（编码器「如何组织」表示）；再用 (ΔH, Δs̄) 空间中的薄板样条 RBF 插值构建「检索效能景观」，并做 Spearman/Pearson 相关与显著性检验。效率侧在 H100-80GB、vLLM、FP16、512 token 上下文、约 115 tok/s 下测量离线重写 GPU 小时与在线每查询解码延迟。
AI.result: (1) 代码到代码任务上 QC-NL 对全部编码器最优（CT-DL 为 5 中 4），MoSE-18 在 CT-Contest 从 0.23→0.74（+0.51），E5-base-v2 +0.24，CodeXEmbed 基线已 >0.33 说明强编码器收益饱和；PseudoCode 稳定介于 Rephrase 与 NL 之间。(2) 文本到代码任务层级崩塌：Apps 上 QC-Rephrase 最佳（CodeXEmbed +0.14），CosQA 上无任何 QC 配置超过基线（Qwen3-Emb 0.38、CodeXEmbed 0.34）；混合任务三种策略差异 <0.01，QC 下 Pseudo/NL 并列 0.26。(3) 仅语料重写在 56/90（≈62%）配置中退化，QC 在 78/90（86.7%）配对比较中占优，根因是查询–语料模态错配。(4) 增益与编码器强度反相关：四个纯检索任务平均 QC-NL 使 MoSE-18 相对提升 +175%、UniXcoder +32%、E5-base-v2 +39%，而 Qwen3-Emb-0.6B 持平或略降。(5) 表征层：除 Qwen3-Emb（151k 词表吸收 NL 多样性）外 ΔH 随抽象层级单调递增；NL 降低全部编码器的 s̄（最多 UniXcoder −0.15），PseudoCode 最不一致；NL 达最高 Hapax%（43.5%）、覆盖 80% 词表需约 1.9× 不同词。(6) 相关分析：QC 下 ΔH 是唯一显著预测量（ρ=+0.356，p<0.01；r=+0.319，p<0.05），C 下两者均不显著，Δs̄ 与 ΔH 基本独立（ρ=+0.229，p=0.078）。跨重写器复现：Codestral ρ=+0.593（p<0.001）、DeepSeek ρ=+0.274、合并非 Qwen ρ=+0.436（p<0.001）；CosQA 上 ΔH 为负/接近零（−0.11、−0.36）而 ΔNDCG 一致为负。(7) 效率：约 38K 片段语料离线重写约 16.5 GPU·小时（NL）/ 11（Rephrase），QC 每查询额外约 725 ms 解码延迟。(8) 重写器规模越大平均质量越好但非逐对单调；CT-Contest 上 NL 对 Qwen(0.81)、DeepSeek(0.65) 最佳，Codestral 则 Rephrase 最佳（0.74），说明「Rephrase<Pseudo<NL」并非普适。
AI.conclusion: LLM 重写的价值应被理解为成本–收益决策而非默认收益：QC 重写（含完整 NL 转写）应作为轻量编码器在代码主导查询上的「补救层」，在强编码器或 NL 丰富的查询上应跳过重写；仅语料离线重写因模态错配通常不可行。ΔH（token 熵增量）被确立为廉价且与重写器无关的代理指标，可在运行检索前判断重写是否划算，并双向地识别每个重写器下的最优策略。局限性包括未覆盖闭源前沿重写器、CoIR 语料偏 Python、诊断量为语料级聚合而非逐查询预测、延迟测量未含生产级批处理与缓存；风险方面重写可能引入语义漂移与幻觉，建议抽样审计、保留原文指针、仅在收益大于成本与幻觉风险时采用 QC-NL。

title: Change My View? The Dynamics of Persuasion and Polarization in Online Discourse
summary: Philosophical accounts of persuasion often assume that shared evidence and rational argumentation should lead to a convergence of views between peers, yet everyday discourse often suggests otherwise. In this study, we use large language models to analyze a corpus of debates on Reddit's r/ChangeMyView, where belief revision is publicly signaled. Large language models were asked, halfway through each discussion, to forecast whether such an acknowledgement would arise; their probabilistic estimates serve as a conversational baseline. Each reply was then coded, through a hybrid machine-assisted procedure, for ten familiar rhetorical strategies -- concession, empathy, logical challenge, credibility appeals, and so forth. Adding these strategic features markedly improves predictive power and yields a consistent pattern: moves that express concession or empathetic alignment substantially increase the prospect of belief change, whereas frontal refutation, credibility attacks, and topic deflection diminish it. The findings indicate that effective public reasoning depends as much on relational framing as on evidential content, and they invite a refinement of normative accounts of rational dialogue.

AI.tldr: 研究通过大语言模型分析在线辩论语料，发现修辞策略对观点改变有显著预测力，其中让步和共情策略促进说服，而正面反驳和信誉攻击则阻碍说服，表明有效的公共推理需兼顾关系框架与证据内容。
AI.motivation: 哲学上的说服理论通常假设共享证据和理性论证应导致观点趋同，但日常话语实践表明现实往往相反，存在理论与实践之间的张力。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型对Reddit r/ChangeMyView辩论语料进行分析，通过混合机器辅助程序对每条回复编码10种常见修辞策略（让步、共情、逻辑挑战、信誉诉诸等），并让LLM在半程对话时预测是否会形成观点认可。
AI.result: 修辞策略特征显著提升预测能力：表达让步或共情对齐的策略大幅增加观点改变的可能性，而正面反驳、信誉攻击和话题转移则削弱这一可能性。
AI.conclusion: 有效的公共推理既依赖于关系框架，也依赖于证据内容，这对规范性的理性对话理论提出了修正要求。

title: Auto-Rubric as Reward: From Implicit Preferences to Explicit Multimodal Generative Criteria
summary: Aligning multimodal generative models with human preferences demands reward signals that respect the compositional, multi-dimensional structure of human judgment. Prevailing RLHF approaches reduce this structure to scalar or pairwise labels, collapsing nuanced preferences into opaque parametric proxies and exposing vulnerabilities to reward hacking. While recent Rubrics-as-Reward (RaR) methods attempt to recover this structure through explicit criteria, generating rubrics that are simultaneously reliable, scalable, and data-efficient remains an open problem. We introduce Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR), a framework that reframes reward modeling from implicit weight optimization to explicit, criteria-based decomposition. Before any pairwise comparison, ARR externalizes a VLM's internalized preference knowledge as prompt-specific rubrics, translating holistic intent into independently verifiable quality dimensions. This conversion of implicit preference structure into inspectable, interpretable constraints substantially suppresses evaluation biases including positional bias, enabling both zero-shot deployment and few-shot conditioning on minimal supervision. To extend these gains into generative training, we propose Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO), which distills ARR's structured multi-dimensional evaluation into a robust binary reward, replacing opaque scalar regression with rubric-conditioned preference decisions that stabilize policy gradients. On text-to-image generation and image editing benchmarks, ARR-RPO outperforms pairwise reward models and VLM judges, demonstrating that explicitly externalizing implicit preference knowledge into structured rubrics achieves more reliable, data-efficient multimodal alignment, revealing that the bottleneck is the absence of a factorized interface, not a deficit of knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARR框架，通过将VLM隐式偏好知识显式外部化为结构化评分标准来解决多模态对齐问题，并结合RPO方法将多维评估提炼为稳定的二元奖励，在生成任务上取得性能提升
AI.motivation: 当前RLHF方法将人类判断的多维组合结构简化为标量或成对标签，忽视了偏好的细微差别，且容易受到奖励黑客攻击；同时现有RaR方法在生成可靠、可扩展、数据高效的评分标准方面仍存在问题
AI.method: 1. ARR框架：将VLM内化的偏好知识通过提示特定评分标准外部化，将整体意图转化为可独立验证的质量维度；2. RPO方法：将ARR的结构化多维评估提炼为鲁棒的二元奖励，用评分标准条件化的偏好决策替代不透明的标量回归
AI.result: 实验表明ARR-RPO在文本到图像生成和图像编辑任务上优于成对奖励模型和VLM评判器，显著抑制了评估偏差（包括位置偏差），支持零样本部署和小样本条件化
AI.conclusion: ARR-RPO在文本到图像生成和图像编辑基准测试中优于成对奖励模型和VLM评判器，证明了将隐式偏好知识显式外部化为结构化评分标准可以实现更可靠、数据效率更高的多模态对齐，揭示了对齐瓶颈在于缺少分解接口而非知识不足

title: A General Framework for Multimodal LLM-Based Multimedia Understanding in Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
summary: Conventional recommendation systems frequently fail to fully exploit the high-dimensional semantic signals inherent in multimedia content, thereby limiting the fidelity of user preference modeling. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) offer robust mechanisms for interpreting such complex data, their integration into latency-constrained, industrial-scale architectures remains a significant challenge. To address this, we propose a generalized framework for MM-LLM-driven multimedia understanding. Our methodology employs a tripartite architecture encompassing content interpretation, representation extraction, and systematic pipeline integration, instantiated via a LLaMA2-based model that generates descriptive captions subsequently ingested as tokenized categorical features. Empirical evaluation demonstrates the efficacy of this approach, yielding a $0.35\%$ increase in offline AUC and a $0.02\%$ improvement in online metrics at scale, substantiating the practical viability of leveraging MM-LLMs to enhance large-scale recommendation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多模态大语言模型（MM-LLM）的多媒体推荐框架，通过LLaMA2生成描述性caption作为类别特征，实现离线AUC提升0.35%，在线指标提升0.02%。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统未能充分利用多媒体内容的高维语义信号，导致用户偏好建模精度受限；同时，MM-LLMs在工业级低延迟架构中的集成面临挑战。
AI.method: 采用三部分架构：内容解释、表示提取、系统流水线集成。实例化为基于LLaMA2的模型，生成描述性caption作为token化类别特征输入推荐系统。
AI.result: 离线AUC提升0.35%，在线指标提升0.02%，验证了MM-LLMs增强大规模推荐系统的可行性。
AI.conclusion: MM-LLMs可有效提升工业级推荐系统性能，框架具有良好的通用性和实用性。

title: On defining and modeling context-awareness
summary:
Purpose - This paper presents a methodology for defining and modeling context-awareness and describing efficiently the interactions between systems, applications and their context. Also the relation of modern context-aware systems with distributed computation is investigated.
  Design/methodology/approach - On this purpose, definitions of context and context-awareness are developed based on the theory of computation and especially on a computational model for interactive computation which extends the classical Turing Machine model. The computational model proposed here, encloses interaction and networking capabilities for computational machines.
  Findings - The definition of context presented here develop a mathematical framework for working with context. Also the modeling approach of distributed computing enables us to build robust, scalable and detailed models for systems and application with context-aware capabilities. Also enables us to map the procedures that support context-aware operations providing detailed descriptions about the interactions of applications with their context as well as with other external sources.
  Practical implications - A case study of a cloud based context-aware application is examined using the modeling methodology described in the paper so as to demonstrate the practical usage of the theoretical framework that is presented
  Originality/value - The originality on the framework presented here relies on the connection of context-awareness with the theory of computation and distributed computing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套上下文感知(context-awareness)的定义与建模方法论,把"上下文"与"上下文感知"建立在计算理论(尤其是扩展图灵机的交互式计算模型)与分布式计算之上,并以云端上下文感知应用为案例验证其实际可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文感知研究多停留在概念性、分散的描述层面,缺乏统一的理论基础与可操作的建模工具,难以系统刻画系统、应用与其上下文(含外部信息源)之间的交互;同时"上下文感知系统"与现代分布式计算的关系尚不明确。因此作者试图从计算理论出发,为"上下文"和"上下文感知"给出严格定义,并提供可扩展、可复用的建模框架。
AI.method: 1) 基于计算理论,尤其是扩展经典图灵机的交互式计算模型,提出新的计算模型,把交互与网络能力纳入计算机器之中;2) 由此形式化地定义"上下文"与"上下文感知",构建处理上下文的数学框架;3) 引入分布式计算的建模方法,建立具备上下文感知能力的系统与应用模型,并映射支撑上下文感知操作的过程(procedures),以详细描述应用与自身上下文及其他外部来源的交互;4) 通过一个基于云的上下文感知应用案例研究,验证该理论框架与建模方法在实际中的使用方式。
AI.result: 结果表明:(a) 所提出的上下文定义构建了一个可用于处理上下文的数学框架,赋予了上下文严格的形式化语义;(b) 分布式计算的建模方法可构建健壮、可扩展且粒度精细的系统与应用上下文感知模型;(c) 该方法能映射出支撑上下文感知操作的过程/流程,给出应用与上下文、外部信息源之间交互的详细描述;(d) 案例研究展示了理论框架在云环境中的实际可行性与用法。
AI.conclusion: 本文的原创性/价值在于将上下文感知与计算理论、分布式计算建立系统性连接,并由此形成一套定义—建模—映射—验证的完整方法论;其意义在于为上下文感知系统提供了统一的理论基础与可扩展的建模工具,使应用与上下文及外部源之间的交互可被形式化地描述与分析,为后续复杂上下文感知系统的设计与比较提供了通用基座。

title: Slipstream: Trajectory-Grounded Compaction Validation for Long-Horizon Agents
comment: 9 pages (16 pages counting references, appendix), 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: To cope with the large contexts that long-horizon LLM agents produce, modern frameworks increasingly rely on compaction -- invoking an LLM to rewrite the accumulated trajectory into a shorter summary that the agent resumes from. Today, compaction runs synchronously on the critical path of agent execution but this can unpredictably degrade accuracy due to a structural validation gap: the compactor must condense context but is fundamentally unaware of precisely what information the agent will need later. Further, because post-compaction agent steps are conditioned on the new summary, targeted validation criteria do not exist and errors silently propagate through coherent but incorrect behavior. Our key insight is that asynchronous compaction efficiently addresses this gap: by running the compactor in parallel with continued agent execution on the original context, the candidate summary and the agent's next steps are generated independently from the same pre-compaction state, yielding a validation signal independent of the summary itself. We build Slipstream, a trajectory-grounded compaction system that uses a judge to validate the candidate summary against the agent's continued reasoning, checking that it preserves both the agent's forward intent and the key facts and constraints it depends on. Across long-horizon coding (SWE-bench Verified) and web-browsing (BrowseComp) workloads, Slipstream improves task accuracy by up to 8.8 percentage points while reducing end-to-end latency by up to 39.7%.

AI.tldr: Slipstream 把长程 LLM 智能体的上下文压缩(compaction)从同步阻塞改为异步执行:压缩器在独立线程上并行生成候选摘要,主智能体仍在原始(未压缩)上下文上继续推进若干步;压缩结束后用一个「轨迹接地」的 judge 用这段 next-k 轨迹校验候选摘要是否同时保住了智能体的前向意图(plan-level)与其依赖的关键事实/约束(statement-level),通过则连同已生成的 next-k 步一起采纳,不通过则按诊断做定向修补(必要时回退同步压缩)。在 SWE-bench Verified 与 BrowseComp 上相对同步压缩基线,任务准确率最高提升 8.8 个百分点,端到端延迟最多降低 39.7%。
AI.motivation:
长程智能体依赖 compaction 压缩不断膨胀的上下文,但当前 compaction 一律同步执行,存在两大结构性缺陷:
1) **准确性缺陷(验证缺口)**:压缩器必须「预测」智能体未来会需要哪些信息,而同步执行中摘要一旦替换原上下文,后续所有步骤都以该摘要为条件,智能体的后续行为不可能作为独立校验信号;一旦摘要遗漏或篡改信息,失败会以「连贯但错误」的形式静默传播,传统 faithfulness/coverage/ROUGE 等摘要度量只对照源上下文,无法看见未来行为,因而无法给出针对性的充分性(sufficiency)判据。真实 trace 中约 90% 的失败是遗漏(omission),其余为捏造/意图篡改(commission),典型案例包括漏掉唯一正确候选、把局部改 patch 指令变成全局指令、用虚构实体替换已确认实体。
2) **延迟缺陷**:压缩位于智能体执行关键路径上,阻塞工具调用与推理,占端到端 per-query 延迟的 26–44%,且触发频率越高(为对抗 context rot,Anthropic 建议 5–20k token 即压缩)损耗越大。
作者的核心洞见:异步是唯一能同时消除阻塞延迟并产生独立验证信号的执行模式——异步窗口内候选摘要与 next-k 智能体步骤都从同一份压缩前状态独立生成,因而 next-k 轨迹构成「留出」的校验集。
AI.method:
**执行模型**:触发阈值与同步基线相同;压缩线程与智能体线程共享压缩前上下文与 KV cache 前缀,智能体在原上下文上继续执行形成 next-k 轨迹(compactor 耗时自然决定 k:实测 BrowseComp 平均重叠 2.1 步、SWE-bench 平均 3.7 步)。

**有限窗口的充分性(locality)**:实测压缩错误的首个可见 manifestations 分布高度局部化——BrowseComp 97% 在 k=1、100% 在 k=2 出现;SWE-bench 60% 在 k=1、88% 在 k=3、96% 在 k=6 出现,Slipstream 窗口覆盖约 88%。

**轨迹接地 judge(结构化 JSON 评分,阈值 7/10 接受)**:
- *statement-level / 信息保留检查*(0–10):next-k 轨迹的 reasoning 引用了哪些实体、约束、中间结果、工具观测,这些具体事实是否都在候选摘要中保留(针对 Case A 遗漏、Case C 实体替换);
- *plan-level / 意图对齐检查*(0–10):摘要中标注为 [PENDING]/[OPEN]/未确认的待办项,与 next-k 轨迹的实际推进方向是否一致、是否直击最关键待办(针对 Case B 意图漂移);若窗口内计划被修订,以最新表述为准。
可行性依赖长程智能体会显式表达计划(SWE-bench/GAIA 的粗粒度任务框架 + 短期计划;BrowseComp 的全局清单)。

**采纳与定向更新**:接受则切换到「压缩摘要 + next-k 已完成步骤」的上下文继续执行;拒绝则短暂暂停,用 judge 诊断与未压缩续跑轨迹中的证据做局部定向修补(恢复被漏约束、纠正被改实体、保留最新 patch 意图),不重跑整段压缩;无法局部修复的结构性漂移则回退同步压缩。实测拒绝率低:BrowseComp 1.0–3.5%,SWE-bench 5.4–8.5%。

**系统实现**:长程服务受显存而非算力约束,compactor/judge 可与主智能体共置;agent 线程与压缩线程复用共享前缀 KV cache,配合 multi-layer cascade attention 只加载一次前缀;judge 输入仅候选摘要 + next-k 轨迹(约为压缩前上下文的 3.6–6.8%),开销 <1% 总延迟。
AI.result:
在 Qwen3.5-9B(混合 MoE)与 Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct(稠密 Transformer)上,两个负载、三档压缩阈值下 **Slipstream 在所有 12 组配置中准确率均优于同步基线**:SWE-bench Verified 提升 2.0–8.8%(如 Qwen3.5-9B @6k:22.0%→30.8%;Seed-OSS-36B @4k:29.6%→35.8%),BrowseComp 提升 1.3–4.6%(Qwen3.5-9B @32k:52.7%→57.3%);编码任务收益更大,说明验证对保住 patch 意图、测试解读与仓库观测尤其有效。
延迟方面,压缩被移出关键路径,端到端 per-query 延迟降低 11.3–39.7%,且压缩越频繁(阈值越小)收益越大;judge/update 开销 <1%。
消融(SWE-bench, Qwen3.5-9B)表明:仅异步重叠(Async-only,无条件采纳摘要)能拿到几乎全部延迟收益,但准确率与 Sync 基本持平;准确率增益完全来自轨迹接地的 judge 验证(相对 Sync +6.4~8.8%)。
换用更小、跨家族的 judge(Qwen3.5-2B、Llama-3.2-3B)仍稳定超过 Sync,并大体保留同模型 judge 的收益(如 @6k:31.8% vs 30.8%),说明收益来自验证信号本身而非 judge 的能力强度,便于低成本独立部署。准确率随阈值并非单调(压缩更频繁可缓解 context rot,但也创造更多静默偏离机会),逐次验证使系统对此权衡保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 压缩的忠实性在同步模式下没有 ground truth:压缩器必须预测智能体后续需要什么,而同步执行在「提交」这一预测之前无法检验它。异步执行解决了这一矛盾——压缩器与智能体从同一压缩前输入独立生成摘要与行为,由此产生同步配置无法构造的独立验证信号。Slipstream 据此把压缩转化为「异步 + 轨迹接地验证 + 定向修补」的流水线,在不额外复制智能体执行的前提下同时提升准确率(最高 +8.8pp)与降低延迟(最高 −39.7%)。更一般的启示是:把辅助过程同步放在智能体关键路径上,可能会「预先关闭」只有异步才能提供的验证信号——这一模式值得在压缩之外的场景(如主动压缩、外部记忆检索、工具策略校验)中继续考察。代码已开源(github.com/chenzhuofu/slipstream)。

title: Trustworthiness in Digital Twin Systems: Systematic Review and Research Horizons
summary:
Digital Twins (DTs) are increasingly deployed across application domains, yet the treatment of trust-related issues remains unevenly addressed. To examine whether and how trust is discussed in the current landscape, we conducted a systematic review of existing DT review papers and a mapping of their abstracts. Seven trust-related challenges and seven trust-enhancing strategies were defined to guide the analysis, enabling the trust focus of each paper to be characterised.
  By aggregating the challenges and strategies referenced across domains, distinct patterns of emphasis were observed. With certain domains consistently sharing similar spectrum of trust concerns, four integration types, including human-centred, safety-critical, context-specific, and technologically-driven, were identified as emergent categories reflecting how trust is prioritised in different deployment contexts. Drawing on the characteristics of these types, several preliminary directions for future research were proposed. These include the development of trust-by-design principles to inform early-stage decision-making, the inclusion of trust metadata in platform schemas to prompt systematic developer consideration of trust factors, and the exploration of how architectural choices, such as federated DTs, influence user trust.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统综述现有数字孪生综述文献，梳理了信任相关挑战与增强策略，发现不同应用领域在信任问题上存在明显模式差异，并据此提出了四类整合类型分类框架，同时指出了信任设计、平台元数据及联邦架构等未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生技术已被广泛应用于多个领域，但信任相关问题的处理在现有研究中存在不平衡，亟需梳理当前数字孪生领域中信任议题的讨论现状与模式。
AI.method: 系统综述法：对现有数字孪生综述论文进行系统梳理，对其摘要进行映射分析；定义7个信任相关挑战和7个信任增强策略作为分析框架，据此表征每篇论文的信任关注特征。
AI.result: 跨领域聚合挑战与策略后观察到显著的强调模式差异：特定领域具有一致的信任关注谱系；识别出四类整合类型（人类中心型、安全关键型、场景特定型、技术驱动型）；提出了若干初步的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 基于信任优先级差异提出的四类整合模式（人类中心型、安全关键型、场景特定型、技术驱动型）为数字孪生系统的信任研究提供了分类框架；未来应发展信任设计原则、在平台架构中嵌入信任元数据、探索联邦数字孪生等架构选择对用户信任的影响。

title: Mazocarta: A Seeded Procedural Deckbuilder for Instrumented Game Development
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Code available at https://github.com/timcogan/mazocarta
summary: Mazocarta is a seeded procedural tactical deckbuilder implemented in Rust, compiled to WebAssembly for browser play, and executable natively for simulation. Its primary technical contribution is not the invention of a new deckbuilding genre, but the construction of an instrumented game-development reference artifact: the same rules engine supports interactive play, native command-line simulation, automated end-to-end tests, save/load fixtures, and local-area multiplayer. This paper describes Mazocarta's architecture, deterministic run model, reproducible balance probes, and QR-mediated WebRTC pairing for local multiplayer. An evaluation snapshot over 1,000 deterministic seeds shows that the simulation pipeline can produce reproducible development signals. In the evaluated configuration, single-player and two-player autoplay win rates were 36.1% and 34.9% over 1,000 deterministic seeds, respectively. These rates are not presented as final player-facing balance metrics, but as repeatable probes for future balance shifts and regressions. Mazocarta is positioned as a playable open-source reference artifact for instrumented game development: deterministic regression checks, automated playtesting workflows, balance probes for game mechanics, and browser-native local multiplayer all exercise one shared production rules core.

AI.tldr: Mazocarta是一款基于Rust/WebAssembly的确定性卡牌构建游戏，作为可instrumented游戏开发的参考artifact，支持交互式游戏、命令行模拟、自动化测试和本地多人联机。其核心贡献在于提供可重复使用的平衡测试探针和回归检查框架。
AI.motivation: 当前游戏开发缺乏标准化的instrumented开发框架，导致平衡性测试、重播验证和多人联机功能需要重复开发。现有 deckbuilder 缺乏确定性执行保证，难以进行可重复的平衡探测和自动化测试。
AI.method: 1) 使用Rust实现确定性规则引擎；2) 编译为WebAssembly支持浏览器原生运行；3) 通过QR码介导的WebRTC实现局域网多人配对；4) 构建可复现的平衡探测探针，通过1,000个确定性种子进行评估。
AI.result: 在1,000个确定性种子的评估快照中，单人自动游戏胜率为36.1%，双人自动游戏胜率为34.9%。模拟管道能够产生可复现的开发信号。
AI.conclusion: Mazocarta作为开源参考artifact，将确定性回归检查、自动测试工作流、平衡探测和浏览器原生多人游戏整合到单一生产规则核心中，为instrumented游戏开发提供了可复用的框架。

title: jina-embeddings-v5-omni: Text-Geometry-Preserving Multimodal Embeddings via Frozen-Tower Composition
summary: In this work, we introduce frozen-encoder model composition, a novel approach to multimodal embedding models. We build on the VLM-style architecture, in which non-text encoders are adapted to produce input for a language model, which in turn generates embeddings for all varieties of input. We present the result: the jina-embeddings-v5-omni suite, a pair of models that encode text, image, audio, and video input into a single semantic embedding space. Our method is to extend the two Jina Embeddings v5 Text models to support additional media by adding encoders for images and audio.
