The backbone text embedding models and the added non-text media encoders remain frozen. We only trained the connecting components, representing 0.35% of the total weights of the joint model. Training is therefore much more efficient than full-parameter retraining. Additionally, the language model remains effectively unaltered, producing exactly the same embeddings for text inputs as the Jina Embeddings v5 Text models. Our evaluations show that this approach produces results that are competitive with the state-of-the-art, yielding nearly equal performance to larger multimodal embedding models.

AI.tldr: Introduces frozen-encoder model composition for efficient multimodal embedding, achieving competitive performance by training only 0.35% of weights while keeping backbone models frozen.
AI.motivation: Need for efficient multimodal embedding models that can encode diverse input types (text, image, audio, video) into a unified semantic space without expensive full-parameter retraining.
AI.method: Frozen-encoder model composition: extend existing text embedding models with frozen non-text media encoders (image, audio), training only the connecting components to integrate modalities into a unified embedding space.
AI.result: Jina Embeddings v5 Omni achieves nearly equal performance to larger state-of-the-art multimodal embedding models, and text inputs produce identical embeddings to the original text-only models.
AI.conclusion: The frozen-encoder approach enables efficient multimodal embedding by updating only 0.35% of parameters, while maintaining competitive performance with state-of-the-art larger models and preserving original text embedding quality.

title: Embeddings for Preferences, Not Semantics
summary: Modern AI is opening the door to collective decision-making in which participants express their views as free-form text rather than voting on a fixed set of candidates. A natural idea is to embed these opinions in a vector space so that the substantial literature on facility location problems and fair clustering can be brought to bear. But standard text embeddings measure semantic similarity, whereas distances in facility location problems and fair clustering require what we call \textit{preferential similarity}: a participant's agreement with a piece of text should be inversely related to their distance from it. Off-the-shelf embeddings inherit a coarse preference signal through a correlation between semantic and preferential similarity, but fail to capture preferences when the correlation breaks. We formalize this as an invariance problem: text embedding models encode both a preference-relevant signal (stance and values) and semantic nuisance (style and wording), and the two are observationally correlated, so a geometry that relies on nuisance can appear preference-correct even when it is not. We show that synthetic training data designed to break this correlation provably shifts the optimal scorer away from nuisance-dominated cosine and significantly improves preference prediction across 11 online deliberation datasets.

AI.tldr: 面向"自由文本集体决策"的嵌入表示论文：指出通用文本嵌入度量的是语义相似度而非"偏好相似度"（preferential similarity），其在自然审议数据上表现出的偏好信号其实主要来自"偏好与措辞/风格耦合"的混淆；作者提出形式化的不变性诊断（把余弦边际分解为偏好分量 Δ_S 与语义冗余分量 Δ_T）、硬三元组（hard triplet）合成与去相关偏好调优（DPT，LoRA + Bradley-Terry），并证明在硬三元组分布下降低冗余权重严格降低 BT 风险；DPT 将 ST5-XL 的硬三元组准确率从 48.3% 提升到 80.0%、自然数据从 65.2% 提升到 68.6%，而基于每话题投票学习的秩-20 低秩投影在冻结嵌入上可达 77.6%（自然）/81.1%（硬），两者叠加可达 78.0%/87.4%，并在 11 个在线审议数据集上显著优于 25 个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 越来越多集体决策系统（Polis、Remesh、生成式社会选择 GSC）允许参与者用自由文本表达观点而非在固定候选项上投票，因此需要把文本嵌入到向量空间，以便复用设施选址（facility location）、公平聚类、k-median/k-center/比例公平等几何聚合文献。但通用文本嵌入是在检索、文本相似度、NLI 等语义任务上训练的，其距离度量的是"语义相似度"，而下游几何聚合要求的是"偏好相似度"：参与者对某文本的认同度应与其到该文本的距离成反比。二者在自然数据上高度相关（立场相同者往往措辞相似），因而以语义特征为主的嵌入"看起来"是偏好正确的；一旦相关被打破，嵌入即失效。作者的核心问题是：通用句子嵌入空间中的距离是否真的反映偏好相似度？若不是，能否重新对齐？
AI.method: 【理论框架】设编码器 ψ 输出单位范数向量，偏好子空间 S 承载立场/价值结构，S⊥ 为语义冗余（风格、措辞）；参与者理想点 u_v = ψ_S(a_v)，效用定义为 S 内负平方欧氏距离，排序由 Bradley-Terry 刻画。展开后边际 = 2Δ_S + Δ_norm（双线性项 + 物品范数二次项）；而余弦边际可加性分解为 Δ_S + Δ_T（等权重），既丢失 Δ_norm 又引入无效用对应的冗余项 Δ_T。【诊断】(1) 近似带（proximity bands）：按余弦相似度五分位统计支持率，四种编码器均单调上升（跨度约 15–20 个百分点），但无法区分是偏好项还是冗余项在起作用；(2) 硬三元组：875 个用 GPT-4o 改写的真实参与者锚点三元组（偏好匹配=同立场不同措辞；语义干扰=同措辞反立场），余弦全线崩塌至接近随机（ST5-XL 48.3%、e5 26.7%、BGE 6.3%、mpnet 8.2%，而自然数据为 58–65%），证明自然数据上的偏好信号几乎全部来自冗余。【方法一：DPT】合成反事实训练三元组（从 Habermas Machine 与 Kialo 的 2,000 个议题池，GPT-4o-mini 过滤可辩性、Claude Sonnet 4 生成 5 档立场意见、GPT-4o 改写为硬三元组），用 LoRA(r=16, α=48) 微调，损失为 Bradley-Terry 的余弦差；不训到收敛以避免冗余权重变负。Theorem 1：在硬三元组条件 E[Δ_T|G]≤0 下，对任意 λ∈[0,1)，BT 风险 R(B,λ) < R(B,1)，即降低冗余权重严格改善；证明用凸性 + R'(B,0)>0 的塔式性质推导。【方法二：每话题投影】在冻结 ST5-XL 上学习秩-20 线性映射 Lᵀ，用映射后空间的负平方距离作效用（理想点模型），并做结构消融（去线性化、去绑定投影、改为内积），以及秩扫描（1→100，r=20 平台）与数据效率扫描（~50 个标注三元组即可超过通用 DPT）。评测为三元组准确率（margin>0），另做 Remesh 用户聚类一致性、GSC Likert 相关性、LLM 误差归因等补充实验。
AI.result: 【核心结果】DPT 后 ST5-XL：硬三元组 48.3%→80.0%（+31.7pp），自然数据 65.2%→68.6%（+3.4pp）；e5 +51.9pp、BGE +26.5pp、mpnet +19.2pp（硬）。显著性：11 数据集 442 名测试参与者合并，配对 Wilcoxon p=3.4×10⁻⁹，配对 t 检验 p=1.8×10⁻⁸，三元组级 McNemar p=9.5×10⁻²¹⁸，10/11 数据集 McNemar 显著（唯一例外为 GSC Chatbot，+0.4pp）。25 模型对比中 DPT-ST5-XL 平均 68.6% 最高，11 个数据集中 8 个第一，其余模型无一在超过 1 个数据集上最优。每话题秩-20 投影：自然 77.6%（r=20 达峰，r=1 仅 70.1%）、硬 81.1%（未见过硬数据）；叠加在 DPT 编码器上自然 78.0%、硬 87.4%，硬集上 10/11 数据集提升，内积边际放大 1.1–5.9 倍。消融：LoRA r=16 最优（r=64 降至 63.8%）；InfoNCE 与 BT 几乎相同（68.6 vs 68.7），说明增益来自三元组构造而非损失形式；"正常相关"三元组训练仅 67.0%/59.3%，远逊于硬三元组，验证了打破相关性的必要性。附加：Remesh 用户聚类组内-组外支持率提升 base 5.6%→tuned 6.7%（+1.11pp，p=0.016）；GSC Likert Spearman 相关 base 0.254–0.436 → tuned 0.385–0.614，投影 0.331–0.721。误差归因（913 例）：61% 仍为表面相似度，20.5% 为锚点信号不足（Polis 短评论中 Bowling Green 占 73%，GSC 仅 6%），16.9% 为细微价值差异。
AI.conclusion: 论文的结论是：通用文本嵌入的"偏好感知"外观是语义与偏好在自然数据上耦合所产生的伪相关，而非真正的偏好几何；一旦把这种耦合作为训练信号（硬三元组）人为打破，嵌入可被"重对齐"为偏好不变、语义冗余不变的几何，且 Bradley-Terry 风险单调受益于降低冗余权重。方法上，DPT 提供一种与话题无关、可迁移的通用调优；每话题低秩投影提供数据高效（~50 标注对）的话题特定读出，且证明冻结的通用编码器已线性可分地含有偏好子空间（秩≈20），这也解释了 DPT 的样本高效性。作者同时给出两个方法互补而非冗余的机制解释：DPT 抑制全局冗余方向，投影提取话题特定偏好子空间，叠加后在内积边际上获得更强信号；并指出"在自然数据上做验证集选择"在分布偏移下会把与偏好相关但实为冗余的方向拉进投影，损害硬三元组表现。最后，作者强调局限：评测只覆盖参与者内部排序而非绝对距离校准；偏好本身是经验性、不完美的表征，只应用于观点梳理与多样性呈现，不应作为约束性决策的依据；未来方向是生成以目标话题为条件的硬三元组以免依赖逐话题投票，并处理"锚点信号不足"这一编码器无法解决的上游问题（需引导参与者更充分表达）。

title: A Scalable and Unified Framework to Weighted Rank Aggregation
summary: The rank aggregation problem seeks to combine multiple rank orderings of the same set of candidates into a single consensus ordering. Such problems arise in diverse domains, including web search, employment, college admissions, and voting. In this work we focus on the 1-median objective: given a set of m rankings over [n], the goal is to compute a ranking that minimizes the sum of its distances to all input rankings. We study rank aggregation under several classical distance metrics: Ulam distance, Spearman's footrule, Hamming distance, and Kendall-tau, as well as their weighted variants. Our contributions begin with a novel unified framework that identifies a key structural property: it suffices to focus on a small subset of rankings, where the corresponding local one-median provides a good approximation to the global median. This principle extends across these distance measures, yielding a general algorithmic framework for weighted rank aggregation. Building on this, we present a new approximation algorithm for rank aggregation under the Ulam distance that scales in the Massively Parallel Computation (MPC) model. Our algorithm computes a $(2-α)$-approximation, for a constant $α>0$, to the 1-median in a constant number of rounds, using local memory sublinear in n and total memory near-linear in n. We further design new MPC approximation algorithms for Spearman's footrule and for the element-weighted variants of Hamming and Kendall-tau distances. For each metric, we obtain a $(2-ζ)$-approximation, for a constant $ζ>0$, to the 1-median in a constant number of rounds, using local memory sublinear in n and total memory linear or near-linear in n. Moreover, for the Ulam distance, we simplify and strengthen the analysis of Chakraborty et al., obtaining an improved 1.968-approximation that further extends to the weighted setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的“局部-全局中位数”框架：只需在常数个（3 个或 5 个）输入排序的子集上求解局部 1-median，即可获得全局 1-median 的 (2-α) 近似。基于该框架，作者给出首个可在 MPC 模型下运行的 Ulam 距离秩聚合近似算法（O(1) 轮、单机内存 Õ(n^{1−ε})、总内存 Õ(n^{1+6ε})、逼近比 2−α，α=0.000007），并为 Spearman footrule 与元素加权的 Hamming、Kendall-tau 距离设计了首个突破 2-因子障碍的并行近似算法（分别 1.75 与 1.9），同时简化并改进了 Chakraborty 等人对 Ulam 距离的分析，将 1.999 改进为 1.968，并首次扩展到加权 Ulam。
AI.motivation: 秩聚合（rank aggregation）需将同一候选集合的 m 个排序合并为一个共识排序，广泛用于网页搜索、选举、录取、投票等。1-median 目标（最小化到所有输入排序距离之和）在 Kendall-tau 与 Ulam 距离下是 NP-硬问题，经典做法仅能得到三角不等式导出的平凡 2-近似（Kendall-tau 有 PTAS，Ulam 有 1.999-近似）。同时现实场景的三个瓶颈尚未解决：(1) 元素重要性不同，传统度量对所有错误一视同仁，需要元素加权版本；(2) 数据规模巨大（排序数 m 大、单个排序长度 n 更大），单台机器甚至无法存下一条排序；(3) 现有可扩展算法无法直接放到 MPC（大规模并行计算）模型中——基于最小费用匹配的 Hamming/footrule 算法在常数轮、亚线性单机内存下无法实现。已有的基于小子集构造局部解的方案（Chakraborty–Das–Krauthgamer, ITCS 2023）依赖 Ulam 距离特有的组合性质，且其“去环”步骤在分布式环境下失效（三角环可能不落在同一台机器上，且需保证被删环顶点互不相交）。因此需要一个跨度量通用、且能扩展到分布式环境的框架。
AI.method: 1) 统一框架（第2节）：引入度量空间中的“三角不等式松弛量”Δ_{i,j}(x)=dist(x,p_i)+dist(x,p_j)−dist(p_i,p_j)（Gromov 积的两倍）与子集上的总松弛 Δ(x,Q)。性质1（普适，Lemma 2.1）：若 P 中至多 δm 个点达到 (2−α)OPT，则随机 r 元子集 Q 满足 E[Δ*]≤C(r,2)(α+2δ)OPT（由成对距离求和与三角不等式的平均值论证）。性质2（度量特定）：存在常数 r 与算法，使 dist(x*,y)≤C·Δ*。结合二者得通用算法 Algorithm 1：采样 O(log n/δ) 个候选与 O(log n/δ²) 个评估排序，用 Indyk 采样选出最小代价者，保证 (2−1/(C·C(r,2)+1)+O(δ))-近似。2) Ulam 距离的可扩展局部算法 ScalableMedianReconstruct（第3–4节）：将最优中位数 y* 切成 n^ε 个长度 κ=n^{1−ε} 的块；Step1 窗口分解（几何级数偏移的窗口，长度按 large/small/medium 分类，选择性分组策略把 |W| 压到 O(n^{7ε}log^8 n)）；Step2 块重建（仅保留出现在 ≥4 个子串中的元素建锦标赛图，剪去无边顶点对、逐个删除三角形后取拓扑序，缺失用哑元 * 补齐至 κ）；Step3 动态规划组合块（目标 BlockED，状态数仅 n^ε）；Step4 后处理（截断至长度 n，按升序用未使用元素按序填充哑元位置）。分析给出 Lemma 4.1：Σ ID(y_offline,π_i) ≤ 1.000225 Σ ID(y*,π_i)+66Δ(x*)，并推出 Lemma 3.1：ID(y_offline,x*) ≤ 0.0009 Σ ID(x*,π_i)+266Δ(x*)。3) 加权局部解（第5节）：加权 Hamming 用逐位多数（Algorithm 4，Lemma 5.3 给出 C=1）；Spearman footrule 用逐位中位数再经 Day 重排不等式转为合法排列（Algorithm 5，Lemma 5.5，C=1）；加权 Kendall-tau 用多数图 + 权重 (w(a)+w(b))/2 满足三角不等式，KWIK-SORT 解反馈弧集（Lemma 5.6，C=3）；加权 Ulam 用 5 元子集、锦标赛图的 2-近似反馈顶点集（Lokshtanov 等，O(n^17)），并证明 Lemma 5.7：dist^w_U(x,y)≤Δ(x)+Δ(y)（C=3）。4) MPC 实现（第6节）：元素按 n^ε 个区间 Σ_i 分片存放；Ulam 分四阶段（并行块重建 → 单机 DP（仅需摘要信息）→ 回溯 → 广播树+秩匹配的后处理）；Hamming/footrule 用秩配对填充未分配位置；Kendall-tau 隐式存边并把枢轴数从 n^{1/2} 降到 n^{1−ε}（因分区规模有界，仍为常数轮）；距离计算中 Hamming/footrule 精确 O(1) 轮 O(n) 空间，Kendall-tau 需 O(n^{1+ε}) 空间，Ulam 用 (1+λ)-近似编辑距离算法（空间 O(n^{1+ε})）。
AI.result: 定理1.1（Ulam，MPC）：对任意 δ>0、ε∈(0,1/8)，存在多项式时间 MPC 算法以高概率给出 1-median 的 (2−α+O(δ))-近似，α=0.000007，O(1) 通信轮，总空间 Õ(n^{1+6ε})，单机内存 Õ(n^{1−ε})；这是 MPC 模型下首个突破 2-因子的 Ulam 秩聚合算法。定理1.2：Spearman footrule 与元素加权 Hamming 得到 (1.75+O(δ))-近似，O(1) 轮，Õ(n^ε) 台机器、单机 O(n^{1−ε}) 内存；元素加权 Kendall-tau 得到 (1.9+O(δ))-近似，O(1) 轮，Õ(n^{2ε}) 台机器。定理1.3 与 Theorem 5.1：简化并强化 Chakraborty 等 (ITCS 2023) 的分析，把 Ulam 距离的近似比从 1.999 改进到 1.968，并首次扩展到元素加权 Ulam（1.9677+O(δ)，时间 O(n^17)）。局部解的 MPC 实现（Lemma 6.1–6.4）分别用 O(n^{7ε}log^8 n) 台机器（Ulam）、Õ(n)（Hamming/footrule/Kendall-tau）完成。算法总运行时间为 Õ(t_ℓ(n)+t(n))。作者指出该框架不限于排列，可望推广到中位字符串的编辑距离、曲线平均问题的 Fréchet 距离与 DTW 等度量。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献是把“局部子集即可近似全局中位数”这一结构性事实提炼为跨度量通用的统一框架，以三角不等式松弛量（Δ、总松弛）作为统一分析工具，从而在同一套框架下同时处理 Ulam、Spearman footrule、Hamming、Kendall-tau 及其元素加权版本；并证明该框架对分布式计算足够鲁棒，从而给出首个可扩展的 MPC 秩聚合近似算法族，突破 2-因子障碍（Ulam: 2−α；footrule/加权 Hamming: 1.75；加权 Kendall-tau: 1.9），同时把 Ulam 的既有离线结果改进到 1.968 并推广至加权情形。其局限与待改进点包括：Ulam 的 MPC 实现要求 ε<1/8（受 O(n^{7ε}log^9 n) 汇总信息约束）；常数 α=0.000007 与 1.75/1.9 等比值均未优化，作者明确指出仍有改进空间；加权 Ulam 的反馈顶点集算法时间为 O(n^17)，规模较大。框架的普适性还暗示可向编辑距离、Fréchet/DTW 等其他度量空间的 1-median 推广。

title: LLM Agents Enable User-Governed Personalization Beyond Platform Boundaries
summary: Personalization today is fundamentally platform-centric: services build user representations from the behavioral fragments they observe. Yet no platform can construct a complete picture of the user, as competitive incentives, legal constraints, user privacy concerns, and epistemic limits create persistent data barriers. This paper argues for a shift from platform-centric personalization to user-governed personalization, where only the user can integrate fragmented contexts across platforms and the offline world. The key asymmetry lies in data access: only users can aggregate their own cross-platform and offline information. Large language model (LLM) agents make such integration practically feasible for the first time by enabling reasoning over heterogeneous personal data and transforming users' cross-context information into actionable personalization capabilities. We provide proof-of-concept evidence that users equipped with cross-platform data exports and an off-the-shelf LLM agent can outperform single-platform personalization baselines. We conclude by outlining a research agenda for building scalable user-governed personalization systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将个性化范式从平台中心化转向用户主导模式，利用LLM智能体帮助用户整合碎片化的跨平台和线下信息，实现更完整的用户理解。概念验证表明该方案可行且性能优于传统单平台方法，同时论文勾勒了构建可扩展用户主导个性化系统的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 当前个性化服务以平台为中心，但各平台因竞争激励、法律约束、用户隐私顾虑和认知局限等因素形成数据壁垒，导致无法构建完整的用户画像。这一根本性限制阻碍了个性化服务质量的进一步提升。
AI.method: 研究者通过概念验证实验，使用跨平台数据导出和现成LLM智能体构建用户主导的个性化系统，并将其与单平台个性化基线方法进行性能对比。
AI.result: 实验证据表明，具备跨平台数据导出能力和LLM智能体的用户，能够在个性化任务上超越单平台个性化基线方法的性能。
AI.conclusion:
该研究提出了从平台中心化个性化向用户主导个性化范式转变的论点和研究议程，通过概念验证展示了LLM智能体在跨平台数据整合中的可行性，同时为构建可扩展的用户主导个性化系统指明了未来研究方向。

该方向的核心贡献在于：提出了利用LLM智能体赋予用户跨平台信息整合能力的新范式，有望突破传统平台中心化个性化面临的数据壁垒与隐私困境，为个性化服务提供一种以用户为中心的替代路径。

title: SPECTRE: Hybrid Ordinary-Parallel Speculative Serving for Resource-Efficient LLM Inference
summary: LLM serving platforms are increasingly deployed as multi-model cloud systems, where user demand is often long-tailed: a few popular large models receive most requests, while many smaller tail models remain underutilized. We propose \textbf{SPECTRE} (Parallel \textbf{SPEC}ulative Decoding with a Multi-\textbf{T}enant \textbf{RE}mote Drafter), a serving framework that reuses underutilized tail-model services as remote drafters for heavily loaded large-model services through speculative decoding. SPECTRE enables draft generation and target-side verification to run in parallel, and makes such parallelism effective through three techniques: a hybrid ordinary-parallel speculative decoding strategy guided by a threshold derived from throughput analysis, speculative priority scheduling to preserve draft--target overlap under multi-tenant traffic, and draft-side prompt compression to reduce draft latency. We implement SPECTRE in \texttt{SGLang} and evaluate it across multiple draft--target model pairs, reasoning benchmarks, real-world long-context workloads, and a wide range of batch sizes. Results show that SPECTRE consistently improves large-model serving throughput while causing only minor interference to the native workloads of tail-model services. In large-model deployments, including Qwen3-235B-A22B with TP=8, SPECTRE achieves up to \textbf{2.28$\times$ speedup} over autoregressive decoding and up to an additional \textbf{66\% relative improvement} over the strongest speculative decoding baselines. Talk is cheap, we show you the code: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/22272.

AI.tldr: SPECTRE 是一个 LLM 服务框架，通过将未充分利用的尾模型作为远程drafter来服务热门大型模型，采用并行推测解码技术提升吞吐量。该框架在 SGLang 中实现，在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 等模型上实现最高 2.28× 加速。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务平台部署为多模型云系统，用户需求呈长尾分布：少量大型热门模型接收大部分请求，而众多小型尾模型服务处于未充分利用状态。
AI.method: SPECTRE 采用三项核心技术：(1) 基于吞吐量阈值推导的混合普通-并行推测解码策略；(2) 推测优先级调度，在多租户流量下保持draft-target重叠；(3) draft侧提示压缩以降低drafter延迟。
AI.result: 在大型模型部署中（包括 TP=8 的 Qwen3-235B-A22B），SPECTRE 相比自回归解码实现最高 2.28×加速，相比最强基线实现额外 66% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: SPECTRE 在 SGLang 中实现并通过多种实验验证了其有效性，同时对尾模型服务的原生工作负载造成极小干扰。

title: ScaleGANN: Accelerate Large-Scale ANN Indexing by Cost-effective Cloud GPUs
summary:
Graph-based ANNS algorithms have gained increasing research interest and market adoption due to their efficiency and accuracy in retrieval. Existing approaches primarily rely on CPUs for graph index construction and retrieval, but this often requires significant time, especially for large-scale and high-dimensional datasets. Some studies have explored GPU-based solutions. However, GPUs are costly and their limited memory makes handling large datasets challenging.
  In this paper, we propose a novel end-to-end system ScaleGANN that enables users to efficiently construct graph indexes for large-scale, high-dimensional datasets by leveraging low-cost spot GPU resources in a distributed cloud system. ScaleGANN utilized the idea of divide-and-merge, with an optimized vector partitioning algorithm to further improve the indexing time and space efficiency while guaranteeing good index quality. Its novel resource allocation strategy realized multi-GPU indexing parallelism and overall cost-effectiveness for both build and query. Besides, we designed a task scheduler and cost model for better spot instance management and evaluation.
  We tested our system on large real-world datasets. Experiment results show that our approach can significantly accelerate the index build time to up to 9x times at even 6x lower price compared with the state-of-the-art extendable ANNS benchmark DiskANN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScaleGANN，一个利用低成本spot GPU资源在分布式云系统中为大规模、高维数据集构建图索引的端到端系统。通过分而治之策略、优化向量分区算法、多GPU并行索引和成本模型，实现比DiskANN快9倍、便宜6倍的索引构建。
AI.motivation: 现有图索引算法主要依赖CPU，耗时严重；现有GPU方案成本高且内存有限，难以处理大规模数据集。
AI.method: 1) 分而治之(Divide-and-merge)架构；2) 优化向量分区算法提升时间和空间效率；3) 新型资源分配策略实现多GPU并行索引；4) 任务调度器和成本模型优化spot实例管理。
AI.result: 实验表明，ScaleGANN相比当前最优的DiskANN基准，索引构建速度提升最高9倍，成本降低6倍。
AI.conclusion: ScaleGANN通过结合云计算资源与算法优化，成功实现了大规模图索引的高效、低成本构建，为ANNS系统提供了可扩展的工程解决方案。

title: Modeling Decision-Making with Will for Cooperation in Social Dilemmas
summary: Standard rational actor models often attribute cooperation failures in social dilemmas to insufficient incentives, overlooking the destabilizing effects of continuous utility maximization. To address this, we propose a framework of ``will" defined as a mechanism that persistently pursues goals while ignoring local cost-benefit fluctuations. We formalize the Willed Agents as potential minimizers, distinguishing them from cumulative utility maximization. Dynamical analysis of infinite population demonstrates that willed agents shrink the feasible state space, acting as boundary constraints that accelerate convergence in canonical social dilemmas. Through multi-agent simulations in a spatiotemporal Stag Hunt Game, we show that willed agents function as ``cooperation catalysts", enabling groups to surmount high-risk thresholds where purely utility maximization fails. We find that heterogeneous will strength promotes cooperation, and that agents who autonomously suspend rational re-evaluation can significantly outperform continuous optimizers. These findings suggest that successful cooperation relies on the cognitive capacity to strategically constrain calculation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"意志"框架，将"意志主体"形式化为势能最小化者，区别于累积效用最大化。通过动力学分析和多智能体模拟，证明了意志主体在社会困境中能收缩可行状态空间，作为边界约束加速收敛，使群体克服高风险合作阈值。研究发现异质性意志强度促进合作，自主暂停理性重评估的智能体显著优于持续优化者，表明成功合作依赖于策略性地约束计算行为的认知能力。
AI.motivation: Standard rational actor models attribute cooperation failures to insufficient incentives, but this view overlooks the destabilizing effects of continuous utility maximization in social dilemmas.
AI.method: The authors formalize "Willed Agents" as potential minimizers (distinct from cumulative utility maximization), analyze their dynamical properties in infinite populations, and conduct multi-agent simulations in a spatiotemporal Stag Hunt Game to test their framework.
AI.result: Willed agents shrink the feasible state space, acting as boundary constraints that accelerate convergence in social dilemmas. In the Stag Hunt Game, willed agents enable groups to overcome high-risk thresholds where pure utility maximization fails. Heterogeneous will strength promotes cooperation, and agents who autonomously suspend rational re-evaluation significantly outperform continuous optimizers.
AI.conclusion: Willed agents, by acting as cognitive boundary constraints that limit continuous utility maximization, enable groups to overcome cooperation failures in high-risk social dilemmas. Heterogeneous will strength further promotes cooperation, suggesting that the strategic suspension of rational calculation is a key capacity for successful collective action.

title: Teachers' Perceived Benefits and Risks of AI Across Fifty-Five Countries: An Audit of LLM Alignment and Steerability
comment: Accepted as full paper to the 13th ACM Conference on Learning @ Scale (L@S'26)
summary: Teachers' trust in artificial intelligence (AI) in education depends on how they balance its perceived benefits and risks. Yet global discussions about scaling AI in education rely on fragmented evidence, as most studies of teachers' perceptions focus on single countries or small samples. This lack of representative cross-national evidence limits both theory building and policy development. At the same time, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in research, policy, and teachers' professional workflows, despite limited validation in education. To address these gaps, we conduct a large-scale audit of LLM alignment with teachers' perceptions of AI by combining representative international survey data with systematic model evaluation. Using OECD TALIS data from 55 countries and territories, we measure cross-national variation in teachers' perceived benefits and risks of AI. We then benchmark responses from eight state-of-the-art LLMs across four providers under both general and country-specific prompting, comparing higher- and lower-reasoning models. Results reveal substantial cross-national variation in teacher perceptions that is not reliably reflected in LLM outputs. Models compress country differences, overestimate both benefits and risks, and show limited gains from identity prompting or enhanced reasoning. This misalignment matters because LLM-generated guidance and professional discourse increasingly shape how teachers learn about and discuss AI, potentially influencing trust and future adoption decisions. Our findings caution against treating LLM outputs as substitutes for direct engagement with teachers when informing global AI-in-education initiatives. At the same time, some models (e.g., Gemini 3 Fast) partially capture cross-national ranking patterns, suggesting a complementary role in hypothesis generation and exploratory comparative analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究对55个国家和地区的教师AI感知进行调查，并评估8个主流LLM与教师实际观点的一致性。研究发现LLM输出无法可靠反映教师感知的跨国差异，高估了AI的收益与风险，且身份提示和增强推理的效果有限。
AI.motivation: 全球AI教育政策讨论缺乏代表性的跨国证据；LLM虽被广泛用于研究和教师专业实践，但其在教育领域的表现尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 使用OECD TALIS数据（55个国家和地区）测量教师对AI收益与风险的跨国感知差异；对8个SOTA LLM进行系统评估，比较通用提示与国家特定提示、普通推理与增强推理模型的表现。
AI.result: LLM无法可靠反映教师感知的跨国差异；模型压缩了国家间差异，高估了收益与风险；身份提示和增强推理带来的改善有限；但部分模型（如Gemini 3 Fast）能部分捕捉跨国排名模式。
AI.conclusion: 不建议将LLM作为 informing 全球AI教育政策的教师感知替代来源；LLM可作为假说生成和探索性比较分析的辅助工具。

title: What Software Engineering Looks Like to AI Agents? -- An Empirical Study of AI-Only Technical Discourse on MoltBook
summary: AI agents are increasingly framed as software-engineering teammates, yet most research studies them inside human-centered workflows. Little is known about the software-engineering discourse autonomous AI agents produce when they interact primarily with one another. This paper examines what autonomous AI agents discuss in MoltBook, an AI-agents-only social network, how that discourse is organized, and how it differs from human developer discourse. We combine human open coding of a 500-post sample, a concentration-plus-check topic-analysis pipeline over 4,707 English-filtered MoltBook technology posts, and a matched-instrument comparison against 5,211 GitHub Discussions posts. MoltBook technology discourse spans 12 recurring themes and is led by Security and Trust (27.4%). At the community level, activity is highly concentrated: the largest submolt contains 63.5% of posts and the Gini coefficient is 0.88, yet a stability-aware BERTopic pipeline still yields 32 non-outlier sub-topics. Compared with the GitHub Discussions baseline, MoltBook discourse contains fewer concrete, context-rich cues such as code-formatted artifacts, environment details, runtime failures, and reproduction steps; social mimicry appears only in a limited way, while idealization is mainly reflected through lower hedging. Overall, AI-only technical discourse is coherent but selective. It repeatedly returns to concerns such as security and trust, memory and context management, tooling and APIs, debugging and error handling, workflow automation, and infrastructure/ops, while omitting much of the concrete runtime and project-local detail common in human developer discourse. This may be because MoltBook contains fewer environment-specific failures, reproduction steps, and other concrete grounding cues.

AI.tldr: 本文以纯 AI 代理社交网络 MoltBook 为研究对象，回答“当 AI 智能体彼此交谈时，软件工程呈现出什么面貌”。方法上，作者用人类开放式编码（500帖→738个开放码→12主题分类法）刻画 AI 代理谈论的技术内容，用“集中度+保守校验”的 BERTopic 流程分析 4,707 条英文技术帖在 354 个 submolt 中的组织结构，并用同一套编码仪器与 5,211 条人类 GitHub Discussions 做匹配对比。结果：AI-only 技术话语连贯但“有选择性”——Security and Trust 占 27.4%、Self-Modder 行为取景占 49.6%；活动高度集中（general 占 63.5%，Gini=0.884）却仍分化为 32 个非离群主题，但保守校验后仅存 1 个 submolt–主题特化信号（bug-hunters × API Authentication Issues）；与人类相比，MoltBook 话语显著缺少代码块、环境/版本信息、错误状态与复现步骤（调试主题中代码块 11.6% vs 48.0%，环境标记 18.9% vs 62.3%）。作者强调这是关于“话语形式”的证据，而非对端到端工程能力的度量。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体正日益被定位为“软件工程队友”，但现有研究几乎都在以人为中心的工作流中考察它们——人类负责提示、检视、纠错并持续提供项目上下文、运行时细节与判断。即便是针对 AI 生成制品（PR、issue、Q&A）的研究，比较基准仍是由人类需求与社区规范塑造的话语。因此一个更具体的经验问题悬而未决：当 AI 代理主要与彼此互动时，软件工程的哪些面向变得“凸显”（salient）？作者以“技术话语”（technical discourse）指称与软件工程相关的对话，涵盖架构决策、调试、安全、API、部署、工具与工作流建议。MoltBook 提供了一个罕见的观测窗口：它是一个类 Reddit 的“仅 AI 代理”社交网络，LLM 代理自发发帖、互相回复并按主题聚集到 submolt；其公开快照包含帖子文本、时间戳与 submolt 归属，既可观察代理谈论什么，也可观察讨论如何分布在平台原生社区中。这使研究能够超越“AI 能否写出貌似合理的文本”，进而考察：在缺乏人类现场锚定（grounding）时，AI 社区会系统性放大工程实践的哪些部分、遗漏哪些部分。作者同时声明：本文研究对象是话语形式与情境性，而非直接测量工程能力。
AI.method:
研究为描述性—比较性、横截面设计，含三个递进的研究问题（内容 → 组织 → 外部比较）与两条数据支线。MoltBook 支线：基于 Hugging Face 公开快照（最后更新 2026-02-04，共 44,376 帖），保留 “B: Technology” 得 5,237 帖，经 NFC 规范化、空字节清除、行尾标准化、构造 full_text、MD5 去重后得 4,968 帖（RQ1 与 RQ3 的 AI 侧语料）；RQ2 另用 langdetect（seed 42，<20 字符记为 unknown）剔除非英语得 4,707 帖，涵盖 354 个 submolt，时间跨度仅 3.04 天（2026-01-28 至 01-31）。GitHub 支线：按仓库挖掘准则（避免便利抽样）策展 35 个仓库（10 Tools、10 APIs & SDKs、8 System Integration、7 AI/LLM 生态；成熟度阈值 7 年 / 1 年，star ≥30,000，discussions ≥500），经 GraphQL API 冻结于 2026-03-22 收集每仓至多 150 条非公告讨论得 5,250 条，清理后 5,211 条。

方法细节：RQ1 由两位作者对同一 500 帖盲化样本独立开放编码（仅对齐格式与任务），产出 738 个开放码；随后用固定模型 gpt-oss-120b（temperature 0，最多 3 次重试，保留原始输出审计）作为“组织辅助”聚类为 12 个主题，再由研究者人工合并、细化为含正式定义的 12 主题分类法（表 2：A 安全与信任、B 架构与设计模式、C 记忆管理与上下文、D 调试/测试/错误处理、E 工作流自动化、F 工具/API/集成、G 基础设施/部署/运维、H 社区互动与治理、I 代理自述与介绍、J 知识分享与教育、K 性能与成本优化、L 合规/审计/供应链安全）；同一固定模型随后对每帖给出唯一主主题标签（平局取最突出主题，输出 cluster_id 与简短理由），并用“接受/拒绝+纠正”协议做 100 帖复核（接受 88/100；重叠 50 帖一致率 88.0%，Cohen’s κ=0.865，Gwet’s AC1=0.859）。行为取景沿用 Amin 等的 PEP 框架并新增中性 “None” 类，复核接受 98/100，一致率 94.0%，κ=0.913。RQ1 另用探索性卡方检验主题×原型关联（χ²=141.04, df=55, p<0.001, Cramér’s V=0.238）。

RQ2 分三层证据：①活动集中度——帖子数分布、Gini 系数、香农熵与保守重尾诊断（离散幂律拟合与对数正态的似然比比较）；②主题结构——在冻结的 UMAP×HDBSCAN 跨种子网格（seeds 42/52/62）中按主题连贯性、多样性、分配稳定性（ARI）、top-words 稳定性（Jaccard）、特化稳定性、离群率与主题数可接受性选出配置（MiniLM，min_cluster_size=20，min_samples=10，UMAP neighbors=30），seed-42 规范运行产出 32 个非离群主题、1,761 条离群（37.4%），离群记为 topic_id=-1 而不强塞；主题标签仅作报告别名，由两名评审检查（接受率 84.4%，raw 87.5%，κ=0.526；连贯性 raw 71.9%，κ=0.246）；③submolt–主题特化的窄层推断——先做四类校验（general“沉池”、离群、近重复、短期爆发），再在冻结的 non-general / non-outlier / 主要 submolt / 合格主题语料（447 帖、12 submolt、24 主题、288 单元格、120 非零）上用固定边际蒙特卡洛卡方检验全局依赖，再做单侧 Fisher 精确检验 + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR、500 次 submolt 内 bootstrap 支持度与最终证据筛查（≥10 帖、观测/期望≥1.5、bootstrap≥0.80、排除重复与一日爆发）。

RQ3 为“匹配仪器”跨平台比较：把 RQ1 分类法与提示原封不动迁移到 GitHub（迁移复核接受 88/100；重叠 50 帖一致率 84.0%，κ=0.786），仅在两语料均≥30 帖的主题内比较主题占比、词数、代码格式线索（围栏/缩进/HTML 代码块）、环境与版本标记、错误标记、复现标记、hedging、confidence、提问框架等话语指标；计数型指标用 Mann-Whitney U，二元指标用卡方或 Fisher 精确检验，并对全部主题×指标比较做 BH-FDR 校正；全部指标由冻结的词法与格式规则及固定词典抽取，脚本化仓库筛选与讨论保留规则随复制包公开。
AI.result:
RQ1（内容）：12 个主题中 Security & Trust 占 27.4%，前三主题合计 49.8%；行为取景上 Self-Modder 占 49.6%（多数帖子以可靠性、改进、系统维护来叙述技术），主题与原型显著关联（χ²=141.04, V=0.238），Security 在 6 个原型中的 4 个居首，Degen Trader 集中于 Tooling/APIs，Existentialist 多见于 Memory/Context。代表性帖子显示大量“信任清单”“安装 skill 前审计权限/网络出口/校验和”“3 行 checkpoint 防遗忘”“崩溃按根因聚类”“资源限额与并发/退避”等模板化内容。

RQ2（组织）：354 个 submolt 中 general 独占 2,988 帖（63.5%），前十占 77.4%；Gini=0.884，香农熵=2.370；幂律诊断 α=1.87±0.05，但似然比无法区分幂律与对数正态（R=−1.36, p=0.174），故仅解释为“强集中”而非幂律。BERTopic 规范运行得 32 个非离群主题（均值 34.0、离群率 37.34%、NPMI 0.275、多样性 0.813、ARI 0.752、top-word Jaccard 0.884、特化稳定性 0.889、综合稳定性分 0.668），最大主题为 Agent Memory Architecture(561)、Agent Coordination(227)、API Authentication Issues(206)、Skill Installation Security(203)、Prompt Injection Security(189)。校验层限制结论：general 覆盖全部 32 主题且其内部最大非离群主题仅占 16.7%（归一化熵 0.888），非离群占比 64.1%；离群帖平均长 1,113.7 字符、与非离群（1,105.6）相当，62.5% 在 general；近重复簇 45 个覆盖 143 帖（最大簇 37 帖）；主推断切片仅 2.33 天，120 个非零单元格中 72 个呈事件型、56 个有≥85% 帖子集中于一天。冻结切片上蒙特卡洛卡方仍拒绝独立（χ²=967.12, p_MC=0.0002, V=0.443），但 288 个单元格中 273 个期望频数<5；最终筛查后仅 bug-hunters × API Authentication Issues 存活（12 帖，期望 0.98，O/E=12.27，q=7.26×10⁻¹¹，bootstrap 0.868，最大重复簇占比 0.083，最大一日占比 0.833）；security × Prompt Injection Security 虽 25 帖、q=8.56×10⁻¹⁴、bootstrap=1.000，但 88% 集中于一天，仅作描述性报告。

RQ3（对比）：主题分布差异显著（χ²=2515.21, V=0.499），MoltBook 过表示 Security/Memory/Workflow，GitHub 由 Debugging 与 Tooling 主导。核心差异是“具体锚定线索”缺口：在 Debugging, Testing & Error Handling 中，GitHub 帖中位 156 词 vs MoltBook 105 词，含代码块比例 48.0% vs 11.6%，环境/版本标记 62.3% vs 18.9%；配对示例显示 NocoDB 的 GitHub 报告给出 Windows 11、Node v18.18.2、NocoDB 0.263.8、命令、复现步骤与具体 TypeError，而 MoltBook 的竞态/重复 cron 通知帖主要是经验叙述。GitHub 在 A/B/D/E/F/G/J/K 的代码线索、A/C/D/F/G/L 的环境线索、A/C/D/G 的错误线索、A/C/D 的复现线索上更高；词数方向不一（D 中 GitHub 更高，B/H/J 中 MoltBook 更高）。社交模仿仅在 J（Knowledge Sharing）成立（58.5% vs 47.6%）。理想化为最不稳健模式：二元理想化标记经校正不显著，但 GitHub 在 11 个保留主题中的 10 个 hedging 分布更高。
AI.conclusion: 结论是“AI-only 技术话语连贯但具选择性”。内容上，AI 代理反复回到安全与信任、记忆与上下文管理、工具与 API、调试与错误处理、工作流自动化、基础设施/运维等关切，把软件工程呈现为以保护、维护、集成与运营判断为中心的工作；组织上，这些话语高度集中于少数可见 submolt，却仍在合并语料中分化为 32 个细粒度技术主题，然而在 sink、离群、近重复与爆发式集中等保守校验后，当前证据只支持一个局部特化信号，不足以支撑“广泛的社区知识组织”主张。对比人类基线，MoltBook 话语在整体上更流畅、技术性可读，但显著缺少代码格式化制品、环境与版本细节、显式失败状态与复现步骤，即缺少使工程主张可检验、可复用的具体锚定。作者因此主张：(1) AI-only 社区本身是软件工程研究的有价值经验对象，可揭示 LLM 代理最易复现的工程知识形态；(2) 不应把 AI 话语当作工程实践的透明代理；(3) 实用含义在于信任校准——AI 生成技术话语可用于解释、综合与候选方案构建，但在依赖环境特定调试、版本敏感故障分析与程序性复现的任务上，人类开发者话语仍具不可替代价值，同时可利用 RQ2 的主题结构为检索/解释系统提供相邻主题提示。需注意的边界：语料仅覆盖早期 2026 年初数天的单一快照（横截面而非纵向），分类与编码依赖单一 LLM（gpt-oss-120b）作为评审式判定者（存在模型偏置、判定者同质性与自我偏好风险），方法是混合式主题分析而非完整扎根理论，指标属话语代理而非正确性或质量度量，GitHub 基线为 35 个策展仓库因而外推限于大型以仓库为中心的开源讨论空间，平台可供性（GitHub 天然鼓励 markdown 与缺陷报告结构）可能部分解释具体线索差距，且部分平台现象可能受人类影响，故结论限定为“关于公开可见话语的断言”而非“关于代理认知或自治的断言”。

title: AIPO: : Learning to Reason from Active Interaction
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities, largely stimulated by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, existing RL algorithms face a fundamental limitation: their exploration remains largely constrained by the inherent capability boundary of the policy model. Although recent methods introduce external expert demonstrations to extend this boundary, they typically rely on complete trajectory-level guidance, which is sample-inefficient, information-sparse, and may confine exploration to a static guidance space. Inspired by the potential of multi-agent systems, we propose $\textbf{AIPO}$, an enhanced reinforcement learning framework that improves LLM reasoning through active multi-agent interaction during exploration. Specifically, AIPO enables the policy model to proactively consult three functional collaborative agents, $\textit{Verify Agent}$, $\textit{Knowledge Agent}$, and $\textit{Reasoning Agent}$, when encountering reasoning bottlenecks, thereby receiving fine-grained and targeted guidance to actively expand its capability boundary during training. We further introduce a tailored importance sampling coefficient together with a clipping strategy to mitigate the off-policy bias and gradient vanishing issues that arise when learning from agent-provided feedback. After training, the policy model performs reasoning independently without relying on collaborative agents. Extensive experiments on diverse reasoning benchmarks, including AIME, MATH500, GPQA-Diamond, and LiveCodeBench, show that AIPO consistently improves reasoning performance, generalizes robustly across different policy models and RLVR algorithms, and effectively expands the reasoning capability boundary of the policy model.

AI.tldr: AIPO是一种通过主动多智能体协作来增强LLM推理能力的RL框架，通过三类功能协作智能体在推理瓶颈时提供细粒度指导，并配合重要性采样和裁剪策略解决离策略学习问题，显著提升多种推理任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RL算法中探索行为受限于策略模型本身的能力边界。虽然引入外部专家演示的方法可以扩展这一边界，但完全轨迹级别的引导存在样本效率低、信息稀疏的问题，且探索空间被限制在静态指导范围内。
AI.method: 提出了AIPO框架，一种基于主动多智能体交互的增强强化学习框架。策略模型在遇到推理瓶颈时主动向三类协作智能体（验证智能体、知识智能体、推理智能体）咨询，获取细粒度、针对性的指导；同时引入定制的重要性采样系数和裁剪策略以缓解离策略偏差和梯度消失问题。
AI.result: 在AIME、MATH500、GPQA-Diamond和LiveCodeBench等多样化推理基准测试中，AIPO持续提升推理性能，对不同策略模型和RLVR算法具有强泛化性，并有效扩展了策略模型的能力边界。
AI.conclusion: AIPO通过多智能体协作机制有效扩展了LLM推理能力边界，在AIME、MATH500、GPQA-Diamond和LiveCodeBench等基准测试中一致提升推理性能，且对不同策略模型和RLVR算法具有良好的泛化能力。训练后的策略模型可独立推理，不再依赖协作智能体。

title: On Distinguishing Capability Elicitation from Capability Creation in Post-Training: A Free-Energy Perspective
summary: Debates about large language model post-training often treat supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as imitation and reinforcement learning (RL) as discovery. But this distinction is too coarse. What matters is whether a training procedure increases the probability of behaviors the pretrained model could already produce, or whether it changes what the model can practically reach. We argue that post-training research should distinguish between capability elicitation and capability creation. We make this distinction operational by introducing the notion of accessible support: the set of behaviors that a model can practically produce under finite budgets. Post-training that reweights behaviors within this support is capability elicitation; whereas changing the support itself corresponds to capability creation. We develop this argument through a free-energy view of post-training. SFT and RL can both be seen as reweighting a pretrained reference distribution, only with different external signals. Demonstration signals define low-energy behavior for SFT, and reward signals define low-energy behavior for RL. When the update remains close to the base model, the main effect is local reweighting, not capability creation. Within this framework, the central question is no longer whether post-training is framed as SFT or RL, but whether it reweights behaviors already within reach, or instead expands the model's reachable behavioral space through search, interaction, tool use, or the incorporation of new information.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了大语言模型后训练中监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）的关系，提出不应简单将SFT视为"模仿"、RL视为"发现"。核心贡献是引入"可及支撑集"（accessible support）概念——即模型在有限计算预算下实际可产生行为的集合，并据此区分"能力唤出"（elicitation）与"能力创造"（creation）。作者从自由能视角统一了SFT和RL：两者都是对预训练参考分布的重加权，只是外部信号不同（SFT用演示定义低能行为，RL用奖励定义低能行为）。论文的核心论点是后训练研究应关注的是训练过程是"重加权已有可及行为"还是"扩展可及行为空间"。
AI.motivation: 当前后训练研究存在粗粒度二分法困境：SFT vs RL、模仿 vs 发现。这种分类过于简化，掩盖了两者在能力提升机制上的本质差异，导致研究讨论和实践指导缺乏清晰度。
AI.method: 1）引入"可及支撑集"作为操作性概念，定义模型在有限预算下实际可达的行为集合；2）从自由能原理统一SFT和RL的数学框架，将两者都视为对预训练分布的重加权过程，区别仅在于外部信号类型（演示 vs 奖励）；3）基于此框架提出后训练的新分类维度。
AI.result: 建立了能力唤出与能力创造的区分标准：当更新保持在基础模型附近时，主要效果是局部重加权（能力唤出）；而通过搜索、交互、工具使用或引入新信息来改变支撑集本身，才是能力创造。在该框架下，后训练的核心问题不再是"用SFT还是RL"，而是"是否扩展了模型的行为空间"。
AI.conclusion: 后训练研究的范式转变建议：从关注"SFT vs RL"的技术选择，转向关注训练过程是否扩展了模型的可及行为空间。SFT和RL在本质上都可能是局部重加权操作，能力创造需要通过搜索、交互、工具使用或新信息整合来实现。

title: Dynamic Edge Coloring of Forests
summary:
In the \emph{dynamic edge coloring} problem, one has to maintain a graph of maximum degree $Δ$ with at most $Δ+c$ colors, given updates to the edges of the graph. An important objective is to minimize the \emph{recourse}, which is the number of edges being recolored.
  We study this problem on forests, which is a natural yet nontrivial restriction of the problem. We consider the problem in both \emph{incremental} (edges are only inserted) and \emph{fully dynamic} (edges may be deleted) models. In the deterministic setting, we show that the natural greedy algorithm achieves $O(\frac{1}{c + \sqrtΔ})$ amortized recourse in the incremental model, and this is tight up to tie-breaking. In contrast, in a fully dynamic forest, greedy can be forced to have $Ω(\log_Δn)$ amortized recourse. To partially alleviate this limitation of greedy, we show an optimal non-greedy algorithm with $O(1)$ amortized recourse for \emph{rooted} fully dynamic forests and $c = Δ- 2$. In the randomized setting, we give a natural distribution-maintaining algorithm that achieves $Θ(\frac{1}Δ)$ expected amortized recourse in the incremental model and $Θ(\min \{ \fracΔ{c}, \log_Δ n \})$ expected recourse in the dynamic model. These randomized results are optimal for $c=0$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究森林上的动态边着色（dynamic edge coloring）：在最大度为 Δ 的森林上用 Δ+c 种颜色维护合法着色，以"回溯代价"（recourse，即被重染色的边数）最小化为目标，同时在增量模型与全动态模型下给出确定性（Greedy、ColorfulPath、GreedyShift 等）与随机化（DistMaint）算法及紧的上下界。核心结论：增量模型中 Greedy 的摊还代价为 O(1/(c+√Δ))（在某种 tie-breaking 下紧），随机 DistMaint 达到最优的 Θ(1/Δ) 期望摊还代价；全动态模型中 Greedy 可被强迫至 Ω(log_Δ n)，任意确定性算法至少 Ω(1)，而在有根森林且 2Δ−2 色时非贪心算法 ColorfulPath 达到 O(1)（最优），随机 DistMaint 每次更新期望代价为 Θ(min{Δ/c, log_{κ−1} n})，且 c=0 时与 Ω(log_{Δ−1} n) 下界匹配。
AI.motivation: 动态边着色要求在边插入/删除过程中始终维护最大度 Δ 的图的合法 (Δ+c)-边着色（König 定理保证森林可 Δ-着色），目标是在尽量少用颜色的前提下最小化回溯代价（recourse，被重新着色的旧边数）。此前该问题几乎只在完全动态情形下研究（multi-Vizing chains、Nibbling、Shift Tree 等），且常需 Δ 很大的假设；森林作为最简单的图类，其离线边着色平凡却被忽视，"增量 vs 完全动态"的分离、每更新代价能否与图规模 n 无关等核心问题仍未解决。论文希望以森林为载体，隔离动态性带来的算法困难，为一般图情形提供基准与下界。
AI.method: 聚焦两类最自然的算法族。确定性：(1) Greedy——每次更新后最小化重染色的边集（在不同 tie-breaking 下为一族算法），另研究 GreedyShift/GreedyPath 等仅沿路径平移颜色的变体；(2) 非贪心的 ColorfulPath——在有根森林上沿根向下路径"上移"颜色，并通过"避免双色路径"（使所选颜色与祖父边颜色不同）保证可停。随机化：DistMaint 维护一个分布不变式——着色始终服从"自顶向下"的分布 𝒟(F)（每个顶点为子边均匀选取可用颜色），该分布等价于所有合法 κ-着色的均匀分布；插入时沿路径交换 (α,β) 双色边、删除时以概率 ℓ/κ 把父边颜色恢复到某条子边。关键技术工具：精确的重着色概率 1/(κ(κ−1)^{d−1})（插入）与 1/(κ−1)^d（修复级联）；增量摊还分析采用"重/轻插入"分类的充电论证（配合引理 3.3 的几何级数求和）；ColorfulPath 用"ready 边"势函数分析；下界用 Yao 原理与硬分布（星形森林 + 随机抽取中心）以及 P/ P̄-分层树（layered tree）对抗构造。
AI.result: 确定性：增量模型中 Greedy 摊还代价 O(1/(c+√Δ))（定理 2.1），存在插入序列与 tie-breaking 使其达 Ω(1/(c+√Δ))（定理 2.2，故除 tie-breaking 外紧）；c≥1 时该界对 GreedyShift/GreedyPath 同样成立。全动态模型：任意确定性算法摊还代价 ≥ Ω(1)（定理 2.3，n 需达 n₀(Δ,c)=Θ((c+1)Δ·C(Δ+c,c+1))）；Greedy 可被强迫达 Ω(log_Δ n) 摊还代价（定理 2.4，基于两棵互补分层树的删除-插入循环），对仅平移颜色的算法下界更强为 Ω(log_{c+1}(n/(Δ−c)))（c=0 时为 Ω(n/Δ)）；有根森林 + 2Δ−2 色时 ColorfulPath 达 O(1) 摊还代价（定理 2.6，与 Ω(1) 下界匹配），可 O(Δ) 摊还时间实现；Δ=2（森林退化为路径）时 Greedy 增量 O(log n)、全动态 O(n)，均最优且随机化无益。随机化：DistMaint 在增量模型达 Θ(1/Δ) 期望摊还代价（有根与一般森林皆然，一般森林需精心选 rerooting 方向，否则代价可达 Ω(1)），且对每个常数 c 有匹配下界 Ω(1/Δ)（定理 2.10）；全动态模型每次更新期望代价 Θ(min{Δ/c, log_{κ−1} n})（c=0 时为 Θ(log_{Δ−1} n)），对 c=0 有匹配下界，对每个常数 c 有 Ω(1) 下界。运行时间：DistMaint 全动态 O(1+R) 每次更新、增量期望摊还 O(α(n)+R)；Greedy/GreedyShift/GreedyPath 分别为 O(Δ⁴n)/O(Δn)/O(n)。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了一幅完整的森林动态边着色代价图景：在增量模型中，即使不用额外颜色也能达到与 n 无关的摊还代价，随机 DistMaint 的 Θ(1/Δ) 在常数 c 下最优，确定性 Greedy 为 O(1/(c+√Δ))；在全动态模型中该目标不可行（c=0 时任何算法需 Ω(log_{Δ−1} n)），有额外颜色后变为可行（有根森林下 ColorfulPath 达 O(1)）。作者指出仍存的开放问题：改进 Greedy 的 tie-breaking 能否改进增量界；在无根森林或更广调色板下确定全动态确定性的最优界；确定性与随机化之间是否存在分离（目前确定性最好为 O(1/√Δ) 而随机为 Θ(1/Δ)）；以及 c 随 Δ 增长时的最优代价与更强下界。

title: Loom: Hybrid Retrieval-Scoring Outfit Recommendation with Semantic Material Compatibility and Occasion-Aware Embedding Priors
summary:
We present Loom, an outfit recommendation system that combines neural embedding retrieval with structured domain scoring to generate complete, coherent outfits from fashion catalogs. Given an anchor clothing item, Loom retrieves complementary pieces via slot-constrained approximate nearest neighbor search over FashionCLIP embeddings, then scores candidate outfits using a multi-objective function that integrates six signals: embedding similarity, color harmony, formality consistency, occasion coherence, style direction, and within-outfit diversity.
  We introduce two techniques that address limitations of purely learned or purely rule-based approaches: (1) semantic material weight, which uses CLIP embedding geometry to infer garment heaviness for layer compatibility without hand-coded material taxonomies; and (2) vibe/anti-vibe occasion priors, which embed prose descriptions of occasion contexts as anchor vectors in CLIP space and score items by differential affinity.
  Ablation experiments on a catalog of 620 items show that each component contributes measurably to outfit quality: the full system achieves a mean outfit score of 0.179 with a 9.3% hard violation rate, compared to 0.054 score and 16.0% violations for a category-constrained random baseline, a 3.3x improvement in score and 42% reduction in violations. Direction reranking is the single indispensable component: removing it drops score to 0.052, essentially equal to random. The system generates three stylistically distinct outfits in under 5 seconds on commodity hardware.

AI.tldr: Loom是一个服装推荐系统，通过结合FashionCLIP神经嵌入检索与包含6个信号的多目标评分，实现完整 coherent outfit 的自动生成。创新性地利用嵌入几何推断材料属性、通过文本嵌入捕捉场合氛围，在620件商品上相比随机基线取得3.3倍得分提升和42%违规率降低，其中风格方向组件为核心必备模块。
AI.motivation: 服装推荐系统需要生成完整且连贯的 outfit，而非仅推荐单件。现有纯学习方法或纯规则方法均存在局限性：学习模型难以捕捉层级相容性和场合语境，规则系统则缺乏灵活性和语义理解能力。如何在没有手工材料分类体系的情况下实现层级相容性推理，以及如何理解抽象的场合氛围描述，是当前的核心挑战。
AI.method: Loom采用神经嵌入检索与结构化域评分相结合的方法。首先通过FashionCLIP嵌入和槽位约束的近似最近邻搜索检索互补单品，随后用包含6个信号的多目标函数评分：嵌入相似度、色彩和谐度、正规性一致性、场合连贯性、风格方向和 outfit 内多样性。创新性技术包括：(1)语义材料权重——利用CLIP嵌入几何结构推断衣物重量以实现层级兼容性，无需手工编码的材料分类；(2)氛围/反氛围场合先验——将场合文本描述嵌入为CLIP空间中的锚向量，通过差分亲和度评分。
AI.result: 在620件商品目录上的消融实验表明：完整系统达到平均得分0.179、硬违规率9.3%，相比类别约束随机基线（得分0.054、违规率16.0%）实现了3.3倍得分提升和42%的违规率降低。其中风格方向重排是唯一不可替代的组件，移除后得分骤降至0.052（几乎等同于随机基线）。系统可在普通硬件上5秒内生成3个风格差异化的 outfit。
AI.conclusion: Loom系统成功实现了3.3倍的质量提升和42%的违规率降低，在普通硬件上5秒内可生成三个风格差异化的完整 outfit。消融实验证明方向重排(direction reranking)是不可或缺的核心组件，移除后系统性能降至随机基线水平。语义材料权重和氛围/反氛围先验两种技术有效弥补了纯学习或纯规则方法的不足。

title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning: Integrating Zero-Knowledge Proofs in Scalable Distributed Architectures
summary: The intersection of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and distributed systems has given rise to Federated Learning (FL), a paradigm that enables decentralized model training without compromising local data privacy. As organizational data silos grow, deploying complex machine learning models across highly distributed edge networks becomes a critical infrastructural challenge. Standard FL implementations suffer from severe vulnerabilities related to adversarial gradient updates and computational bottlenecks at the aggregation layer. This paper presents a novel, end-to-end distributed architecture that hardens FL pipelines using advanced cryptographic verification and optimized big data processing frameworks. We introduce a Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) wrapper that cryptographically validates node computations before global aggregation, neutralizing model poisoning attacks without inspecting raw gradients. Additionally, we evaluate the system's performance using extreme gradient boosting models optimized for distributed edge execution. We formalize the mathematical transformation of the machine learning loss functions into Rank-1 Constraint Systems (R1CS) suitable for succinct verification. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our hybrid architecture achieves a 94.2\% accuracy retention under adversarial conditions while maintaining scalable throughput across 1,000 parallel distributed nodes, effectively bridging the gap between rigorous cryptographic security and high-performance distributed AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套端到端的联邦学习架构，在客户端本地用XGBoost（平方逻辑损失）训练并仅上传梯度直方图，通过将机器学习计算编译为算术电路/R1CS/QAP并生成zk-SNARK零知识证明，在聚合前完成密码学验证以阻断拜占庭模型投毒；聚合层采用Kafka+Spark内存计算实现水平扩展。实验显示在1000节点、10%恶意节点条件下，最终精度达94.2%（标准FL仅42.1%），投毒攻击成功率0%，每轮聚合时间由1.2s增至3.4s。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽避免原始数据集中，但存在两大结构性缺陷：一是默认所有节点诚实，恶意/被攻陷的边缘设备可注入被操纵的梯度实施模型投毒甚至植入后门；二是数千个异步地理分散节点的百万级参数聚合在中心聚合器形成计算与通信瓶颈。同时集中式训练还面临GDPR/CCPA等数据主权合规风险与跨广域网传输原始数据的带宽开销。因此需要一种既能密码学证明"计算被正确执行"又不泄露原始梯度、又能承受高并发聚合负载的端到端方案。
AI.method: 架构分三层：(1) 本地AI执行层——各节点下载全局树集成参数Θ_t，在本地数据上用自定义平方逻辑损失计算一阶梯度g_i与二阶梯度h_i，不在本地建树（避免泄露本地分布结构），仅聚合为安全直方图分箱 G_kv=Σg_i、H_kv=Σh_i；(2) 密码学验证层——将ML计算编译为算术电路→R1CS，满足 (A·w)∘(B·w)=C·w，再转为QAP生成zk-SNARK；聚合端用双线性配对校验 e(π_A,π_B)=e(π_C,G)·e(V_pub,H)，其中公开验证键V_pub编码梯度取值边界，验证失败即判定为Byzantine并丢弃；(3) 可扩展聚合基础设施——Kafka分区主题接收梯度与ZKP，20台c5.4xlarge验证工作节点并行做椭圆曲线配对，验证通过的载荷推入基于Spark的聚合器完成加权联邦平均生成下一代全局分裂，实现验证与聚合解耦。实验在AWS EKS上部署1000个异步worker，HIGGS数据集非i.i.d.划分，10%节点为Byzantine并构造符号反转、幅度夸大的投毒梯度。
AI.result: 标准FL在10%对抗负载下崩塌至42.1%精度（接近随机），投毒成功率100%；加入Krum/中位数类统计异常检测后精度78.4%、投毒成功率仍22%（对抗者将梯度保持在标准差内可绕过统计过滤）；本文ZKP架构对投毒更新实现100%拒绝率（恶意节点无配对曲线陷门无法生成有效证明，载荷在边缘网关被即时丢弃），全局精度保持94.2%，与非对抗基线相当。开销方面：边缘端证明生成约800ms，聚合端单证明验证约12ms，每轮聚合时间由1.2s增至3.4s，内存计算引擎吸收了密码学开销，1000节点规模下吞吐可扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过将ML损失函数形式化为R1CS并用可扩展零知识证明在全局聚合前验证节点计算，可在不检查任何原始数据/梯度的前提下彻底中和拜占庭模型投毒；同时结合Kafka+Spark内存化分布式基础设施，可使企业级密码学计算开销在1000节点规模下保持在可接受范围，弥合了严格密码学安全与高性能分布式AI之间的鸿沟。局限与未来方向：证明生成/验证延迟仍是主要瓶颈；后续将面向参数量更大的深度卷积网络优化zk-SNARK电路规模，并探索完全异步聚合与消息代理层的预测性缓存预热以降低高流失率IoT边缘网络中的通信轮延迟。

title: Toward Multi-Database Query Reasoning for Text2Cypher
summary: Large language models have significantly improved natural language interfaces to databases by translating user questions into executable queries. In particular, Text2Cypher focuses on generating Cypher queries for graph databases, enabling users to access graph data without query language expertise. Most existing Text2Cypher systems assume a single preselected graph database, where queries are generated over a known schema. However, real-world systems are often distributed across multiple independent graph databases organized by domain or system boundaries, where relevant information may span multiple sources. To address this limitation, we propose a shift from single-database query generation to multi-database query reasoning. Instead of assuming a fixed execution context, the system must reason about (i) relevant databases, (ii) how to decompose a question across them, and (iii) how to integrate partial results. We formalize this setting through a three-phase roadmap: database routing, multi-database decomposition, and heterogeneous query reasoning across database types and query languages. This work provides a structured formulation of multi-database reasoning for Text2Cypher and identifies challenges in source selection, query decomposition, and result integration, aiming to support more realistic and scalable natural language interfaces to graph databases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从单数据库Text2Cypher扩展到多数据库查询推理的新范式，解决实际场景中信息跨多个图数据库分布的问题。通过三阶段路线图（数据库路由、多数据库分解、异构查询推理）形式化该问题，并识别源选择、查询分解和结果集成等关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有Text2Cypher系统假设单一预选图数据库，但实际系统常分布在多个独立图数据库中，相关数据可能跨越多个数据源。现有方法无法处理这种分布式场景。
AI.method: 提出三阶段路线图：1) 数据库路由——确定相关数据库；2) 多数据库分解——将问题分解到各数据库；3) 异构查询推理——跨数据库类型和查询语言整合结果。
AI.result: 形式化多数据库Text2Cypher设置，识别源选择、查询分解和结果集成等核心挑战。
AI.conclusion: 为构建更现实、可扩展的图数据库自然语言接口奠定理论基础，指明未来研究方向。

title: Beyond the All-in-One Agent: Benchmarking Role-Specialized Multi-Agent Collaboration in Enterprise Workflows
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to operate in enterprise environments, where work is distributed across specialized roles, permission-controlled systems, and cross-departmental procedures. However, existing enterprise benchmarks largely evaluate single agents with broad tool access, while existing multi-agent benchmarks rarely capture realistic enterprise constraints such as role specialization, access control, stateful business systems, and policy-based approvals. We introduce \textsc{EntCollabBench}, a benchmark for evaluating enterprise multi-agent collaboration. \textsc{EntCollabBench} simulates a permission-isolated organization with 11 role-specialized agents across six departments and contains two evaluation subsets: a Workflow subset, where agents collaboratively modify enterprise system states, and an Approval subset, where agents make policy-grounded decisions. Evaluation is based on execution traces, database state verification, and deterministic policy adjudication rather than natural-language response judging. Experiments with representative LLM agents show that current models still struggle with end-to-end enterprise collaboration, especially in delegation, context transfer, parameter grounding, workflow closure, and decision commitment. \textsc{EntCollabBench} provides a reproducible testbed for measuring and improving agent systems intended for realistic organizational environments.

AI.tldr: EntCollabBench是一个用于评估企业多智能体协作的基准测试，通过模拟一个包含11个角色专业化智能体、六个部门及权限隔离的企业环境，包含工作流子集和审批子集，用于评估当前LLM智能体在企业协作方面的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 现有企业基准测试主要评估具有广泛工具访问权限的单一智能体，而现有的多智能体基准测试很少捕捉到真实企业场景中的角色专业化、访问控制、状态性业务系统和基于策略的审批等约束条件，导致无法有效评估LLM智能体在真实企业环境中的协作能力。
AI.method: 构建EntCollabBench基准测试，模拟一个权限隔离的组织环境，包含11个角色专业化智能体横跨六个部门；设计两个评估子集——工作流子集（智能体协作修改企业系统状态）和审批子集（智能体做出基于策略的决策）；采用执行轨迹、数据库状态验证和确定性策略裁决进行评估，而非自然语言响应评判。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前主流LLM智能体在端到端企业协作方面仍存在明显不足，尤其在任务委派、上下文传递、参数约束、工作流闭环和决策承诺等关键能力上表现欠佳。
AI.conclusion: EntCollabBench为评估和改进面向真实组织环境的智能体系统提供了可复现的测试平台，有助于推动企业级多智能体协作技术的发展。

title: Understanding Student Effort Using Response-Time Propensities During Problem Solving
comment: Accepted as full paper to the 13th ACM Conference on Learning @ Scale (L@S '26)
summary: Adaptive learning systems can produce substantial learning gains, yet many students engage for too brief or too superficial a period to benefit. A central obstacle is measuring effort. Effort during multi-step problem solving is rarely directly observed, and common log-based proxies, such as time on task, cannot distinguish between a student working carefully and a student encountering a harder problem. We examine step-to-step response time as a scalable effort signal by modeling trait-like differences in students' typical response timing during tutoring (while adjusting for skill difficulty). Using step-level logs from eight classroom deployments of algebra tutoring systems (2020 to 2023) across six U.S. schools (794 students), we estimate student- and knowledge-component-level propensities using hierarchical models and relate them to learning efficiency, defined as performance improvement per completed solution step. Response-time propensities show moderate to strong stability within students, supporting their use as an individual differences measure beyond correctness. At the same time, their relationship to learning is not uniform but conditional on the learner and context. Slower propensities predict greater learning efficiency for higher-proficiency students, consistent with constructive processing, whereas for lower-proficiency students, slower propensities are weakly related or even negative, consistent with unproductive struggle or idling. These associations are strongest early in practice sequences and attenuate later in the class period, highlighting an actionable window for detecting emerging disengagement and low persistence. Overall, response-time propensities provide a practical way to incorporate temporal process data into learner models and to target adaptive supports when effort is most diagnostic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"反应时倾向"（response-time propensities）：用分层混合效应模型从智能辅导系统（ITS）逐步骤日志中估计学生"典型的、难度校正后的步间反应速度"，并检验其与学习效率（每完成一步带来的成绩提升）的关系。基于2020–2023年美国6所学校8次代数辅导部署（794名中学生、87,592次操作、44,804步），发现：反应时倾向在学生内具有中等到强稳定性（切片间相关 r=.51–.64），但与学习效率的关系并非一致——高水平学生中较慢倾向预测更高学习效率（建设性加工/自我解释），低水平学生中则弱相关甚至为负（无效挣扎或走神）；该关联在课堂前期（Q1）最强并随课堂推进而衰减（Q1 交互 β=0.12, p=.007；Q2/Q3 不显著）。
AI.motivation: 大规模自适应学习系统中，只有极少部分学生（如低至5%）达到足以获益的投入与坚持水平，但"努力/努力调节"几乎无法直接观测。现有日志代理指标（如总时长、点击数、任务启动）模糊且易被预处理方式影响，无法区分"学生认真思考"与"题目更难"；原始反应时间更是高度歧义——快可能是流畅化，也可能是猜测/刷题，慢可能是深思、监控，也可能是不动产、走神或卡住。已有工作多在反应时间的极端处使用它（识别快速猜测），且多停留在会话层面，缺少同时区分稳定的个体特质差异与内容/任务难度情境效应的"建设性努力"特质模型。同时，先备知识会调节努力的意义：高水平学生花更多时间可能是自我解释式的建设性加工，低水平学生则可能是困惑或停滞，因此不能对所有学习者统一解释时间信号。作者还关注课堂时段位置这一情境因素——早期投入更可能反映任务启动与自我调节，晚期则受疲劳、任务切换干扰。
AI.method: 数据：8个数据集（DataShop IDs 3332/5153/5360/5549/5604/5605/5606/5610），来自CTAT+TutorShop基础设施上的Lynnette等步级代数辅导系统（含纸质vs辅导、游戏化、拖拽输入、同伴辅导等条件），794名学生、约30–60分钟/人、32个技能/知识成分；预处理采用开源流水线。测量：反应时为相邻步骤首次尝试之间的间隔并做对数变换；学习机会按"学生×技能"枚举；每节课按起止时间归一化为四个全局时间切片（Q1–Q4）。模型：(1) 反应时倾向模型——log RT ~ 1 + (1|student) + (1|skill)，学生随机截距即难度校正后的特质性倾向；(2) 学习效率模型——iAFM：correct ~ opp + (1+opp|student) + (1+opp|skill)，学生随机斜率为个体学习率；均用R lme4按时间切片分别拟合。分析：RQ1 跨切片随机效应两两Pearson相关（稳定性）；RQ2 切片内RT截距与学习率斜率相关；RQ3 线性模型 learning_rate ~ RT_propensity × prior_proficiency（先备知识由iAFM学生截距操作化），报告95% CI与原始p，并对四个切片分别做Benjamini–Hochberg FDR校正；全部变量标准化；另做Cook's D/杠杆/学生化残差敏感性与剔除98个（12.5%） influential case的敏感性分析。
AI.result: RQ1：RT倾向跨切片相关r=.51（Q1–Q3）至.55（Q1–Q4），相邻晚期切片最高r=.64（Q3–Q4），属中等到强稳定性；学习率估计稳定性明显更差（r=.19–.35）。各切片步级RT中位数约19–20秒，基本稳定。RQ2：RT倾向与先备知识负相关（高水平学生反应更快，符合流畅化解释）；RT倾向对学习率无可靠主效应（β=−0.02, p=.534），先备知识正向预测学习率（β=0.10, p=.009），但交互显著（β=0.11, 95% CI [.03,.18], p=.004）：高先备学生中较慢倾向对应更陡的机会斜率，中等水平近似平坦，低水平者弱负相关。剔除高影响观测后交互仍显著（β=0.147, p=.014）。RQ3：切片内相关在Q1最强且显著（r=−0.12, p<.001），Q2（r=−0.05, p=.145）、Q3（r=.04, p=.296）、Q4（r=−0.03, p=.375）均不显著；交互项在Q1显著（β=0.116, 调整后p<.05）、Q4边缘显著（β=0.092, 调整后p<.10）、Q2/Q3不显著；先备知识主效应随切片变号（Q1 +0.243，Q2 −0.084，Q3 −0.237，Q4 +0.110）。Q3→Q4步级RT上升，而掌握度通常随练习上升，提示课堂末段的延迟可能反映疲劳、任务切换或战略性停止等非建设性努力因素。
AI.conclusion: 反应时的歧义并非数据固有，而源于建模方式：通过将步间延迟建模为知识成分校正的"反应时倾向"，可在规模化场景下得到可解释的学生层面参数，作为正确率轨迹之外的过程性个体差异构念，补充知识模型。其与学习效率的关系由学习者先备知识和课堂时段位置共同调节，故时间信号应作为"情境依赖的参与与调节证据"而非努力的直接代理：早期课堂时段（尤其Q1）是识别投入不足、走神与低坚持倾向最具诊断力的可操作窗口，可据此触发情境化自适应支持；把"慢= disengagement"当作通用启发式会误伤高先备学生的建设性加工。对低先备学生、尤其练习早期的超长延迟更可能反映启动困难与无效挣扎，应优先给予支持。未来工作包括：与BROMP等观察性参与指标三角验证构念、建模尝试层级动态（重复猜测、对反馈的反应时间）、通过实验/准实验检验以早期时序触发支持能否提升坚持与学习、纳入会话层效应以分离长期个体差异、以及在阅读负荷更重或开放作答等不同领域与人群中的外部效度检验。局限：反应时间仍无法区分课堂中断、走神与阅读时间；分析为相关性、不支持因果推断；结论受限于美国步级数学辅导的短交互周期与有限阅读负荷。

title: A Dataset of Agentic AI Coding Tool Configurations
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables, Proceedings of the 3rd ACM/IEEE International Conference on AI-powered Software (AIware 2026)
summary: Agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex execute multi-step coding tasks with limited human oversight. To steer these tools, developers create repository-level configuration artifacts (e.g., Markdown files) for configuration mechanisms such as Context Files, Skills, Rules, and Hooks. There is no curated dataset yet that captures these configurations at scale. This dataset, collected from open-source GitHub repositories, fills that gap. We selected 40,585 actively maintained repositories through metadata filtering, classified them using GPT-5.2 to identify 36,710 as belonging to engineered software projects, and systematically detected configuration artifacts in these repositories. The dataset covers 4,738 repositories across five tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Gemini) and eight configuration mechanisms. We collected 15,591 configuration artifacts, the full content of 18,167 configuration files associated with these configuration artifacts, and 148,519 AI-co-authored commits. The dataset and the construction pipeline are publicly available on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. An interactive website allows researchers to browse and explore the data. This data supports research on context engineering, AI tool adoption patterns, and human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个大规模AI编码工具配置数据集，从40,585个开源GitHub仓库中筛选出36,710个工程软件项目，最终从4,738个仓库收集了15,591个配置工件，覆盖5种工具（Claude Code、GitHub Copilot、OpenAI Codex、Cursor、Gemini）和8种配置机制，附带148,519个AI协作提交记录，为上下文工程和人类-AI协作研究提供数据支持。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏大规模、系统化的AI编码工具配置数据集。开发者通过配置工件（Markdown文件等）引导Agentic AI工具（如Context Files、Skills、Rules、Hooks），但这些配置尚未被系统采集和整理，限制了相关领域的研究进展。
AI.method: 通过元数据过滤筛选40,585个活跃维护的仓库；使用GPT-5.2进行分类识别出36,710个工程软件项目；系统性检测配置工件；数据收集涵盖5种AI编码工具和8种配置机制；提供交互式网站供研究人员浏览数据。
AI.result: 数据集包含15,591个配置工件、18,167个相关配置文件的完整内容、148,519个AI协作提交记录；覆盖4,738个仓库；已在Zenodo平台发布（CC BY 4.0许可证）；构建了完整的可复现数据采集流水线。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了AI编码工具配置研究的数据空白，为上下文工程（context engineering）、AI工具采纳模式、人类-AI协作等研究方向提供了实证基础，有望推动软件工程与AI交叉领域的研究进展。

title: Built Environment Reasoning from Remote Sensing Imagery Using Large Vision--Language Models
comment: Published in the International Conference on Industrialized Construction 2026
summary: This work investigates the use of large language models (LLMs) for tasks in smart cities. The core idea is to leverage remote sensing imagery to characterize the built environment, including design suggestions, constructability assessment, landuse patterns, and risk identification. We examine remote sensing imagery at multiple spatial scales as inputs for multimodal language modeling and evaluate their effects on built-environment-related reasoning. In addition, we compare state-of-the-art LLMs, including InternVL and Qwen, in terms of accuracy and reliability when generating built environment recommendations. The results demonstrate the potential of integrating remote sensing imagery with large language models to assist smart cities and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了大语言模型（LLM）与遥感影像结合用于智慧城市建设的可行性，通过多尺度遥感输入和跨模型对比，验证了该方法在建筑环境评估中的潜在价值。
AI.motivation: 随着智慧城市发展，如何高效利用海量遥感影像数据进行城市环境分析与决策支持成为关键挑战。传统方法在语义理解和推理能力上存在局限，而大语言模型的快速发展为多模态城市分析提供了新途径。
AI.method: 研究采用多尺度遥感影像作为多模态语言模型的输入端，测试不同空间尺度对建筑环境推理任务的影响；同时对比了InternVL和Qwen等前沿LLM在生成建筑环境建议时的准确性和可靠性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，遥感影像与大规模语言模型的融合具有显著潜力，可有效支持智慧城市建设和决策应用。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型结合遥感技术是智慧城市领域一个有前景的研究方向，未来有望在城市设计建议、可建性评估、土地利用模式和风险识别等任务中发挥重要作用。

title: MemQ: Integrating Q-Learning into Self-Evolving Memory Agents over Provenance DAGs
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures (containing 43 individual image panels total)
summary: Episodic memory allows LLM agents to accumulate and retrieve experience, but current methods treat each memory independently, i.e., evaluating retrieval quality in isolation without accounting for the dependency chains through which memories enable the creation of future memories. We introduce MemQ, which applies TD($λ$) eligibility traces to memory Q-values, propagating credit backward through a provenance DAG that records which memories were retrieved when each new memory was created. Credit weight decays as $(γλ)^d$ with DAG depth $d$, replacing temporal distance with structural proximity. We formalize the setting as an Exogenous-Context MDP, whose factored transition decouples the exogenous task stream from the endogenous memory store. Across six benchmarks, spanning OS interaction, function calling, code generation, multimodal reasoning, embodied reasoning, and expert-level QA, MemQ achieves the highest success rate on all six in generalization evaluation and runtime learning, with gains largest on multi-step tasks that produce deep and relevant provenance chains (up to +5.7~pp) and smallest on single-step classification (+0.77~pp) where single-step updates already suffice. We further study how $γ$ and $λ$ interact with the EC-MDP structure, providing principled guidance for parameter selection and future research. Code will be available soon.

AI.tldr: MemQ introduces TD(λ) eligibility traces with provenance DAG-based credit propagation for episodic memory in LLM agents, achieving state-of-the-art results on six diverse benchmarks, with greatest improvements on multi-step tasks requiring deep memory chains.
AI.motivation: Current episodic memory methods for LLM agents treat each memory independently, evaluating retrieval quality in isolation without accounting for dependency chains through which memories enable the creation of future memories.
AI.method: MemQ applies TD(λ) eligibility traces to memory Q-values, propagating credit backward through a provenance DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) that records memory retrieval history. Credit weight decays as (γλ)^d based on DAG depth d, replacing temporal distance with structural proximity. The problem is formalized as an Exogenous-Context MDP (EC-MDP) with factored transitions that decouple the exogenous task stream from the endogenous memory store.
AI.result: Across six benchmarks (OS interaction, function calling, code generation, multimodal reasoning, embodied reasoning, and expert-level QA), MemQ achieves the highest success rate on all six in both generalization evaluation and runtime learning. The largest gains (+5.7~pp) occur on multi-step tasks with deep provenance chains, while the smallest gains (+0.77~pp) are on single-step classification.
AI.conclusion: MemQ provides a principled framework for episodic memory in LLM agents, with the EC-MDP formalism offering principled guidance for parameter selection (γ and λ) and future research directions.

title: TreeWidzard: An Engine for Width-Based Dynamic Programming and Automated Theorem Proving
summary: In this work, we introduce TreeWidzard, an engine for developing dynamic programming algorithms that decide graph-theoretic properties parameterized by treewidth and pathwidth. Besides providing a unified framework for algorithms deciding atomic graph-theoretic properties, our engine allows one to combine such algorithms for two purposes: to obtain dynamic programming algorithms for more complex graph properties, and to support treewidth-based automated theorem proving. Within this context, given the specification of a Boolean combination \(P\) of graph properties \(P_1, P_2, \ldots, P_r\), and a positive integer \(k\), our engine can be used to determine whether all graphs of treewidth at most \(k\) satisfy \(P\). The main goal of the present work is to provide a system description of TreeWidzard. In particular, we provide a step-by-step account of how to implement dynamic programming algorithms in our framework and how to combine these algorithms for model checking and automated theorem proving.

AI.tldr: TreeWidzard是一个用于开发动态规划算法的引擎,专门处理由树宽和路径宽参数化的图论性质判定问题。该系统提供了一个统一框架,既可以单独实现原子图性质的判定算法,也可以通过布尔组合方式组合这些算法,以获得更复杂图性质的动态规划算法,并支持基于树宽的自动定理证明。
AI.motivation: Developing dynamic programming algorithms for graph properties parameterized by treewidth is complex and error-prone. There is a need for a unified framework that not only implements individual algorithms but also supports composing them to handle Boolean combinations of properties for both algorithmic model checking and automated theorem proving.
AI.method: TreeWidzard engine provides a unified framework where atomic graph property algorithms can be combined through Boolean operations to build more complex dynamic programming algorithms for model checking and automated theorem proving.
AI.result: A complete system description of TreeWidzard that enables step-by-step implementation of dynamic programming algorithms and their composition for checking Boolean combinations of graph properties on graphs of bounded treewidth.
AI.conclusion: TreeWidzard provides a practical system for implementing and composing dynamic programming algorithms on bounded treewidth/pathwidth graphs, with applications in both algorithmic graph analysis and automated theorem proving.

title: ReCoVR: Closing the Loop in Interactive Composed Video Retrieval
summary: Composed video retrieval (CoVR) searches for target videos using a reference video and a modification text, but existing methods are restricted to a single interaction round and cannot support the progressive nature of real-world visual search. To bridge this gap, we first formalize interactive composed video retrieval, a multi-turn extension of CoVR, where users progressively refine their search intent through natural-language feedback across turns. Adapting existing interactive retrieval methods to this setting reveals two structural weaknesses: reliance on a single retrieval channel and an open-loop retrieval design that consumes user feedback but does not diagnose whether its own retrieval trajectory is drifting or stagnating. To address these limitations, we propose ReCoVR (Reflexive Composed Video Retrieval), a dual-pathway architecture built on reflexive perception, where the system treats its retrieval history as diagnostic evidence alongside user feedback. Specifically, an Intent Pathway routes heterogeneous feedback to complementary retrieval channels, while a Reflection Pathway performs trajectory-level reflection to monitor result evolution and correct retrieval errors across turns. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ReCoVR consistently outperforms interactive baselines, notably achieving 74.30% R@1 after just one interactive round on the WebVid-CoVR-Test dataset.

AI.tldr: ReCoVR是一种新型的交互式组合视频检索框架，通过双通道架构实现多轮对话式视频检索。系统包含意图通道和反思通道，分别处理用户反馈和检索轨迹监控，在WebVid-CoVR-Test数据集上取得74.30%的R@1准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有组合视频检索（CoVR）方法仅限于单轮交互，无法支持真实场景中用户需要通过多轮自然语言反馈逐步精化检索意图的需求。现有交互式检索方法存在两大结构缺陷：仅依赖单一检索通道，以及开环设计无法诊断检索轨迹是否偏离或停滞。
AI.method: 提出ReCoVR（反思式组合视频检索）框架，采用双通道架构：①意图通道（Intent Pathway）：将异构反馈路由至互补的检索通道；②反思通道（Reflection Pathway）：执行轨迹级反思，监控结果演变并在多轮交互中纠正检索错误。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，ReCoVR一致性地超越交互式基线方法。在WebVid-CoVR-Test数据集上，仅经过一轮交互即达到74.30%的R@1准确率。
AI.conclusion: ReCoVR通过引入反思机制和双通道架构，有效解决了多轮交互式视频检索中的轨迹监控和错误纠正问题，为实现更自然、更精准的视觉搜索系统提供了新的技术路径。

title: parHSOM: A novel parallel Hierarchical Self-Organizing Map implementation
summary: The digital age has completely transformed the way that information is processed and stored, which makes cybersecurity a crucial field of research. Cybersecurity contains many different domains, but this work focuses on Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs). Within the literature, Hierarchical Self-Organizing Maps (HSOMs) have been used to create trustworthy, explainable, and AI-based IDSs. However, HSOMs are trained sequentially, which means that training HSOMs on large datasets is slow. This work presents a novel parallel HSOM architecture, called parHSOM. The purpose of this research is to investigate the effect that parallel computation has on the HSOM training time. parHSOM is tested on two different testbeds, four different output grid sizes, and five different cybersecurity datasets. Performance metrics collected from these experiments show that parHSOM consistently trains faster than the Sequential HSOM algorithm without any significant loss in performance. Additionally, this work provides a platform for further investigation into parallel HSOM implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了首个并行分层自组织映射算法 parHSOM，将 HSOM 训练过程按"数据分区"思想并行化（顶层 SOM 顺序训练，各簇的垂直生长由多进程并行执行），在 2 个测试平台、4 种输出网格尺寸（2x2~5x5）、5 个网络安全数据集（NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS-2017/2018、TON_IoT）上与串行 HSOM 对比：训练时间一致更快，最高加速 6.056 倍（NSL-KDD，3x3 网格，H100 服务器），而准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、FPR、FNR 与预测时间等指标与串行版本差异均在极小范围内（多数 ≤0.01，部分 ≤0.03），无显著性能损失。
AI.motivation: 网络安全入侵检测系统（IDS）需要可信、可解释的 AI 模型；SOM/HSOM 通过 2D 输出网格提供可解释的聚类结果，因而被广泛用于构建可解释 IDS。但 SOM/HSOM 均为串行训练，数据量增大时训练时间呈线性增长，难以支撑大规模网络流量数据；而 HSOM 需在每个父簇上再训练子 SOM，训练开销被进一步放大（一个模型内包含多个 SOM）。降低训练时间的常见途径是缩小数据集，但这会削弱模型鲁棒性，因此需要引入并行计算。作者的文献调研表明：已有工作集中于 SOM 的并行化（软件优化可分数据分区、网络分区、混合分区；硬件优化依赖特殊体系结构、可及性差），而针对并行 HSOM 的实现几乎为空白，由此形成研究缺口并提出两个研究问题：RQ1 如何并行化 HSOM？RQ2 并行 HSOM（parHSOM）相对串行 HSOM 的性能表现如何？
AI.method: 以文献 [33] 的 DBGHSOM 代码为基础，先裁剪出最基础的 Sequential HSOM 作为基线，再按数据分区法并行化得到 parHSOM，仅并行化训练过程，预测过程保持不变。算法分两阶段：Phase 1 在初始训练集上顺序训练一个 SOM，得到相互独立的簇并存入 SOM_tmp_list；Phase 2 父进程遍历列表，对含 SOM 对象的节点复制出 parent_SOM 并派生子进程执行 Vertical Growth Function（VGF），VGF 逐神经元计算误差并与 growth_threshold 比较，超过阈值且样本数大于网格规模则在该神经元数据上再训练一个 SOM，否则直接标注 benign/malicious 并作为叶节点返回；父进程等待全部子进程结束后通过 Multiprocessing Manager 的共享内存字典回收结果，循环直至列表为空。数据预处理使用 scikit-learn 的 Normalizer 归一化与 train_test_split 按 80/20 划分，保证两种算法使用相同训练/测试集。实验平台为 Alienware Aurora R16（24 核/32 逻辑处理器）与 H100 服务器（2 路 16 核/64 逻辑处理器）；输出网格为 2x2、3x3、4x4、5x5；评测指标为 precision、recall、F1、accuracy、FPR、FNR、训练时间 TT、预测时间 PT，每组实验重复 10 次取均值。
AI.result: RQ1：给出了明确的并行化方案——利用 HSOM 天然把训练数据划分为独立子集的特性，采用数据分区法对每一层的子 SOM 训练做多进程并行，实现可行。RQ2-1（训练时间）：parHSOM 在全部 40 组配置中训练时间均优于串行 HSOM；最大加速出现在 NSL-KDD+3x3 网格，Testbed 1 为 5.265 倍、Testbed 2 为 6.056 倍；各数据集最佳加速分别为 CIC-IDS-2017 1.891/1.778、CIC-IDS-2018 1.616/1.501、TON_IoT 4.734/4.04、UNSW-NB15 2.897/3.669（Testbed1/Testbed2），除 UNSW-NB15 在 Testbed 1 上 2x2 略优于 3x3 外，最优配置普遍为 3x3 网格。趋势上，数据集越大加速比越低（子进程数量增加导致 CPU 过载）；Testbed 2 绝对训练时间更长（双路 socket 间通信开销），但相对加速更高，说明通信开销存在优化空间。RQ2-2（其他指标）：CIC-IDS-2017/2018 与 NSL-KDD 上所有指标差异均 ≤0.01，TON_IoT 与 UNSW-NB15 多数 ≤0.01、个别 ≤0.03；准确率整体差异 ≤1.6%（TON_IoT 最大），FPR 差异最大 7.07%（UNSW-NB15，主要由不同网格尺寸造成，同一网格下 parHSOM 与串行相当或更优），FNR 差异最大 3.07%，且在多数配置下 parHSOM 的 FPR/FNR 反而更低。结论为并行化未带来显著性能退化。
AI.conclusion: parHSOM 首次以数据分区方式实现了并行 HSOM，证明了并行化 HSOM 用于构建可解释、可信 AI 入侵检测系统是一条有前景的路线：在保持与串行 HSOM 几乎相同检测性能（部分指标更优）的前提下显著缩短训练时间，并提供了一个可扩展的并行 HSOM 研究平台。局限性包括：仅在 HSOM 基础组件层面并行、初始化条件（学习率、邻域函数等）固定而未充分调优（在权重更新变小时出现 Runtime error 提示初始化可优化）、Python 并非降低通信开销的最优语言、多路 socket 通信成本未优化、仅利用 CPU 多进程未涉及 GPU。后续研究方向：用 MPI 等更高效语言/通信框架重写以降低通信开销、扩展为 GHSOM 以进一步缓解初始化敏感性、探索 GPU 加速、改进初始参数与并行粒度（如网络分区或混合分区）、并在更大规模数据上验证加速扩展性。

title: Robust Multi-Agent LLMs under Byzantine Faults
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly collaborate over peer-to-peer networks to improve their reliability. However, these same interactions can also become a source of vulnerability, as unreliable or Byzantine agents may sway neighboring agents toward incorrect conclusions and degrade overall system performance. Existing methods rely on leader-based coordination or self-reported confidence, both of which are susceptible to adversarial manipulation. We study decentralized LLM multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) and propose Self-Anchored Consensus (SAC), a fully decentralized iterative filter-and-refine protocol in which agents iteratively exchange responses, locally evaluate and filter unreliable messages, and refine their own outputs. We present $(F{+}1)$-robustness conditions for the communication graph that ensure honest agents preserve and propagate reliable information despite Byzantine influence. Experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that SAC effectively suppresses Byzantine influence and consistently improves performance across diverse communication topologies, whereas prior methods degrade under adversarial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出完全去中心化的 LLM 多智能体系统抗拜占庭协议 SAC（Self-Anchored Consensus）：用接收方自评置信度替代发送方自报置信度，配合 MSR 式过滤-精炼迭代，并以 (F+1)-robust 通信图为拓扑条件；实验显示 SAC 在数学/常识/竞赛推理基准上一致保持或提升性能（BFTI 非负），而基线 CP-WBFT 在伪造置信度攻击下性能崩溃。
AI.motivation: 去中心化 LLM 多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）通过点对点交互提升可靠性，但不可靠或拜占庭智能体可将邻居引向错误结论并降低系统性能。已有方法依赖领导者协调（Trusted MultiLLMN）或自报置信度（CP-WBFT），前者易被恶意领导者触发昂贵重选，后者隐含假设拜占庭节点诚实上报置信度，且通信图拓扑多为启发式手挑，缺乏容错理论保证。核心问题：如何在无中心、未知拜占庭身份的前提下，既让诚实的可靠智能体保持基线能力并协作精炼答案，又限制拜占庭影响传播。
AI.method: 将经典 MSR（Dolev 等）与 r-robustness（LeBlanc 等）迁移到 LLM-MAS。（1）威胁模型：拜占庭集 B=F（故障型，遵循协议但输出不可靠）∪ A（对抗型，可任意行为），采用 F-local 假设；定义 r-robust 图与引理：删除每个节点至多 k 条入边后仍为 (r−k)-robust。（2）SAC 协议（Algorithm 1）：每轮各节点 i 广播当前回答 r_i^(t)；用自身 LLM 的评分函数 φ_i（验证提示词，独立求解后输出 [0,1] 校准分数，解析失败取 0.5）对邻居回答逐一打分 s_{i→j}，完全不使用 j 自报分数；将得分低于自身自评分 s_{i→i} 的邻居构成 L_i，再丢弃其中最低分的 min(F,|L_i|) 个得到保留集 R_i；以 r_i^(t)、(r_j^(t), s_{i→j}) 构造精炼提示词更新 r_i^(t+1)（优先高分回答，允许保留自身回答作为锚点），并重算自评分。完全去中心化，不需全局拓扑或拜占庭身份；LLM 调用数 n(1+2T)（评分批量成一次调用）。（3）理论性质：Property 4.3——(F+1)-robust 图保证 |N_i|≥F+1，过滤后 R_i 非空且保留回答的评分不低于可靠节点评分的最小值；Property 4.4——(F+1)-robust 图在每节点删至多 F 条入边后仍含 rooted out-branching，即可靠节点子图在过滤后保持连通，避免分裂为收敛到不同答案的孤立子群。（4）拓扑：γ-MERG（r=⌈n/2⌉、边数最少）、完全图、优先连接图、Erdős–Rényi（p=[ln n+(r−1)lnln n]/n），均验证 (F+1)-robust。
AI.result: 在 n=7（4 强诚实 + 2 弱诚实 + 1 对抗拜占庭，F=3，r=4，T=6，对抗节点回放缓存弱模型回答并自报置信度 1.0）设置下：闭源模型（Hendrycks MATH Level 4 抽样 100 题、Commonsense170k 抽样 30 题）上 CP-WBFT 的 BFTI 为 −8.7%~−17.5%（MATH）与 −32.4%~−54.7%（常识），而 SAC 为 +0.4%~+3.0% 与 −2.8%~0.0%，H-Majority 达 76.7%~83.3%。开源模型（MATH-500 全量 + ARC-C/HellaSwag/BoolQ/OBQA/RTE 全量，Qwen3-4B 强 / Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 弱）上 CP-WBFT BFTI −2.8%~−12.0%，SAC 为 +1.1%~+6.5%，H-Majority 55.4%~74.6% vs 38.2%~50.0%，且跨拓扑方差更小。推理模型 AIME 2025（Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 强 / Qwen3-4B 弱）上 CP-WBFT 崩溃至 0.0% FAA，而 SAC 保持 58.6%~61.4%（H-Majority 76.7%~83.3%）；HMMT-25（4×GPT-5.6-sol 强 + 3 对抗）SAC BFTI 仅 −3.8%、H-Majority 93.3%，CP-WBFT 为 −51.4%/10.0%。消融显示 (b,w)=(3,0) 全对抗等设置下 SAC 仍多为非负 BFTI、H-Majority 83.3%~96.7%，性能不随 b 单调退化；n=9 扩展（6/2/1，含 4-robust 优先连接图）时 SAC 三个拓扑 BFTI 为正、H-Majority 86.7%~90.0%。机制上：CP-WBFT 的强/弱组精度在第 1 轮后互换（强降弱升），属靠拉低强节点换准确率的伪提升；SAC 则在保护强节点能力的同时小幅抬升弱节点。
AI.conclusion: SAC 将接收方自评 + MSR 式过滤-精炼与 (F+1)-robust 拓扑条件结合，为去中心化 LLM-MAS 提供了首个基于 MSR 类算法与 r-robustness 的抗拜占庭设计：自报置信度是攻击面，接收方独立评估可在构造层面遏制拜占庭影响，使可靠节点在 (F+1)-robust 图上保持能力并持续协作精炼。局限：鲁棒性依赖智能体基座能力（评分函数准确性、整合能力），过自信的故障节点可能错杀正确回答；实验仅覆盖 n∈{7,9}、单一对抗行为（缓存弱模型回放+伪造置信度）、单轮回答，未涉及大规模/动态网络、多轮推理与工具调用；更高鲁棒性需更稠密网络，存在韧性—效率权衡。

title: Detecting Deception, Not Deepfakes: Why Media Forensics Needs Social Theories
comment: Position paper. 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project page included
summary: For nearly a decade, deepfake detection has been framed as a classification task: given an audio or video clip, decide whether it is real or synthetic. Top detectors often report high accuracy on standard benchmarks; however, performance drops sharply on content from newer or unseen generators. We argue that better classifiers of synthetic media alone will not solve this problem, especially for interactive deepfakes such as impersonation in video and voice calls, where the harm lies not in the artifact (manipulated media signal) but in the act of deception. Deepfake detection therefore requires a complementary analytical layer focused on communicative interaction, not just media realism. We identify five assumptions that artifact-based detection (the forensic analysis of low-level signal traces) relies on and show that all five are eroding as generative models improve, producing what we call the Generalization Illusion. To address this, we draw on three well-established frameworks from philosophy of language and social psychology, namely, Speech Act Theory, Grice's Cooperative Principle, and Cialdini's principles of influence, to examine forensic signals at three levels: the utterance, the conversation, and the listener response. The result is a unified framework that complements existing forensic methods. We close with open problems for future work. https://jesseeho.github.io/deepfake-deception/

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了将深度伪造检测仅视为分类任务的传统范式，指出基于信号痕迹的取证分析所依赖的五个假设正随着生成模型进步而失效。作者引入言语行为理论、Grice合作原则和Cialdini影响力原则，从话语、会话和听众反应三个层面构建交互式深度伪造检测的统一框架。
AI.motivation: 当前深度伪造检测面临"泛化幻觉"困境：标准基准测试上表现优异，但在新型或未见过的生成器上性能急剧下降。现有方法聚焦于媒体真实性分析，忽视了交互式深度伪造（如视频/语音通话中的冒充）的核心危害在于欺骗行为本身而非人工痕迹
AI.method: 整合哲学语言学（言语行为理论）、语用学（Grice合作原则）和社会心理学（Cialdini影响力原则）三个框架，从话语、会话和听众反应三个层面分析合成信号的交际特征
AI.result: 构建了一个超越传统分类范式的互补分析框架，引入交际互动层面的深度伪造检测视角
AI.conclusion: 提出一个统一的框架来补充现有取证方法，并列出未来研究方向

title: VeriContest: A Competitive-Programming Benchmark for Verifiable Code Generation
summary: Large language models can generate useful code from natural language, but their outputs come without correctness guarantees. Verifiable code generation offers a path beyond testing by requiring models to produce not only executable code, but also formal specifications and machine-checkable proofs. Progress in this direction, however, is difficult to measure: existing benchmarks are often small, focus on only one part of the pipeline, lack ground-truth proofs or rigorous specification validation, or target verification settings far from mainstream software development. We present VeriContest, a benchmark of 946 competitive-programming problems from LeetCode and Codeforces for verifiable code generation in Rust with Verus. Each problem pairs a natural language description with expert-validated formal specifications, judge-accepted Rust code, Verus-checked proofs, and positive and negative test suites. VeriContest is constructed through a three-phase pipeline that scales from manually verified seed problems to semi-automated expansion with human-in-the-loop review. To further strengthen benchmark quality, we use testing as an additional quality-assurance layer for validating postcondition completeness. VeriContest supports isolated and compositional evaluation of specification generation, code generation, proof generation, and end-to-end verified program synthesis. Evaluating ten state-of-the-art models reveals a sharp gap between coding ability and verifiable code generation: the strongest model reaches 92.18% on natural-language-to-code generation, but only 48.31% on specification generation, 13.95% on proof generation, and 5.29% end-to-end. These results identify proof and specification generation as the central bottlenecks for models and establish VeriContest as a rigorous platform for measuring and training future systems that generate code with machine-checkable correctness.

AI.tldr: VeriContest是一个用于可验证代码生成的基准测试，包含946道竞赛编程题目，涵盖规格生成、代码生成、证明生成和端到端验证程序合成。评估10个SOTA模型发现：最强模型在代码生成达92.18%，但规格生成仅48.31%，证明生成仅13.95%，端到端仅5.29%，表明规格和证明生成是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证代码生成基准测试存在规模小、覆盖pipeline单一、缺乏真值证明或严格规格验证等问题，且与主流软件开发场景差距较大，难以准确衡量模型在可验证代码生成方面的进展。
AI.method: 通过三阶段流水线构建VeriContest基准：从人工验证的种子问题扩展到半自动化扩展+人工审查；使用测试作为验证后置条件完整性的额外质量保障层；支持对规格生成、代码生成、证明生成和端到端验证程序合成的独立和组合评估。
AI.result: 最强模型在自然语言到代码生成达92.18%，但规格生成仅48.31%，证明生成仅13.95%，端到端验证程序合成仅5.29%，表明规格和证明生成能力远落后于代码生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 规格生成和证明生成是当前模型在可验证代码生成任务中的核心瓶颈；VeriContest为衡量和训练未来生成可机器验证正确性代码的系统提供了严格平台。

title: Effective Explanations Support Planning Under Uncertainty
summary: Explaining how to get from A to B can be challenging. It requires mentally simulating what the listener will do based on what they are told. To capture this process, we propose a computational model that converts utterances into action plans: a large language model translates an explanation into program-like guidance (a policy prior and value map), and a planning agent executes it under partial observability. We score explanations by the efficiency and reliability of the resulting paths, penalizing replanning. Across four preregistered experiments, we collect a corpus of 1,200 explanations over 24 maps, elicit helpfulness judgments, measure baseline navigation, and test behavior with explanations of differing quality. Higher-scored explanations are judged more helpful and improve navigation: participants with explanations outperform those without, and high-scoring explanations help more than low-scoring ones. Together, these results show procedural explanation as utility-guided communication shaped by how language can be grounded into action under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将自然语言方向解释转化为可执行行动计划的计算模型，通过大语言模型将解释解码为程序化指导，结合规划智能体在部分可观测环境中执行，并在1200条解释、24张地图的四个预注册实验中验证了模型预测的解释质量与人类帮助性判断及实际导航表现高度一致。
AI.motivation: 解释如何从A点到B点是困难的，需要说话者模拟听者在给定信息下的行为，现有方法缺乏对这一心理模拟过程的计算化捕捉。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型将自然语言解释转换为程序化指导（策略先验和价值地图），结合规划智能体在部分可观测环境下执行；通过1200条解释、24张地图的四个预注册实验验证，包括帮助性判断、基线导航测量和不同质量解释的行为测试。
AI.result: 评分更高的解释被判断为更有帮助，接受解释的参与者表现优于无解释参与者，高评分解释比低评分解释帮助更大。
AI.conclusion: 通过计算模型预测解释质量，证明解释的有效性取决于将语言转化为行动计划的能力，证明了程序性解释是受效用引导的沟通方式。

title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents
summary: Skill libraries have become a practical way for LLM agents to reuse procedural experience across tasks. However, existing systems typically treat skills as flat, single-resolution prompt blocks. This creates a tension between relevance and cost: injecting coarse skills can introduce irrelevant or misleading context, while rewriting entire skills is expensive and often unnecessary. We propose SkillLens, a hierarchical skill-evolution framework that organizes skills into a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, and retrieves them at mixed granularity. Given a task, SkillLens first retrieves semantically relevant skill seeds, expands them through degree-corrected random walk over the skill graph, and then uses a verifier to decide whether each visited unit should be accepted, decomposed, rewritten, or skipped. This enables the agent to reuse compatible subskills directly while adapting only locally mismatched components. To improve the system over time, SkillLens further refines multi-granularity skills and verifier in order to improve its routing decisions. We provide theoretical analysis showing that mixed-granularity adaptation incurs sublinear cost under sparse mismatch assumptions and that the evolutionary update rule monotonically improves the validation objective until a local optimum. Across MuLocbench and ALFWorld, SkillLens consistently improves over strong skill-based baselines, achieving up to a 6.31 percentage-point Acc@1 gain for bug localization and raising agent success rate from 45.00% to 51.31%.

AI.tldr: SkillLens是一个层级化技能进化框架，通过四层技能图和验证器实现混合粒度技能检索与自适应复用，在两个基准上取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 现有技能库将技能作为扁平单粒度prompt块，存在相关性-成本权衡困境：粗粒度引入噪声，细粒度重写成本高
AI.method: 四层技能图（策略/策略/程序/原语）+ 度校正随机游走检索 + 验证器决策（接受/分解/重写/跳过）+ 进化式更新机制
AI.result: 在MuLocbench上Acc@1提升6.31个百分点；在ALFWorld上成功率从45.00%提升至51.31%
AI.conclusion: 理论证明了亚线性成本和单调收敛性；实验表明在多个基准上显著优于基线方法，验证了框架的有效性。
